title_zh: 课前闲聊：今日计划（核酸与静态生化收尾，动态生化开篇）
title_en: Pre-class chat: today's plan (finishing nucleic acids and static biochemistry, opening dynamic biochemistry)

points.zh: 今天计划讲完核酸(nucleic acids)部分，从而结束整个静态生化(static biochemistry)
points.en: Today's plan is to finish the nucleic acids section, completing all of static biochemistry.

points.zh: 动态生化(dynamic biochemistry，即代谢部分)今天先开一个头，正式展开留到之后
points.en: Dynamic biochemistry (i.e., metabolism) will only get an opening today; the full treatment comes later.

points.zh: 复习内容是大约一周前讲过的"维生素和辅酶"(vitamins and coenzymes)这一章
points.en: The review covers the "vitamins and coenzymes" chapter taught about a week earlier.

points.zh: 课程固定模式是先复习上次内容，再讲新内容
points.en: The course's fixed pattern is to review the previous session's material before moving to new content.

points.zh: 开场出现屏幕共享问题：一开始误把整个桌面而非讲义窗口分享出去，随后切换为全屏共享讲义
points.en: A screen-share hiccup at the start: the whole desktop was shared instead of the slide window, then switched to full-screen slides.

extra.zh: 静态生化通常涵盖氨基酸/蛋白质、糖类、脂质、维生素与辅酶、核酸的结构化学；动态生化对应物质代谢(metabolism)——这是常见的生化课程整体架构，帮助定位当天内容在课程大纲中的位置
extra.en: Static biochemistry typically covers the structural chemistry of amino acids/proteins, carbohydrates, lipids, vitamins/coenzymes, and nucleic acids; dynamic biochemistry corresponds to metabolism — a common overall course structure that helps place today's content within the syllabus.

extra.zh: 国内高校"生物化学"教材常把课程分为"静态生化"（结构与组成）和"动态生化"（代谢与生物能学）两大板块，是许多考研/考博大纲固定的分类方式，复习时可据此按板块查漏补缺
extra.en: Chinese biochemistry textbooks commonly split the subject into "static biochemistry" (structure/composition) and "dynamic biochemistry" (metabolism/bioenergetics) — a standard grouping used in many graduate-entrance exam syllabi, useful for organizing review by section.

quiz.q_zh: 本节课开头，老师说今天计划讲完哪一部分内容，从而结束整个"静态生化"？
quiz.q_en: At the start of class, what does the teacher say will be finished today, completing all of "static biochemistry"?

options.zh: 脂质与生物膜
options.en: Lipids and biomembranes

options.zh: 糖类与多糖
options.en: Sugars and polysaccharides

options.zh: 核酸与碱基
options.en: Nucleic acids and bases

options.zh: 蛋白质与氨基酸
options.en: Proteins and amino acids

quiz.explain_zh: 老师明确说"我们今天无论如何肯定会把核酸全部讲完，把静态生化全部讲完"。蛋白质与氨基酸、脂质与生物膜、糖类与多糖都是此前几讲已经结束的内容。
quiz.explain_en: The teacher explicitly says today they will definitely finish nucleic acids, completing all of static biochemistry. Proteins and amino acids, lipids and biomembranes, and sugars and polysaccharides were all finished in earlier sessions.

quiz.q_zh: 老师提到，"动态生化"这一部分主要对应生物化学中的哪一类内容？
quiz.q_en: The teacher says "dynamic biochemistry" mainly corresponds to which area of biochemistry?

options.zh: 基因编辑与基因治疗
options.en: Gene editing and gene therapy

options.zh: 代谢与能量转化
options.en: Metabolism and energy flow

options.zh: 蛋白质结构生物学
options.en: Structural biology of proteins

options.zh: 分子克隆与载体
options.en: Molecular cloning and vectors

quiz.explain_zh: 老师说"动态生化...就是代谢这一块"，讲的是物质与能量在细胞内的转化。蛋白质结构生物学属于静态生化已讲过的部分，分子克隆与载体、基因编辑与基因治疗则是分子生物学课程的内容。
quiz.explain_en: The teacher says "dynamic biochemistry ... is the metabolism part," i.e. how matter and energy are transformed in the cell. Structural biology of proteins belongs to the static half already covered, while molecular cloning and gene editing belong to molecular biology courses.

title_zh: 上一讲复习：脂溶性维生素 A、D、E、K
title_en: Review of last session: fat-soluble vitamins A, D, E, K

points.zh: 脂溶性维生素共4种：维生素A、D、E、K
points.en: There are four fat-soluble vitamins: A, D, E, and K.

points.zh: 维生素A对眼睛好（与视觉功能相关）
points.en: Vitamin A is good for the eyes (related to visual function).

points.zh: 维生素D主要有D2（麦角钙化醇, ergocalciferol）和D3（胆钙化醇, cholecalciferol）两种形式，统称"钙化醇"类
points.en: Vitamin D mainly exists as D2 (ergocalciferol) and D3 (cholecalciferol), collectively the "calciferols."

points.zh: 维生素D最主要的作用是促进钙（及磷）的吸收，晒太阳有助于促进钙磷吸收
points.en: Vitamin D's main role is promoting calcium (and phosphate) absorption; sun exposure helps with this.

points.zh: 维生素E中文名"生育酚"(tocopherol)，具有一定抗氧化(antioxidant)功能，但因脂溶性维生素用量少，其抗氧化作用不如维生素C重要
points.en: Vitamin E ("tocopherol") has some antioxidant function, but since fat-soluble vitamins are used in smaller amounts, its antioxidant role is less prominent than vitamin C's.

points.zh: 维生素K是脂溶性维生素中唯一可以作为辅酶(coenzyme)的维生素
points.en: Vitamin K is the only fat-soluble vitamin that can act as a coenzyme.

points.zh: 维生素K的功能是促进氨基酸的羧化(carboxylation)反应，加上一个羧基
points.en: Vitamin K's function is to promote carboxylation of amino acids, adding a carboxyl group.

points.zh: 四种脂溶性维生素中，维生素D相对最重要，其余三种重要性较低
points.en: Among the four fat-soluble vitamins, vitamin D is relatively the most important; the other three are less critical.

extra.zh: 老师说"VD是坏血病"(~00:01:41)。实际上坏血病(scurvy)是维生素C缺乏导致——胶原蛋白的脯氨酸/赖氨酸羟化酶(prolyl/lysyl hydroxylase)需要抗坏血酸作辅因子，缺乏时胶原交联失败、血管变脆弱；维生素D缺乏导致的是佝偻病/骨软化症(rickets/osteomalacia)，与坏血病无关。
extra.en: The teacher says "vitamin D is scurvy" (~00:01:41). Scurvy is actually caused by vitamin C deficiency — collagen's prolyl/lysyl hydroxylases need ascorbate as a cofactor, so collagen cross-linking fails without it. Vitamin D deficiency causes rickets/osteomalacia, not scurvy.

extra.zh: 老师说维生素K"是一种凝血酶原(prothrombin)"、"这是一种酶"(~00:03:55-00:04:27)。实际上维生素K是γ-谷氨酰羧化酶(γ-glutamyl carboxylase)的辅因子(cofactor)，该酶负责羧化凝血酶原及因子VII、IX、X上的谷氨酸残基；维生素K本身既不是凝血酶原也不是酶。
extra.en: The teacher calls vitamin K "a kind of prothrombin" and "an enzyme" (~00:03:55-00:04:27). Vitamin K is actually the cofactor for γ-glutamyl carboxylase, the enzyme that carboxylates glutamate residues on prothrombin and factors VII, IX, X. It is neither prothrombin nor an enzyme itself.

extra.zh: 维生素A的活性形式包括视黄醛(retinal，参与视觉circuit)和视黄酸(retinoic acid，参与基因转录调控)；典型缺乏症是夜盲症(night blindness)——课上未展开。
extra.en: Active forms of vitamin A include retinal (involved in vision) and retinoic acid (involved in gene transcription regulation); the classic deficiency is night blindness — not detailed in lecture.

extra.zh: 维生素D的活性形式是骨化三醇(calcitriol, 1,25-二羟维生素D3)，需经皮肤UV合成后再经肝、肾两步羟化才能激活——课上未展开这一激活过程。
extra.en: The active form of vitamin D is calcitriol (1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D3), which requires UV synthesis in skin followed by two hydroxylation steps in liver and kidney to become active — this activation pathway was not detailed in lecture.

quiz.q_zh: 老师口误地把某个维生素与"坏血病"联系了起来，实际造成坏血病(scurvy)的是哪种维生素缺乏？
quiz.q_en: The teacher misspoke and linked a vitamin to "scurvy" — which vitamin deficiency actually causes scurvy?

options.zh: 维生素A
options.en: Vitamin A

options.zh: 维生素K
options.en: Vitamin K

options.zh: 维生素C
options.en: Vitamin C

options.zh: 维生素D
options.en: Vitamin D

quiz.explain_zh: 坏血病由维生素C缺乏引起（胶原羟化需要抗坏血酸）。维生素D缺乏导致佝偻病/骨软化症，维生素A缺乏导致夜盲，维生素K缺乏导致凝血障碍，老师口误把维生素D与坏血病搞混了。
quiz.explain_en: Scurvy results from vitamin C deficiency (collagen hydroxylation needs ascorbate). Vitamin D deficiency causes rickets/osteomalacia, vitamin A deficiency causes night blindness, and vitamin K deficiency causes bleeding; the teacher's misstatement conflated vitamin D with scurvy.

quiz.q_zh: 维生素K真正的生化角色是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is vitamin K's true biochemical role?

options.zh: 凝血酶原本身，一种凝血因子
options.en: Prothrombin itself, a clotting factor

options.zh: 催化凝血酶原合成的一种酶
options.en: The enzyme that makes prothrombin

options.zh: 被羧化后的谷氨酸残基产物
options.en: The product of glutamate carboxylation

options.zh: γ-谷氨酰羧化酶的辅因子
options.en: Cofactor of γ-glutamyl carboxylase

quiz.explain_zh: 维生素K是γ-谷氨酰羧化酶的辅因子，帮助该酶羧化凝血因子上的谷氨酸残基。它不是凝血酶原这种凝血因子，不是催化凝血酶原合成的酶，也不是羧化反应生成的γ-羧基谷氨酸残基。
quiz.explain_en: Vitamin K is the cofactor of γ-glutamyl carboxylase, which carboxylates glutamate residues on clotting factors. It is not prothrombin, not the enzyme that makes prothrombin, and not the γ-carboxyglutamate produced by that reaction.

quiz.q_zh: 课上说，四种脂溶性维生素中唯一可以作为辅酶的是哪一个？
quiz.q_en: Of the four fat-soluble vitamins, which one does the lecture say is the only one that can act as a coenzyme?

options.zh: 维生素E
options.en: Vitamin E

options.zh: 维生素A
options.en: Vitamin A

options.zh: 维生素D
options.en: Vitamin D

options.zh: 维生素K
options.en: Vitamin K

quiz.explain_zh: 课上明确说"维生素K是脂溶性维生素里边唯一一个可以作为辅酶的维生素"。维生素E主要作抗氧化剂，维生素A是视觉色素的发色团前体，维生素D经羟化后作为激素起作用，都不充当辅酶。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture states vitamin K is "the only fat-soluble vitamin that can act as a coenzyme." Vitamin E acts as an antioxidant, vitamin A supplies the chromophore of visual pigment, and vitamin D acts as a hormone after hydroxylation — none serves as a coenzyme.

title_zh: 上一讲复习：水溶性维生素 B1/B2/B6/B12/B3(PP)
title_en: Review of last session: water-soluble vitamins B1, B2, B6, B12, B3 (PP)

points.zh: 水溶性维生素的共同特点是几乎都能作为某些酶的辅酶(coenzyme)，具体功能不需要逐一精确记忆
points.en: Water-soluble vitamins share the feature that almost all can serve as coenzymes for various enzymes; their exact individual functions don't need to be memorized precisely.

points.zh: 维生素B1（硫胺素, thiamine）的功能是转移二碳单位(two-carbon unit)
points.en: Vitamin B1 (thiamine) functions in transferring two-carbon units.

points.zh: 维生素B2（核黄素, riboflavin）主要以FMN和FAD两种形式存在，二者都能接受两个氢原子(2 hydrogen atoms)
points.en: Vitamin B2 (riboflavin) mainly exists as FMN and FAD, both of which accept two hydrogen atoms.

points.zh: 维生素B6（磷酸吡哆醛, pyridoxal phosphate）也可以醛、醇或胺的形式存在，但主要形式是磷酸吡哆醛
points.en: Vitamin B6 (pyridoxal phosphate) can also exist as an aldehyde, alcohol, or amine form, but pyridoxal phosphate is the main form.

points.zh: 维生素B12含有钴元素(cobalt)，其结构被描述为与血红蛋白中的血红素很相似
points.en: Vitamin B12 contains cobalt; its structure is described as very similar to the heme in hemoglobin.

points.zh: 维生素B3/PP（烟酸/烟酰胺, niacin）是NAD和NADP的关键组成成分，主要作用是传递一个氢原子(1 hydrogen atom)
points.en: Vitamin B3/PP (niacin) is a key component of NAD and NADP, mainly functioning to transfer one hydrogen atom.

points.zh: 课上把B2（接受2个氢原子）与B3（接受1个氢原子）做对比强调，因为代谢章节围绕氢原子的传递展开
points.en: The lecture contrasts B2 (accepts 2 hydrogen atoms) with B3 (accepts 1 hydrogen atom) since the metabolism chapters revolve around hydrogen-atom transfer.

extra.zh: 严格来说NAD⁺接受的是一个氢负离子(hydride, H⁻，相当于2个电子+1个质子)而不是笼统的"一个氢原子"，生成NADH，另一个质子则释放到溶液中；FAD/FMN则确实接受2个完整氢原子（2电子+2质子）。课上"一个/两个氢原子"是简化说法。
extra.en: Strictly, NAD+ accepts a hydride ion (H⁻, equivalent to 2 electrons + 1 proton) rather than a generic "one hydrogen atom," forming NADH while the second proton is released to solution; FAD/FMN do accept two full hydrogen atoms (2 electrons + 2 protons). The lecture's "one/two hydrogen atoms" is a simplification.

extra.zh: 维生素B1的活性辅酶形式是焦磷酸硫胺素(TPP, thiamine pyrophosphate)，在丙酮酸脱氢酶(pyruvate dehydrogenase)等酶中催化α-酮酸的脱羧反应——课上未展开。
extra.en: The active coenzyme form of vitamin B1 is thiamine pyrophosphate (TPP), which catalyzes decarboxylation of α-keto acids in enzymes like pyruvate dehydrogenase — not detailed in lecture.

extra.zh: FAD/FMN属于黄素核苷酸(基于异咯嗪环, isoalloxazine ring)，NAD/NADP属于烟酰胺核苷酸(基于烟酰胺环, nicotinamide ring)，两类结构完全不同，容易只记"接受几个氢"而混淆其化学本质。
extra.en: FAD/FMN are flavin nucleotides (based on the isoalloxazine ring), while NAD/NADP are nicotinamide nucleotides (based on the nicotinamide ring) — structurally distinct classes that are easy to conflate if only the "how many hydrogens" fact is remembered.

quiz.q_zh: 讲课中把FMN/FAD与NAD/NADP做对比，二者分别接受几个氢原子？
quiz.q_en: The lecture contrasts FMN/FAD with NAD/NADP — how many hydrogen atoms does each accept?

options.zh: FMN/FAD与NAD/NADP都接受1个
options.en: Both FMN/FAD and NAD/NADP accept 1

options.zh: FMN/FAD接受2个，NAD/NADP接受1个
options.en: FMN/FAD accept 2, NAD/NADP accept 1

options.zh: FMN/FAD接受1个，NAD/NADP接受2个
options.en: FMN/FAD accept 1, NAD/NADP accept 2

options.zh: FMN/FAD与NAD/NADP都接受2个
options.en: Both FMN/FAD and NAD/NADP accept 2

quiz.explain_zh: 课上明确对比"维B2它是接受两个氢原子，维B3是接受一个氢原子"，即黄素辅酶接受2个而烟酰胺辅酶接受1个氢，二者数目并不相同，也不是反过来。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture explicitly contrasts: "vitamin B2 accepts two hydrogen atoms, vitamin B3 accepts one." The flavin and nicotinamide coenzymes therefore differ, and the numbers are not equal nor reversed.

quiz.q_zh: 维生素B1(硫胺素)在课上被强调的主要功能是什么？
quiz.q_en: What main function does the lecture emphasize for vitamin B1 (thiamine)?

options.zh: 转移氢原子
options.en: Transfers hydrogen atoms

options.zh: 羧化氨基酸
options.en: Carboxylates amino acids

options.zh: 转移二碳单位
options.en: Transfers two-carbon units

options.zh: 转移一碳单位
options.en: Transfers one-carbon units

quiz.explain_zh: 课上说B1（以TPP形式）转移二碳单位。一碳单位由叶酸携带，转移氢原子是B2/B3类辅酶的工作，羧化氨基酸残基依赖生物素或维生素K，都不是B1的功能。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture says B1 (as TPP) transfers two-carbon units. One-carbon units are carried by folate, hydrogen transfer is the job of the B2/B3 coenzymes, and carboxylating amino acid residues depends on biotin or vitamin K.

quiz.q_zh: 维生素B12在结构上与什么最为相似（课上提到）？
quiz.q_en: What does the lecture say vitamin B12's structure most closely resembles?

options.zh: 维生素K中的醌环
options.en: The quinone ring of vitamin K

options.zh: NAD中的烟酰胺环
options.en: The nicotinamide ring of NAD

options.zh: FAD中的异咯嗪环
options.en: The isoalloxazine ring of FAD

options.zh: 血红蛋白中的血红素
options.en: The heme group of hemoglobin

quiz.explain_zh: 课上说维生素B12的结构"非常像血红蛋白里的血红素"：两者都是围绕一个中心金属的四吡咯大环（B12是钴，血红素是铁）。维生素K的醌环、NAD的烟酰胺环、FAD的异咯嗪环都不是这种含金属的大环。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture says vitamin B12's structure is "very much like the heme in hemoglobin": both are tetrapyrrole macrocycles around a central metal (cobalt in B12, iron in heme). The quinone ring of vitamin K, the nicotinamide ring of NAD and the isoalloxazine ring of FAD are not metal-containing macrocycles.

title_zh: 上一讲复习：泛酸/辅酶A(CoA)与生物素/Strep-tag
title_en: Review of last session: pantothenic acid/coenzyme A (CoA) and biotin/Strep-tag

points.zh: 泛酸(pantothenic acid, 维生素B5)在各类生物体内都广泛存在，因为大多数生物的脂肪酸(fatty acid)代谢途径比较相似（不像糖代谢途径因物种差异较大）
points.en: Pantothenic acid (vitamin B5) is widely present across organisms because most organisms' fatty acid metabolism pathways are relatively similar, unlike carbohydrate metabolism pathways which vary more by species.

points.zh: 泛酸是辅酶A(CoA, coenzyme A)的关键组成部分
points.en: Pantothenic acid is a key component of coenzyme A (CoA).

points.zh: 乙酰CoA(acetyl-CoA)是脂肪酸合成(fatty acid synthesis)的主要原料，也是糖代谢与脂肪酸代谢之间的桥梁
points.en: Acetyl-CoA is the main raw material for fatty acid synthesis and serves as a bridge between carbohydrate and fatty acid metabolism.

points.zh: 乙酰CoA的结构是一个羰基(carbonyl)加两个碳组成的"乙酰"基团，连接到CoA上的一个硫原子（可能来自半胱氨酸cysteine的巯基）
points.en: Acetyl-CoA's structure is an acetyl group (a carbonyl plus two carbons) attached to a sulfur atom on CoA (possibly from a cysteine thiol).

points.zh: 生物素(biotin)是相对重要的水溶性维生素，广泛作为辅酶发挥作用
points.en: Biotin is a relatively important water-soluble vitamin that widely functions as a coenzyme.

points.zh: Strep-tag是模拟生物素结构的一小段七肽(7-residue peptide)，能与链霉亲和素(streptavidin，课上称"链霉素结合蛋白")结合
points.en: Strep-tag is a short 7-residue peptide that mimics biotin's structure and binds streptavidin (called "streptomycin-binding protein" in lecture).

points.zh: 课上强调Strep-tag与链霉亲和素的结合力是自然界目前发现最强的结合力之一，远高于常用的His-tag
points.en: The lecture emphasizes that Strep-tag's binding to streptavidin is among the strongest known non-covalent interactions in nature, much stronger than the commonly used His-tag.

points.zh: Strep-tag只有7个氨基酸，对目标蛋白结构影响小；该原理也用于蛋白的生物素化标记(biotinylation)，以便固定到芯片等表面
points.en: Strep-tag's mere 7 amino acids minimally perturb the target protein's structure; the same principle underlies biotinylation labeling used to immobilize proteins on surfaces like chips.

extra.zh: 天然的生物素-(链霉)亲和素结合是自然界已知最强的非共价相互作用之一，解离常数(Kd)可达飞摩尔级别(~10⁻¹⁵ M)；工程化的Strep-tag/Strep-Tactin系统结合力弱得多（通常在微摩尔到纳摩尔级别），这正是它能温和洗脱、适合可逆纯化的原因——课上给出的具体数量级仅供参考，未必与文献完全一致。
extra.en: Natural biotin-(strept)avidin binding is among the strongest known non-covalent interactions, with a dissociation constant (Kd) reaching the femtomolar range (~10⁻¹⁵ M); the engineered Strep-tag/Strep-Tactin system binds far more weakly (typically micromolar to nanomolar), which is precisely why it allows gentle elution and reversible purification — the specific order of magnitude given in lecture is presented for reference and may not exactly match the literature.

extra.zh: 生物素是羧化酶(carboxylase)的辅酶，例如丙酮酸羧化酶(pyruvate carboxylase)和乙酰CoA羧化酶(acetyl-CoA carboxylase)，其机制是先形成活化的羧基生物素(carboxybiotin)中间体，再把CO2转移给底物——课上未展开这一机制。
extra.en: Biotin serves as the coenzyme for carboxylases such as pyruvate carboxylase and acetyl-CoA carboxylase, working by first forming an activated carboxybiotin intermediate that then transfers CO2 to the substrate — this mechanism was not detailed in lecture.

extra.zh: His-tag通常依赖与Ni²⁺/Co²⁺等金属离子的螯合作用(chelation)结合到Ni-NTA树脂上，其结合力受咪唑(imidazole)浓度调控，机制与Strep-tag/链霉亲和素的蛋白-蛋白识别完全不同——课上只做了强弱比较，未展开原理差异。
extra.en: His-tag purification typically relies on chelation with metal ions such as Ni²⁺/Co²⁺ on Ni-NTA resin, with binding modulated by imidazole concentration — a fundamentally different mechanism from the protein-protein recognition of Strep-tag/streptavidin. Lecture only compared strength, not the underlying mechanistic difference.

quiz.q_zh: 课上强调，为什么泛酸(pantothenic acid)在各种生物体内都广泛存在？
quiz.q_en: Why does the lecture say pantothenic acid is widespread across organisms?

options.zh: 各类生物的糖代谢途径几乎完全相同
options.en: Sugar metabolism pathways are identical in all organisms

options.zh: 泛酸不需转运蛋白即可自由地跨膜扩散
options.en: Pantothenate crosses any membrane freely without a carrier

options.zh: 几乎所有生物都能自己从头合成泛酸
options.en: Almost every organism can synthesize its own pantothenate

options.zh: 大多数生物的脂肪酸代谢途径高度相似
options.en: Fatty-acid metabolism is highly similar in most organisms

quiz.explain_zh: 课上说大多数生物（真核或原核）的脂肪酸合成和分解途径都比较相似，而这些途径都要用到以泛酸为骨架的辅酶A，所以泛酸广泛存在。糖代谢途径恰恰因物种而异；泛酸跨膜要靠专门的转运蛋白；动物也不能从头合成泛酸，必须从食物摄取。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture explains that most organisms' (eukaryotic or prokaryotic) fatty acid synthesis and breakdown pathways are similar, and all of them use coenzyme A, whose backbone is pantothenate. Carbohydrate metabolism is precisely what varies between species; pantothenate needs a dedicated transporter to cross membranes; and animals cannot make it de novo, which is why it is a vitamin.

quiz.q_zh: 乙酰CoA在课上被描述为连接哪两类代谢途径的桥梁？
quiz.q_en: The lecture describes acetyl-CoA as a bridge connecting which two metabolic pathways?

options.zh: 脂肪酸代谢与核酸代谢
options.en: Fatty acid and nucleic acid metabolism

options.zh: 糖代谢与脂肪酸代谢
options.en: Carbohydrate and fatty acid metabolism

options.zh: 核酸代谢与蛋白质代谢
options.en: Nucleic acid and protein metabolism

options.zh: 核苷酸代谢与氨基酸代谢
options.en: Nucleotide and amino acid metabolism

quiz.explain_zh: 课上说乙酰CoA"在糖的代谢和脂肪酸的代谢里边加起一个桥梁的作用"：糖酵解产物丙酮酸转成乙酰CoA后可去合成脂肪酸。核酸与蛋白质、核苷酸与氨基酸、脂肪酸与核酸这几组途径之间并不是靠乙酰CoA相连的。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture says acetyl-CoA "serves as a bridge between carbohydrate metabolism and fatty acid metabolism": pyruvate from glycolysis becomes acetyl-CoA, which can then build fatty acids. Nucleic acid with protein, nucleotide with amino acid, and fatty acid with nucleic acid are not pairs joined by acetyl-CoA.

quiz.q_zh: 关于Strep-tag，课上强调的最大优势是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the main advantage of Strep-tag emphasized in lecture?

options.zh: 只能用于原核表达系统，在真核中失效
options.en: Works only in prokaryotic, not eukaryotic, systems

options.zh: 必须先对标签做生物素化修饰才能结合
options.en: The tag must be biotinylated first in order to bind

options.zh: 与链霉亲和素的亲和力极强，且肽段很短
options.en: Very strong streptavidin binding; short peptide

options.zh: 亲和力弱于His-tag，但洗脱更温和
options.en: Weaker than His-tag, but the elution is gentler

quiz.explain_zh: 课上说Strep-tag与链霉亲和素的结合力"是自然界中目前发现的最强的"，而且标签只有7个氨基酸，对蛋白结构影响很小。它的亲和力远强于His-tag而不是更弱，在真核和原核表达系统中都能使用，也不需要事先做生物素化修饰。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture says Strep-tag's binding to streptavidin is "currently the strongest found in nature," and being only 7 residues it barely perturbs the protein. Its affinity is far stronger than His-tag rather than weaker, it works in eukaryotic as well as prokaryotic systems, and it needs no prior biotinylation.

title_zh: 复习收尾：叶酸、硫辛酸、维生素C与辅基金属离子
title_en: Wrapping up the review: folic acid, lipoic acid, vitamin C, and metal-ion cofactors

points.zh: 叶酸(folic acid)作为辅酶携带一碳单位(one-carbon unit)
points.en: Folic acid acts as a coenzyme carrying one-carbon units.

points.zh: 一碳单位用于构建核苷酸(nucleotide)，因此孕妇孕期(pregnancy)被推荐额外补充叶酸，帮助胎儿基因正确复制合成
points.en: One-carbon units are used to build nucleotides, so pregnant women are recommended to supplement folic acid to help the fetus's genes replicate and synthesize correctly.

points.zh: 硫辛酸(lipoic acid)提及简略，属于不太重要、只需认识名字的维生素
points.en: Lipoic acid is mentioned only briefly, a less important vitamin whose name just needs to be recognized.

points.zh: 维生素C（化学式近似CH2O，类似碳水化合物）结构中有两个双键，且双键上各带一个羟基(hydroxyl)，这个环状结构课上称为"缩醛"
points.en: Vitamin C (chemical formula approximately CH2O, resembling a carbohydrate) has two double bonds each bearing a hydroxyl group; the lecture calls this ring structure an "acetal."

points.zh: 该环状结构在水中可打开形成醛基(aldehyde)，醛基可被进一步还原为醇，这是维生素C强还原性(reducing property)的化学基础
points.en: This ring can open in water to form an aldehyde group, which can be further reduced to an alcohol — the chemical basis of vitamin C's strong reducing property.

points.zh: 辅基金属离子中，铁(Fe)是血红蛋白中与O2/CO配位的金属中心
points.en: Among cofactor metal ions, iron (Fe) is the metal center in hemoglobin that coordinates O2/CO.

points.zh: 课上把龙虾(lobster)体内呈蓝色、以铜(Cu)为中心的呼吸色素称为"血红蛋白/血红素"，并说明亚铁(Fe²⁺)呈红色、亚铜(Cu⁺)呈蓝色
points.en: The lecture calls the lobster's blue, copper-centered respiratory pigment "hemoglobin/heme," noting that ferrous iron (Fe²⁺) is red while cuprous copper (Cu⁺) is blue.

points.zh: 锌(Zn)和镁(Mg)功能相似，主要用于和ATP络合，存在于许多利用ATP的酶活性中心
points.en: Zinc (Zn) and magnesium (Mg) have similar functions, mainly complexing with ATP and present in the active centers of many ATP-utilizing enzymes.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 龙虾等甲壳类/软体动物体内的铜基呼吸色素正确名称是血蓝蛋白(hemocyanin)，与血红蛋白(hemoglobin)结构完全不同、不含血红素(heme)，而是溶解在血淋巴(hemolymph)中，不像脊椎动物血红蛋白那样包装在红细胞(erythrocyte)内；氧合时呈蓝色。（对应~00:16:17-00:16:50）
extra.en: The copper-based respiratory pigment in lobsters and many mollusks/arthropods is correctly called hemocyanin, structurally unrelated to hemoglobin and containing no heme. It is dissolved in the hemolymph rather than packaged inside erythrocytes as vertebrate hemoglobin is, and turns blue when oxygenated. (Corresponds to ~00:16:17-00:16:50.)

extra.zh: 维生素C的还原性中心标准描述为烯二醇内酯结构(ene-diol lactone)，氧化后生成脱氢抗坏血酸(dehydroascorbic acid)；这个环实际是内酯(lactone，一种环状酯)而非"缩醛"(acetal)，课上用词与标准命名不同，仅供参考。
extra.en: The standard description of vitamin C's reducing center is an ene-diol lactone structure, which oxidizes to dehydroascorbic acid; the ring is actually a lactone (a cyclic ester), not an "acetal" as stated in lecture — presented for reference as the terms differ.

extra.zh: 叶酸的活性辅酶形式是四氢叶酸(tetrahydrofolate, THF)，参与嘌呤(purine)全合成及胸苷酸(dTMP)合成，是甲氨蝶呤(methotrexate)等抗叶酸药物的作用靶点——课上未展开。
extra.en: The active coenzyme form of folic acid is tetrahydrofolate (THF), involved in purine synthesis and dTMP synthesis, and is the target of antifolate drugs like methotrexate — not detailed in lecture.

extra.zh: 锌指(zinc finger)结构域是Zn参与DNA/RNA结合调控的经典例子，是Zn的另一类重要功能，与课上提到的Zn-ATP络合功能不同——课上未展开。
extra.en: Zinc finger domains are a classic example of Zn's role in DNA/RNA binding regulation, a different important function from the Zn-ATP complexing mentioned in lecture — not detailed in lecture.

quiz.q_zh: 关于龙虾血液呈蓝色的原因，课上说法与标准生物化学的正确名称分别是什么？
quiz.q_en: For why lobster blood is blue, what does the lecture call the pigment, and what is its correct standard name?

options.zh: 课上称为"血蓝蛋白"，正确名称应为血红蛋白(hemoglobin)
options.en: Lecture calls it "hemocyanin"; the correct name is hemoglobin

options.zh: 课上称为"肌红蛋白"，正确名称应为血红蛋白(hemoglobin)
options.en: Lecture calls it "myoglobin"; the correct name is hemoglobin

options.zh: 课上称为"肌红蛋白"，正确名称应为血蓝蛋白(hemocyanin)
options.en: Lecture calls it "myoglobin"; the correct name is hemocyanin

options.zh: 课上称为"血红蛋白"，正确名称应为血蓝蛋白(hemocyanin)
options.en: Lecture calls it "hemoglobin"; the correct name is hemocyanin

quiz.explain_zh: 老师把这个铜基呼吸色素称为"血红蛋白/血红素"，而不是血蓝蛋白，也不是肌红蛋白；但它结构上与血红蛋白无关、不含血红素，铜直接由组氨酸配位，正确名称是血蓝蛋白(hemocyanin)。
quiz.explain_en: The teacher calls this copper-based pigment "hemoglobin/heme" — not hemocyanin and not myoglobin. Structurally it is unrelated to hemoglobin and contains no heme; the copper is held directly by histidines, and the correct name is hemocyanin.

quiz.q_zh: 叶酸在课上被强调的主要功能是什么？
quiz.q_en: What main function does the lecture emphasize for folic acid?

options.zh: 接受氢原子，参与氧化还原反应
options.en: Accepts hydrogen atoms, taking part in redox reactions

options.zh: 促进氨基酸羧化，用于凝血因子
options.en: Promotes amino acid carboxylation, in clotting factors

options.zh: 携带一碳单位，用于构建核苷酸
options.en: Carries one-carbon units, used to build nucleotides

options.zh: 携带二碳单位，用于构建脂肪酸
options.en: Carries two-carbon units, used to build fatty acids

quiz.explain_zh: 课上说叶酸"主要是...用来携带这个一碳单位...用于构建核酸的...核苷酸"。携带二碳单位的是乙酰CoA与TPP，接受氢原子参与氧化还原的是NAD与FAD，促进凝血因子上谷氨酸羧化的是维生素K。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture says folic acid "is mainly used to carry one-carbon units ... used to build nucleic acids ... nucleotides." Two-carbon units are carried by acetyl-CoA and TPP, hydrogen atoms in redox reactions by NAD and FAD, and carboxylation of clotting-factor glutamates depends on vitamin K.

quiz.q_zh: 课上提到锌(Zn)和镁(Mg)的共同功能是什么？
quiz.q_en: What common function does the lecture attribute to zinc (Zn) and magnesium (Mg)?

options.zh: 与氧分子配位，存在于血红蛋白中心
options.en: Coordinate O2 in the heme center of hemoglobin

options.zh: 构成NAD与NADP分子的核心骨架
options.en: Make up the core skeleton of NAD and NADP molecules

options.zh: 作为羧化酶辅酶，转移二氧化碳分子
options.en: Serve as the carboxylase coenzyme that carries CO2

options.zh: 与ATP络合，位于相关酶的活性中心
options.en: Complex with ATP at the active site of such enzymes

quiz.explain_zh: 课上说锌和镁"主要都是用来和ATP络合的...在一些需要利用ATP的酶的酶活中心会有这种金属离子的存在"。与氧配位的是血红素中的铁，NAD/NADP的骨架由烟酰胺、核糖和磷酸组成，转移二氧化碳的羧化酶辅酶是生物素。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture says zinc and magnesium are "mainly used to complex with ATP ... present in the active centers of enzymes that need to use ATP." It is the iron of heme that coordinates O2, NAD/NADP are built from nicotinamide, ribose and phosphate, and the carboxylase coenzyme that carries CO2 is biotin.

title_zh: 课堂延伸：巴洛沙韦与流感病毒聚合酶的夺帽结构域
title_en: Class digression: baloxavir and the influenza polymerase cap-snatching domain

points.zh: 巴洛沙韦(baloxavir marboxil)被课上称为目前全世界最强的抗流感药物之一
points.en: Baloxavir marboxil is described in lecture as one of the strongest anti-influenza drugs currently available worldwide.

points.zh: 该药物靶向流感病毒(influenza virus)RNA聚合酶(RNA polymerase)中的夺帽区(cap-snatching domain)
points.en: The drug targets the cap-snatching domain within the influenza virus RNA polymerase.

points.zh: 流感病毒是RNA病毒(RNA virus)，其转录出的mRNA必须获得帽子结构(5' cap)和poly-A尾，才能被宿主核糖体正确识别翻译
points.en: Influenza is an RNA virus, and its transcribed mRNA must acquire a 5' cap and poly-A tail to be correctly recognized and translated by the host ribosome.

points.zh: 夺帽机制：病毒聚合酶的这个功能域会把宿主mRNA的帽子结构"抢过来"，接到自己的病毒mRNA上
points.en: The cap-snatching mechanism: this functional domain of the viral polymerase "steals" the cap structure from host mRNA and attaches it to the viral mRNA.

points.zh: 图中该结构域活性口袋标注含有金属离子（锰离子Mn²⁺），用于结合ATP/核苷酸底物；镁离子(Mg²⁺)、锌离子(Zn²⁺)在类似口袋中往往能起相似作用
points.en: The active pocket of this domain is shown with a metal ion (Mn²⁺) that helps bind ATP/nucleotide substrates; Mg²⁺ and Zn²⁺ can often play similar roles in comparable pockets.

points.zh: 新冠病毒(SARS-CoV-2)的聚合酶也具有部分夺帽功能，其机制被认为更复杂
points.en: SARS-CoV-2's polymerase also has partial cap-snatching function, with a mechanism thought to be even more complex.

points.zh: 巴洛沙韦通过抑制这个夺帽结构域，阻止病毒mRNA获得帽子，从而抑制病毒蛋白的翻译
points.en: Baloxavir inhibits this cap-snatching domain, preventing viral mRNA from acquiring a cap and thereby suppressing viral protein translation.

extra.zh: 巴洛沙韦玛波酯(baloxavir marboxil, 商品名Xofluza)于2018年获美国FDA批准，通过抑制流感病毒PA蛋白的核酸内切酶(endonuclease)活性发挥作用，单次口服即可，作用机制不同于抑制神经氨酸酶(neuraminidase)的奥司他韦(oseltamivir)。
extra.en: Baloxavir marboxil (brand name Xofluza) was approved by the US FDA in 2018, working by inhibiting the endonuclease activity of the influenza PA protein; it is given as a single oral dose, with a mechanism distinct from neuraminidase inhibitors like oseltamivir.

extra.zh: 课上"吃一粒第二天就好"是口语化的强调说法，并非严谨的临床结论；实际疗效因个体、病毒株和用药时机而异，需以具体临床研究数据为准。
extra.en: The lecture's "take one pill and you're better the next day" is a colloquial emphasis, not a rigorous clinical claim; actual efficacy varies by individual, viral strain, and timing of treatment, and should be assessed against specific clinical data.

extra.zh: 冠状病毒(包括SARS-CoV-2)自身编码有加帽相关酶（如鸟苷酸转移酶guanylyltransferase、甲基转移酶methyltransferase等），其加帽/是否涉及"夺帽"的具体机制与流感病毒不同，仍是研究中的细节，课上未详细展开。
extra.en: Coronaviruses (including SARS-CoV-2) encode their own capping-related enzymes (e.g., guanylyltransferase, methyltransferase); the specific mechanism of their capping and whether it involves "cap-snatching" differs from influenza and remains an area of ongoing research not detailed in lecture.

quiz.q_zh: 课上介绍的巴洛沙韦(baloxavir)靶向流感病毒聚合酶的哪个功能区域？
quiz.q_en: Which functional region of the influenza polymerase does baloxavir target, as introduced in lecture?

options.zh: 帽子甲基转移酶区
options.en: The mRNA cap methyltransferase region

options.zh: poly-A聚合酶区
options.en: The viral poly-A polymerase region

options.zh: 夺帽内切酶结构域
options.en: The cap-snatching endonuclease domain

options.zh: RNA聚合酶催化中心
options.en: The RNA-dependent polymerase active site

quiz.explain_zh: 课上说巴洛沙韦作用在"流感病毒的聚合酶里边的这个夺帽区"，即负责切割宿主帽子的内切酶结构域。它不抑制聚合酶的催化中心，流感病毒本身也不用自己的甲基转移酶给帽子加甲基，poly-A尾则由聚合酶滑动产生而非独立的加尾酶区。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture says baloxavir acts on "the cap-snatching region inside the influenza polymerase," the endonuclease domain that cleaves the host cap. It does not block the polymerase active site; influenza does not methylate the cap with its own methyltransferase; and the poly-A tail is made by polymerase stuttering rather than by a separate tailing domain.

quiz.q_zh: 为什么流感病毒的mRNA需要"抢夺"宿主的帽子结构？
quiz.q_en: Why does influenza viral mRNA need to "steal" the host's cap structure?

options.zh: 帽子结构能帮助病毒mRNA躲避宿主的免疫识别
options.en: The cap lets viral mRNA evade the host immune sensors

options.zh: 帽子是病毒RNA聚合酶复制基因组时的必需底物
options.en: The cap is a required substrate for genome replication

options.zh: 病毒mRNA需有帽子才能被核糖体识别翻译
options.en: Viral mRNA needs a cap before the ribosome translates

options.zh: 流感病毒自身根本无法转录出自己的mRNA分子
options.en: Influenza cannot transcribe any mRNA of its own at all

quiz.explain_zh: 课上说流感病毒转录出的mRNA要"加个帽子...再加一个PolyA位才能正确的被...识别"，即被宿主核糖体识别并起始翻译。流感病毒自己能转录mRNA，只是缺加帽酶；帽子并不是免疫逃逸装置，也不是聚合酶复制基因组的底物。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture says influenza transcripts must "get a cap ... and a poly-A tail to be correctly recognized," i.e. recognized by the host ribosome for translation initiation. Influenza can transcribe its own mRNA and merely lacks a capping enzyme; the cap is not an immune-evasion device, nor a substrate for genome replication.

quiz.q_zh: 课上提到夺帽结构域活性中心结合的金属离子（图中标注）是什么？
quiz.q_en: What metal ion (labeled in the figure shown) does the lecture say is bound at the active center of the cap-snatching domain?

options.zh: 二价钙离子(Ca²⁺)
options.en: Divalent calcium (Ca²⁺)

options.zh: 二价锰离子(Mn²⁺)
options.en: Divalent manganese (Mn²⁺)

options.zh: 二价铁离子(Fe²⁺)
options.en: Divalent iron ion (Fe²⁺)

options.zh: 二价铜离子(Cu²⁺)
options.en: Divalent copper ion (Cu²⁺)

quiz.explain_zh: 课上说"这个你可以看到这个右下角它写的是锰离子"，并说镁离子、锌离子在类似口袋中往往可以起相似作用；铁、铜、钙离子都没有出现在这个内切酶口袋里。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture says "you can see it is labeled manganese ion," adding that magnesium and zinc can often play a similar role in comparable pockets; iron, copper and calcium do not appear in this endonuclease site.

title_zh: mRNA的帽子结构：m7G 与 cap-0
title_en: mRNA cap structure: m7G and cap-0

points.zh: 真核生物(eukaryote)mRNA要被核糖体(ribosome)翻译，核糖体会先校验这个mRNA有没有帽子(cap)结构
points.en: For a eukaryotic mRNA to be translated by the ribosome, the ribosome first checks whether the mRNA has a cap structure.

points.zh: 帽子结构的连接方式与正常5'→3'方向相反：末端的鸟嘌呤(guanine, G)是通过5'-5'三磷酸桥"倒接"上去的
points.en: The cap is linked in the reverse orientation of normal 5'→3' chemistry: the terminal guanine (G) is attached "backwards" via a 5'-5' triphosphate bridge.

points.zh: 该末端鸟嘌呤在第7位氮(N7位置)上带有甲基化修饰，因此称为m7G(7-methylguanosine)
points.en: This terminal guanine carries a methyl modification at the N7 position, hence it is called m7G (7-methylguanosine).

points.zh: 帽子结构通过三个磷酸基团(triphosphate bridge)连接到mRNA的第一个核苷酸（标记为N，代表任意碱基）
points.en: The cap connects to the mRNA's first nucleotide (labeled N, any base) via a triphosphate bridge.

points.zh: 完整命名为"cap-0"：0代表这是额外加在mRNA最前端的第0位修饰
points.en: The full name is "cap-0": the 0 denotes that this is an extra modification added at position 0, at the very front of the mRNA.

points.zh: 从cap之后，mRNA其余部分才是正常顺着5'→3'方向排列的碱基序列
points.en: After the cap, the rest of the mRNA follows the normal 5'→3' base sequence.

extra.zh: cap-0之外还有cap-1、cap-2等更高级修饰形式，是在mRNA第一、第二个核苷酸的2'-O位置再加甲基化修饰(2'-O-methylation)，常见于真核生物mRNA，也是部分病毒mRNA逃避天然免疫识别（如RIG-I）的修饰策略——课上未展开。
extra.en: Beyond cap-0, more advanced forms like cap-1 and cap-2 add 2'-O-methylation at the mRNA's first and second nucleotides; these are common in eukaryotic mRNA and are also used by some viral mRNAs to evade innate immune recognition (e.g., by RIG-I) — not detailed in lecture.

extra.zh: 加帽反应由三步酶促反应完成：RNA三磷酸酶(RNA triphosphatase)去掉γ-磷酸、鸟苷酸转移酶(guanylyltransferase)加上G、甲基转移酶(methyltransferase)完成m7G修饰——课上未详细展开这三步机制。
extra.en: Capping is carried out by three enzymatic steps: RNA triphosphatase removes the γ-phosphate, guanylyltransferase adds the G, and methyltransferase completes the m7G modification — this three-step mechanism was not detailed in lecture.

extra.zh: m7G帽子除了帮助核糖体识别翻译起始位点外，还能保护mRNA的5'端免受5'→3'核酸外切酶(5'→3' exonuclease)降解，是mRNA稳定性(mRNA stability)的重要保护机制之一。
extra.en: Beyond helping the ribosome recognize the translation start site, the m7G cap also protects the mRNA's 5' end from 5'→3' exonuclease degradation, serving as an important mRNA stability mechanism.

quiz.q_zh: mRNA帽子结构中，末端鸟嘌呤与其余核苷酸之间的连接方式是什么？
quiz.q_en: How is the terminal guanine of the mRNA cap connected to the rest of the nucleotides?

options.zh: 反向的3'-3'磷酸二酯键连接
options.en: A reversed 3'-3' phosphodiester bond

options.zh: 正向的5'-3'三磷酸桥连接
options.en: A forward 5'-3' triphosphate bridge

options.zh: 反向的5'-5'三磷酸桥连接
options.en: A reversed 5'-5' triphosphate bridge

options.zh: 正常的5'→3'磷酸二酯键连接
options.en: A normal 5'→3' phosphodiester bond

quiz.explain_zh: 课上说帽子的G是"反过来接了"：两个5'端通过三个磷酸相连，形成5'-5'三磷酸桥。链内其余核苷酸之间才是正常的5'→3'磷酸二酯键；帽子既不是3'-3'磷酸二酯键，也不是正向的5'-3'三磷酸桥。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture explains the cap's G is attached "backwards": two 5' ends are joined through three phosphates, forming a 5'-5' triphosphate bridge. Normal 5'→3' phosphodiester bonds link the rest of the chain; the cap is neither a 3'-3' phosphodiester bond nor a forward 5'-3' triphosphate bridge.

quiz.q_zh: "m7G"中的"7"具体指的是什么？
quiz.q_en: What does the "7" in "m7G" specifically refer to?

options.zh: mRNA上第7个核苷酸被加上帽子
options.en: The seventh nucleotide of the mRNA gets the cap

options.zh: 帽子结构中含有7个磷酸基团
options.en: The cap structure contains 7 phosphate groups

options.zh: 该修饰在转录起始后第7秒发生
options.en: The modification happens 7 seconds post-initiation

options.zh: 鸟嘌呤第7位氮上发生甲基化修饰
options.en: Methylation occurs at the N7 position of guanine

quiz.explain_zh: 课上说"在7位...有一个甲基化修饰它就叫小M"，指鸟嘌呤嘌呤环第7位氮上的甲基化。这个数字与被加帽的核苷酸序号无关，帽子里只有三个磷酸而不是七个，也与加帽发生的时间无关。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture says "at position 7 ... there's a methylation, that's called little m," meaning methylation at N7 of the guanine purine ring. The number is not the index of the capped nucleotide, the cap holds three phosphates rather than seven, and it says nothing about timing.

quiz.q_zh: 在标准命名法中，"cap-0"里的"0"代表什么含义？
quiz.q_en: In the standard nomenclature, what does the "0" in "cap-0" denote?

options.zh: 帽子加在转录本的第0号核苷酸位置上
options.en: The cap sits at nucleotide position 0 of the transcript

options.zh: 帽子后核糖2'-O位甲基化数目为0
options.en: Zero 2'-O-methyl groups on the ribose after the cap

options.zh: 帽子上鸟嘌呤N7位的甲基化数目为0
options.en: Zero methyl groups on the N7 atom of the cap's guanine

options.zh: 帽子与mRNA之间的磷酸基数目为0
options.en: Zero phosphate groups between the cap and the mRNA

quiz.explain_zh: 标准命名中，cap-0 指帽子之后的核糖2'-O位上一个甲基都没有（cap-1 有一个，cap-2 有两个）。帽子鸟嘌呤的N7位恰恰是甲基化的，帽子与mRNA之间是三磷酸桥而不是没有磷酸；课上把"0"通俗解释成"额外加在最前面的第0位"，那只是个记忆说法，并非命名的由来。
quiz.explain_en: In the standard nomenclature cap-0 means there is no 2'-O-methyl group on the ribose following the cap (cap-1 has one, cap-2 has two). The cap's guanine is precisely the position that is methylated, at N7; the cap is joined to the mRNA by a triphosphate bridge rather than by no phosphate; and describing the cap as sitting at "position 0" in front of the transcript is the informal gloss given in class, not the origin of the name.

title_zh: 闲聊博后经费机会，回到流感病毒mRNA加帽机制与抗病毒药物
title_en: Aside on a postdoc funding opportunity, then back to influenza cap-snatching and its antiviral drug

points.zh: 金属离子(通常两个Mg2+，也可以是Mn2+或Zn2+，作用相似可互相替代)作为辅因子参与聚合酶/加帽酶催化，可结合ATP或核酸。
points.en: Metal ions (typically two Mg2+, interchangeable with Mn2+ or Zn2+ giving similar function) act as cofactors in polymerase/capping-enzyme catalysis and can bind ATP or nucleic acid.

points.zh: 流感病毒是病毒(不是原核生物)，用自身RNA polymerase转录出mRNA，但病毒本身不携带加帽酶(capping enzyme)。
points.en: Influenza is a virus (not a prokaryote); it uses its own RNA polymerase to transcribe mRNA, but the virus itself carries no capping enzyme.

points.zh: 因此流感病毒挟持(cap-snatching)宿主细胞已加好帽的mRNA帽子，把它转接到自己转录出的mRNA上，使病毒mRNA能被宿主核糖体识别翻译。
points.en: So influenza performs cap-snatching: it steals the cap from an already-capped host mRNA and transfers it onto its own transcript, so the viral mRNA is recognised and translated by the host ribosome.

points.zh: 这一夺帽过程要消耗ATP。
points.en: This cap-snatching process consumes ATP.

points.zh: 讲座展示的抗流感药物结构图显示，药物专门堵住加帽相关结构域活性口袋里的两个金属离子结合位点，阻止病毒完成夺帽。
points.en: The antiviral drug structure shown blocks the two metal-ion binding sites in the capping-related domain's active pocket, preventing the virus from completing cap-snatching.

points.zh: 病毒mRNA一旦无法获得帽子，就不能被宿主核糖体识别翻译，相当于从源头阻断病毒复制；老师形容这个药「吃一颗第二天流感就好了」。
points.en: Without a cap, viral mRNA cannot be recognised and translated by host ribosomes — blocking replication at its source; the lecturer described the drug as clearing flu symptoms 'the next day after one pill'.

points.zh: (闲聊部分)老师提到一个可申请的博后/访问经费机会，笑称是「fab」学会，具体金额说法在闲聊中反复修正，并提醒对方清华背景很有竞争力，国内也有类似项目。
points.en: (Chat aside) The lecturer mentioned an applicable postdoc/visiting funding opportunity, jokingly called the 'fab' society, with the stated amount repeatedly revised mid-conversation, and noted the colleague's Tsinghua background would be competitive; similar domestic programs also exist.

extra.zh: 这个夺帽机制是分段负链RNA病毒(如流感/正粘病毒科)的特征；讲座描述的药物机制(封堵活性口袋内双金属离子中心)最贴近的是抑制病毒polymerase PA亚基的核酸内切酶活性，已上市的巴洛沙韦(baloxavir marboxil)正是这一类药物，而非独立的宿主型加帽酶抑制剂。
extra.en: This cap-snatching mechanism is characteristic of segmented negative-strand RNA viruses (e.g. influenza/Orthomyxoviridae). The drug mechanism described (blocking a two-metal-ion active pocket) most closely matches inhibition of the PA endonuclease subunit of the viral polymerase — the approved drug baloxavir marboxil works this way — rather than blocking a separate host-type capping enzyme.

extra.zh: 「病毒没有加帽酶」只对RNA病毒(如流感)成立，不代表所有病毒都缺乏此能力；某些DNA病毒(如痘病毒vaccinia)自身携带完整的加帽酶系统。
extra.en: 'The virus has no capping enzyme' is true for RNA viruses like influenza, but not universal — some DNA viruses (e.g. vaccinia/poxvirus) carry a complete capping enzyme system of their own.

extra.zh: 闲聊中提到的具体经费金额(一天30-100欧或一个月2000欧)是行政性闲聊内容，非考试知识点，不建议记忆任何具体数字。
extra.en: The specific funding figures mentioned in the chat aside (30-100 euros/day or 2000 euros/month) are administrative chit-chat, not exam content — no specific number should be memorised.

extra.zh: 双金属离子催化(two-metal-ion catalysis)是聚合酶、核酸酶、磷酸转移酶中反复出现的通用催化策略，不是加帽酶独有的机制，值得作为一个跨酶类的共性考点记住。
extra.en: Two-metal-ion catalysis is a recurring general strategy across polymerases, nucleases, and phosphotransferases — not unique to capping enzymes — worth remembering as a cross-enzyme-class exam point.

quiz.q_zh: 流感病毒的mRNA获得5' cap的方式是?
quiz.q_en: How does influenza viral mRNA acquire its 5' cap?

options.zh: 病毒借助宿主DNA聚合酶完成加帽反应
options.en: The virus uses host DNA polymerase to add the cap

options.zh: 病毒自带加帽酶，独立完成整个加帽反应
options.en: The virus has its own capping enzyme for the job

options.zh: 病毒切取宿主mRNA上已有的帽子结构
options.en: The virus cuts the ready-made cap off host mRNA

options.zh: 病毒mRNA在核糖体上一边翻译一边加帽
options.en: Viral mRNA is capped while translated on ribosomes

quiz.explain_zh: 流感病毒没有自己的加帽酶，靠病毒聚合酶上的内切酶结构域"切取"宿主mRNA上已有的帽子，转接到自己的转录产物上。加帽发生在细胞核内的转录起始阶段，不是在核糖体上边翻译边完成；宿主DNA聚合酶与加帽也毫无关系。
quiz.explain_en: Influenza has no capping enzyme of its own; an endonuclease domain on the viral polymerase cuts the ready-made cap off a host mRNA and transfers it onto the viral transcript. Capping happens at transcription initiation in the nucleus, not on the ribosome during translation, and host DNA polymerase has nothing to do with it.

quiz.q_zh: 讲座中描述的抗流感药物的作用机制是?
quiz.q_en: What is the mechanism of the antiviral drug described in the lecture?

options.zh: 竞争性抑制病毒衣壳蛋白的组装过程
options.en: Competitively blocks viral capsid protein assembly

options.zh: 阻断宿主核糖体与病毒mRNA的结合
options.en: Blocks host ribosome binding to the viral mRNA

options.zh: 抑制病毒RNA聚合酶的链延伸活性
options.en: Blocks chain elongation by the viral RNA polymerase

options.zh: 堵住夺帽结构域的两个金属离子位点
options.en: Plugs the two metal-ion sites of the cap domain

quiz.explain_zh: 药物结构图显示它牢牢堵住夺帽结构域口袋中的两个金属离子结合位点，使内切酶无法切下宿主帽子。它并不作用于聚合酶的链延伸活性，也不干扰衣壳组装或核糖体与mRNA的结合。
quiz.explain_en: The structure shown has the drug plugging the two metal-ion sites in the cap-snatching pocket, so the endonuclease cannot cut the host cap. It does not act on polymerase elongation, nor on capsid assembly, nor on ribosome binding to the mRNA.

quiz.q_zh: 讲座中提到，除Mg2+外，起相似作用的金属离子还包括?
quiz.q_en: Besides Mg2+, which other metal ions were mentioned as playing a similar role?

options.zh: Ni2+或Ca2+
options.en: Ni2+ or Ca2+

options.zh: Ca2+或Fe2+
options.en: Ca2+ or Fe2+

options.zh: Mn2+或Zn2+
options.en: Mn2+ or Zn2+

options.zh: Cu2+或Co2+
options.en: Cu2+ or Co2+

quiz.explain_zh: 老师说这两个金属离子位点上，Mg2+、Mn2+或Zn2+基本都能起到相似的结合ATP/核酸的作用。Ca2+、Fe2+、Cu2+、Co2+、Ni2+并不在课上提到的范围内。
quiz.explain_en: The lecturer said Mg2+, Mn2+, or Zn2+ can all play a similar role in binding ATP/nucleic acid at these two sites. Ca2+, Fe2+, Cu2+, Co2+ and Ni2+ were not among the ions mentioned.

title_zh: 核酸历史背景：Griffith/Avery转化实验；核酸分布与核糖体沉降系数
title_en: Nucleic acid history: the Griffith/Avery transformation experiment; nucleic acid distribution and ribosome sedimentation coefficients

points.zh: 老师结束题外话后正式进入「核酸」章节，提到核酸的研究方法、提取分离方法会在后续做polymerase实验时用到。
points.en: After the digression, the lecturer formally opens the 'nucleic acids' chapter, noting that nucleic acid research and extraction/purification methods will matter later for polymerase work.

points.zh: 核酸历史背景中重要的实验是Griffith和Avery的细菌转化实验(transformation experiment)。
points.en: A key historical experiment in nucleic acid research is the Griffith/Avery bacterial transformation experiment.

points.zh: 实验用两种肺炎链球菌：菌落光滑型(Smooth，S型)有毒致死；菌落粗糙型(Rough，R型)无毒，小鼠可存活。
points.en: The experiment used two strains of pneumococcus: smooth-colony (S-type), virulent and lethal; rough-colony (R-type), avirulent, mice survive it.

points.zh: 将S型高温加热杀死(细菌本身死亡，但其核酸未被破坏)，把死S型的核酸与活R型混合后注入小鼠，结果小鼠死亡。
points.en: Heat-killed S-type (the bacterium dies, but its nucleic acid is not destroyed) was mixed with live R-type and injected into mice, and the mice died.

points.zh: 该实验证明DNA(核酸)才是遗传物质，而不是当时普遍认为的蛋白质。
points.en: The experiment demonstrated that DNA (nucleic acid), not protein as was then commonly believed, is the genetic material.

points.zh: 核酸在生物体内广泛分布，DNA和RNA在不同部位的具体分类命名有差异，但这些细分类不是学习重点。
points.en: Nucleic acids are widely distributed in organisms; DNA and RNA have somewhat different subclassification naming by location, but these fine subcategories are not the focus.

points.zh: 引出核糖体的质量分类：原核生物核糖体为70S，真核生物核糖体为80S。
points.en: This leads to ribosome size classification: prokaryotic ribosomes are 70S, eukaryotic ribosomes are 80S.

points.zh: 「S」是沉降系数(sedimentation coefficient)，来自超速离心(ultracentrifugation)，是此前蛋白质鉴定章节讲过的分子量表征单位，单位是秒分之一(Svedberg)；因核糖体分子量太大，分子生物学中常用S值区分核糖体大小。
points.en: 'S' is the sedimentation coefficient from ultracentrifugation, the same molecular-weight characterisation unit covered earlier in the protein identification chapter, in units of per-second (Svedberg); because ribosomes are so large, S values are the standard way to distinguish ribosome sizes in molecular biology.

extra.zh: Griffith(1928)最先发现「转化因子」现象，Avery-MacLeod-McCarty(1944)才通过分离纯化确认转化因子就是DNA；讲座把两人合并叙述，严格来说是两组不同年份的实验，构成完整的历史链条。
extra.en: Griffith (1928) first observed the 'transforming principle'; Avery-MacLeod-McCarty (1944) later purified and confirmed it was DNA. The lecture merges the two into one narrative, but strictly they are two separate experiments years apart forming a complete historical chain.

extra.zh: 沉降系数S不是线性可加的(70S核糖体由50S+30S亚基组成，不是50+30=80)，因为S值同时取决于分子质量、形状和摩擦系数，合并后构象改变导致数值不能简单相加。
extra.en: Sedimentation coefficients are not linearly additive (the 70S ribosome is made of a 50S and a 30S subunit, not 50+30=80), because S depends on mass, shape, and frictional coefficient together, and the combined particle's conformation changes.

extra.zh: Avery实验建立了「核酸是遗传物质」的证据，但真正让科学界普遍接受这一结论的是1952年Hershey-Chase的噬菌体标记实验(35S标记蛋白质外壳，32P标记DNA)，可作为同类实验的延伸对比。
extra.en: Avery's experiment established the evidence that nucleic acid is the genetic material, but it was the 1952 Hershey-Chase bacteriophage blender experiment (35S-labeled protein coat, 32P-labeled DNA) that won broad scientific acceptance — a useful comparison experiment.

extra.zh: 沉降系数S的公式(Svedberg equation)与分子量、形状(摩擦系数)、溶液密度都相关，并非分子量的直接线性度量，这正是70S核糖体是50S+30S而非简单相加的化学原因。
extra.en: The Svedberg equation relates S to molecular weight, shape (frictional coefficient), and solution density — it is not a direct linear measure of molecular weight, which is exactly why a 70S ribosome is a 50S+30S combination rather than a simple sum.

quiz.q_zh: Griffith/Avery转化实验的关键结论是?
quiz.q_en: What was the key conclusion of the Griffith/Avery transformation experiment?

options.zh: 糖类是遗传物质
options.en: Sugar is the genetic material

options.zh: 蛋白质是遗传物质
options.en: Protein is the genetic material

options.zh: DNA是遗传物质
options.en: DNA is the genetic material

options.zh: 脂质是遗传物质
options.en: Lipid is the genetic material

quiz.explain_zh: 热死S型菌的提取物能把无毒R型转化为致死型；Avery用蛋白酶、脂酶和DNA酶分别处理，只有DNA酶处理后转化消失，说明转化因子是DNA，而不是蛋白质、脂质或糖类。
quiz.explain_en: Extract from heat-killed S-type transformed avirulent R-type into a lethal form; Avery treated the extract with protease, lipase and DNase, and only DNase abolished transformation, showing the transforming principle is DNA rather than protein, lipid or sugar.

quiz.q_zh: 实验中，与活R型细菌混合后会导致小鼠死亡的是哪种处理过的S型细菌?
quiz.q_en: Which treated form of S-type bacteria, when mixed with live R-type, caused the mice to die?

options.zh: 加热杀死后再用DNA酶处理的S型细菌
options.en: Heat-killed S-type bacteria then digested with DNase

options.zh: 经高温加热杀死但未再处理的S型细菌
options.en: Heat-killed S-type bacteria with no further treatment

options.zh: 只含荚膜多糖成分的S型细菌提取物
options.en: A preparation of the S-type capsule polysaccharide alone

options.zh: 经紫外照射已把DNA彻底降解的S型细菌
options.en: S-type bacteria whose DNA has been fully degraded by UV

quiz.explain_zh: 关键操作是把S型高温加热杀死后直接与活R型混合：菌体死亡，但其中的核酸仍然完整，能把R型转化成有荚膜的S型，小鼠因而死亡。加热后再用DNA酶消化，或用紫外把DNA彻底降解，转化能力都随之消失；只含荚膜多糖的制剂本身不带遗传物质，同样不能转化。
quiz.explain_en: The key manipulation was heat-killing the S-type and mixing it straight into live R-type: the cells die but their nucleic acid stays intact and still converts R-type into the encapsulated S form, killing the mice. Digesting that heat-killed material with DNase, or degrading its DNA with UV, abolishes the transforming activity, and a preparation of capsule polysaccharide alone carries no genetic material and cannot transform either.

quiz.q_zh: 沉降系数「S」的实验来源是?
quiz.q_en: What experimental technique is the sedimentation coefficient 'S' derived from?

options.zh: 超速离心中的沉降速率
options.en: Sedimentation rate in an ultracentrifuge

options.zh: 质谱中测得的质荷比
options.en: Mass-to-charge ratio from mass spectrometry

options.zh: 层析柱上的保留时间
options.en: Retention time on a chromatography column

options.zh: 凝胶电泳中的相对迁移率
options.en: Relative migration in gel electrophoresis

quiz.explain_zh: S是Svedberg沉降系数，来自超速离心中颗粒的沉降速率，是此前蛋白质鉴定章节讲过的分子量表征方法。凝胶电泳的迁移率、质谱的质荷比、层析柱的保留时间基于完全不同的分离原理，都不给出沉降系数。
quiz.explain_en: S is the Svedberg sedimentation coefficient, taken from how fast a particle sediments in an ultracentrifuge — the same characterisation method covered in the earlier protein identification chapter. Migration in gel electrophoresis, mass-to-charge ratio in mass spectrometry and retention time on a chromatography column rest on quite different separation principles and yield no sedimentation coefficient.

title_zh: 原核/真核核糖体亚基与16S rRNA细菌鉴定；染色质折叠的起点
title_en: Prokaryotic/eukaryotic ribosome subunits, 16S rRNA bacterial identification, and the start of chromatin folding

points.zh: 原核生物核糖体(70S)分为大亚基50S和小亚基30S。
points.en: The prokaryotic 70S ribosome consists of a large 50S subunit and a small 30S subunit.

points.zh: 30S小亚基中含有16S rRNA，其序列在不同细菌间高度保守但具种特异性差异(如大肠杆菌与金黄色葡萄球菌的16S rRNA序列不同)，因此PCR扩增16S rRNA可用于细菌菌种鉴定。
points.en: The 30S subunit contains 16S rRNA, highly conserved across bacteria yet species-specific (e.g. E. coli vs. Staphylococcus aureus 16S rRNA differ), so PCR amplification of 16S rRNA is used for bacterial species identification.

points.zh: 真核生物核糖体为80S，分为大亚基60S和小亚基40S；大亚基由三部分组成，具体细节课上略过未展开。
points.en: The eukaryotic ribosome is 80S, made of a 60S large subunit and a 40S small subunit; the large subunit has three components, details skipped in the lecture.

points.zh: 真核生物染色体呈超高度折叠/压缩状态。
points.en: Eukaryotic chromosomes exist in a highly folded, highly compacted state.

points.zh: 折叠第一步：线状双链DNA与组蛋白(histone)结合；组蛋白富含带正电荷的氨基酸，与DNA磷酸骨架上的负电荷直接形成盐桥(salt bridge)。
points.en: The first folding step: linear double-stranded DNA binds histones; histones are rich in positively charged amino acids that form salt bridges directly with the negatively charged DNA phosphate backbone.

points.zh: DNA与组蛋白结合形成核小体(nucleosome)。
points.en: DNA bound to histones forms the nucleosome.

extra.zh: 一个核小体核心颗粒由组蛋白八聚体(H2A、H2B、H3、H4各两份)缠绕约147 bp DNA构成，课上未给出具体碱基数，可作为补充记忆点。
extra.en: A nucleosome core particle consists of a histone octamer (two copies each of H2A, H2B, H3, H4) wrapped by about 147 bp of DNA — a specific number the lecture did not give, worth adding.

extra.zh: 16S rRNA测序是现代细菌分类与宏基因组学(metagenomics)物种鉴定的金标准，因其序列中既有高度保守区(设计通用引物)又有可变区(区分菌种)。
extra.en: 16S rRNA sequencing is the gold standard for modern bacterial classification and metagenomic species identification, because it has both highly conserved regions (for universal primers) and variable regions (for species discrimination).

extra.zh: 真核细胞质核糖体是80S型，但线粒体和叶绿体核糖体因内共生起源(endosymbiosis)更接近原核的70S型，不要与细胞质中的80S真核核糖体混淆。
extra.en: The eukaryotic cytoplasmic ribosome is 80S, but mitochondrial and chloroplast ribosomes, due to their endosymbiotic origin, are closer to the prokaryotic 70S type — do not confuse the two within the same eukaryotic cell.

quiz.q_zh: 用于细菌菌种鉴定PCR的常用靶标是?
quiz.q_en: Which target is commonly used for bacterial species-identification PCR?

options.zh: 16S rRNA
options.en: 16S rRNA

options.zh: 28S rRNA
options.en: 28S rRNA

options.zh: 5S rRNA
options.en: 5S rRNA

options.zh: 18S rRNA
options.en: 18S rRNA

quiz.explain_zh: 16S rRNA位于原核30S小亚基，在不同细菌间保守但有种间差异，是PCR鉴定细菌的常用靶标。18S和28S rRNA属于真核核糖体，5S rRNA太短、信息量不足以区分菌种。
quiz.explain_en: 16S rRNA sits in the prokaryotic 30S subunit, conserved yet species-specific, making it the standard PCR target for bacterial identification. 18S and 28S rRNA belong to eukaryotic ribosomes, and 5S rRNA is too short to carry enough information to separate species.

quiz.q_zh: 原核生物核糖体小亚基的沉降系数是?
quiz.q_en: What is the sedimentation coefficient of the prokaryotic ribosome's small subunit?
quiz.explain_zh: 原核70S核糖体由大亚基50S和小亚基30S组成，30S含16S rRNA；40S和60S分别是真核80S核糖体的小、大亚基，50S是原核的大亚基。
quiz.explain_en: The prokaryotic 70S ribosome consists of a 50S large subunit and a 30S small subunit, and the 30S contains 16S rRNA. The 40S and 60S values are the small and large subunits of the eukaryotic 80S ribosome, while 50S is the prokaryotic large subunit.

quiz.q_zh: 组蛋白与DNA结合形成核小体，依赖的相互作用主要是?
quiz.q_en: What interaction mainly holds histones and DNA together in a nucleosome?

options.zh: 组蛋白疏水侧链与DNA碱基之间的疏水作用
options.en: Hydrophobic contact between histone side chains and DNA bases

options.zh: 组蛋白正电荷残基与DNA磷酸负电荷间的盐桥
options.en: Salt bridges between positive histone residues and DNA phosphates

options.zh: 组蛋白半胱氨酸与DNA之间的共价二硫键交联
options.en: Covalent disulfide cross-links between histone cysteines and DNA

options.zh: 组蛋白芳香环与DNA碱基之间的范德华堆积作用
options.en: Van der Waals stacking of histone aromatic rings onto the DNA bases

quiz.explain_zh: 组蛋白富含赖氨酸、精氨酸这类带正电荷的残基，直接与DNA磷酸骨架的负电荷形成盐桥，这是核小体结合的基础。DNA上没有巯基，与半胱氨酸不可能形成共价二硫键；疏水作用和范德华堆积主要发生在双螺旋内部相邻碱基之间，不是把组蛋白拉住DNA的主要力量。
quiz.explain_en: Histones are rich in positively charged residues such as lysine and arginine, which form salt bridges directly with the negatively charged DNA phosphate backbone — the basis of nucleosome binding. DNA carries no thiol group, so a covalent disulfide bond to cysteine is impossible, and hydrophobic contact and van der Waals stacking act mainly between neighbouring bases inside the helix rather than holding histone onto DNA.

title_zh: 超螺旋到染色体；核酸=核苷酸的定义与「苷」；核苷酸三组分与磷酸结构
title_en: Supercoiling to the chromosome; nucleic acid = nucleotide and the term 'glycoside'; the three parts of a nucleotide and phosphate structure

points.zh: 核小体进一步缠绕形成超螺旋(supercoil)，超螺旋本身又可以再发生扭曲，最终堆积成高度致密的染色体。
points.en: Nucleosomes further coil into a supercoil, which can itself twist further, ultimately packing into a highly compact chromosome.

points.zh: 核酸(nucleic acid)＝核苷酸(nucleotide)的聚合物，「核酸」等于「核苷酸」；「苷」指糖苷键连接的糖基团(如核糖)。
points.en: Nucleic acid = a polymer of nucleotides; 'nucleic acid' is equated with 'nucleotide' here; the character 'gan/glycoside' refers to a sugar group linked by a glycosidic bond (e.g. ribose).

points.zh: 「苷」单独出现常指糖连接了另一个基团，如中草药里的「某某苷」、生化里的「糖苷键」(glycosidic bond)。
points.en: 'Glycoside' alone typically means a sugar linked to another group, as in the 'glycosides' of herbal medicine or the 'glycosidic bond' of biochemistry.

points.zh: 「核苷」(nucleoside)＝碱基+糖，不含磷酸；「核苷酸」(nucleotide)＝碱基+糖+磷酸。碱基不可能只与磷酸相连而不经过糖。
points.en: 'Nucleoside' = base + sugar, no phosphate; 'nucleotide' = base + sugar + phosphate. A base can never be linked directly to phosphate without the sugar.

points.zh: 核苷酸由三部分组成：磷酸(phosphate)、糖(核糖/脱氧核糖)、含氮碱基(base)。
points.en: A nucleotide has three parts: phosphate, sugar (ribose/deoxyribose), and a nitrogenous base.

points.zh: 磷酸基团核心结构是PO4：一个中心磷原子，两个氧以双键(P=O)相连，一个OH，其余电荷/质子化状态可变，因为磷酸本身是一种缓冲对，可带H+也可不带。
points.en: The core phosphate group is PO4: a central phosphorus with two oxygens double-bonded (P=O) and one OH; the remaining charge/protonation state is variable because phosphate itself behaves as a buffer pair, protonated or not.

extra.zh: 核苷(nucleoside)与核苷酸(nucleotide)一字之差但化学组成不同——前者只有「糖+碱基」，后者多了磷酸基团；做题时要特别注意题干是否提到「磷酸化」。
extra.en: Nucleoside and nucleotide differ by one character in Chinese but differ chemically: the former is 'sugar + base', the latter adds a phosphate group — watch whether a question mentions phosphorylation.

extra.zh: 从裸露DNA到中期染色体，经过核小体→超螺旋等多级折叠，长度压缩可达约万倍量级，课上未给出具体压缩倍数。
extra.en: From naked DNA to a metaphase chromosome, through nucleosome → supercoil and further levels of folding, the length compaction reaches roughly the ten-thousand-fold order of magnitude — a figure the lecture did not give.

extra.zh: 染色质多级折叠传统上还包括一个中间层级「30nm纤维」(由核小体进一步螺旋化形成)，课上直接从核小体跳到超螺旋，未逐级展开。
extra.en: Classic chromatin folding also includes an intermediate '30 nm fiber' level (nucleosomes coiled further); the lecture jumped straight from nucleosome to supercoil without covering this intermediate step.

quiz.q_zh: 「核苷」与「核苷酸」的区别在于?
quiz.q_en: What is the difference between a nucleoside and a nucleotide?

options.zh: 核苷含碱基和糖，核苷酸再多一个磷酸基团
options.en: A nucleoside is base plus sugar, a nucleotide adds one phosphate group

options.zh: 两者的化学组成完全相同，只是叫法不同
options.en: The two have exactly the same composition, only the names differ

options.zh: 核苷是双链形式，核苷酸只有单链形式
options.en: A nucleoside is double-stranded, a nucleotide is single-stranded

options.zh: 核苷含碱基和磷酸，核苷酸只含碱基和糖
options.en: A nucleoside is base plus phosphate, a nucleotide base plus sugar

quiz.explain_zh: 核苷＝碱基+糖，核苷酸是在核苷上再连一个磷酸。把磷酸算给核苷、把糖算给核苷酸正好说反了；两者的组成并不相同，因为差一个磷酸；单链还是双链是整条核酸分子的性质，与这两个名词无关。
quiz.explain_en: Nucleoside = base + sugar; a nucleotide is a nucleoside with one phosphate added. Assigning the phosphate to the nucleoside and the sugar to the nucleotide reverses the two; their compositions are not identical, since they differ by exactly one phosphate; and strandedness is a property of the whole nucleic acid molecule, unrelated to either term.

quiz.q_zh: 组成核苷酸的三个基本组分是?
quiz.q_en: What are the three basic components of a nucleotide?

options.zh: 磷酸、戊糖和一个氨基酸
options.en: Phosphate, pentose sugar, and an amino acid

options.zh: 磷酸、戊糖、含氮碱基
options.en: Phosphate, pentose sugar, nitrogenous base

options.zh: 磷酸、脂肪酸、含氮碱基
options.en: Phosphate, fatty acid, nitrogenous base

options.zh: 戊糖、氨基酸、含氮碱基
options.en: Pentose sugar, amino acid, nitrogenous base

quiz.explain_zh: 核苷酸由磷酸、戊糖(核糖或脱氧核糖)和含氮碱基三部分组成。脂肪酸是脂类的构件，氨基酸是蛋白质的构件，两者都不出现在核苷酸里，含氮碱基也不能被它们替代。
quiz.explain_en: A nucleotide is built from phosphate, a pentose sugar (ribose or deoxyribose) and a nitrogenous base. Fatty acids are the building blocks of lipids and amino acids those of proteins; neither appears in a nucleotide, and neither can stand in for the nitrogenous base.

quiz.q_zh: DNA从核小体到染色体的进一步压缩主要依赖于?
quiz.q_en: What drives the further compaction of DNA from nucleosomes to a chromosome?

options.zh: 核小体纤维扭成超螺旋后层层堆积
options.en: The nucleosome fibre twists into supercoils packed in layers

options.zh: 碱基与糖之间的糖苷键不断地重排
options.en: Glycosidic bonds between base and sugar rearrange repeatedly

options.zh: 磷酸二酯键反复断裂再重新连接
options.en: Phosphodiester bonds are repeatedly broken and re-ligated

options.zh: 组蛋白之间形成二硫键交联成束
options.en: Disulfide cross-links between histones bundle the fibres up

quiz.explain_zh: 串成念珠状的核小体纤维进一步扭曲成超螺旋，超螺旋再层层堆积，形成致密的染色体。压缩过程不改变共价结构：糖苷键和磷酸二酯键的重排、断裂重连都属于化学结构改变；组蛋白之间的二硫键交联也不是染色质压缩的方式。
quiz.explain_en: The beads-on-a-string nucleosome fibre twists further into supercoils, which stack in successive layers to give the compact chromosome. Compaction leaves the covalent structure untouched: rearranging glycosidic bonds or breaking and re-ligating phosphodiester bonds would alter chemical structure, and disulfide cross-linking between histones is not how chromatin condenses.

title_zh: 核糖碳原子编号系统与嘧啶碳原子编号
title_en: Ribose carbon numbering and pyrimidine ring carbon numbering

points.zh: 核苷酸中糖的碳原子编号规则：从形成糖苷键(与碱基相连)的碳开始命名为1'(一撇)，所有核糖编号都带撇号以区别于碱基的编号。
points.en: Sugar carbon numbering in a nucleotide: numbering starts from the carbon that forms the glycosidic bond (to the base), called 1'; all ribose carbons carry a prime to distinguish them from base numbering.

points.zh: 核糖上有两个重要羟基：2'-OH和3'-OH，老师强调这两个羟基本节课会反复提到。
points.en: Ribose has two important hydroxyls: 2'-OH and 3'-OH; the lecturer emphasised these two hydroxyls would come up repeatedly in this session.

points.zh: 4'位在糖环上，5'位在环平面之外向上延伸，5'位连接第一个磷酸形成磷酸键(5'端)。
points.en: The 4' carbon is on the sugar ring; the 5' carbon extends above the ring plane and carries the first phosphate, forming the 5' end.

points.zh: 另一端的磷酸键形成在3'位(3'端)，所以核酸链方向命名为「从5'端到3'端」。
points.en: The other phosphate linkage forms at the 3' position (3' end), so nucleic acid strand direction is named 'from the 5' end to the 3' end'.

points.zh: 碱基上的原子编号不带撇号，直接用阿拉伯数字1、2、3…命名，以区分糖的编号。
points.en: Atoms on the base are numbered without a prime, using plain digits 1, 2, 3…, to distinguish them from sugar numbering.

points.zh: 嘧啶(pyrimidine)碳骨架为6元环，编号从形成糖苷键的氮开始记为1位，按有机化学惯例(让非碳原子的编号最小)沿环走一圈编号。
points.en: The pyrimidine ring is a 6-membered ring; numbering starts at the nitrogen forming the glycosidic bond, called position 1, following the organic-chemistry convention of giving non-carbon atoms the lowest possible numbers around the ring.

points.zh: 三种嘧啶(胞嘧啶C、胸腺嘧啶T、尿嘧啶U)中：2位为羰基(C=O)，3位为氮，4位有不同取代基，5位胸腺嘧啶特有甲基取代，6位通常无取代。
points.en: Among the three pyrimidines (cytosine C, thymine T, uracil U): position 2 is a carbonyl (C=O), position 3 is a nitrogen, position 4 carries different substituents, position 5 has thymine's characteristic methyl group, and position 6 is generally unsubstituted.

extra.zh: DNA与RNA核糖的关键区别正是2'位：DNA(脱氧核糖)在2'位没有羟基(只有H)，RNA核糖2'位有羟基，这个2'-OH使RNA更易水解，也是逆转录酶/RNA酶反应机制的关键。
extra.en: The key difference between DNA and RNA sugars is the 2' position: DNA (deoxyribose) has no 2'-OH (just H), while RNA ribose has a 2'-OH — this hydroxyl makes RNA more hydrolysis-prone and is central to reverse transcriptase/RNase mechanisms.

extra.zh: 5'→3'方向不仅是命名习惯，也是DNA/RNA聚合酶合成新链的唯一方向(聚合酶只能5'→3'延伸)，这是复制、转录机制的基础。
extra.en: The 5'→3' direction is not just a naming convention — it is also the only direction in which DNA/RNA polymerases can synthesise new strand (extension is always 5'→3'), the basis of replication and transcription mechanisms.

extra.zh: 嘧啶编号中「5位甲基」是胸腺嘧啶(T)特有(5-甲基尿嘧啶即T的结构本质)，尿嘧啶(U)本身5位无取代；这也是DNA(用T)与RNA(用U)碱基组成差异的化学根源之一。
extra.en: The '5-methyl' substitution is characteristic of thymine (T) — chemically, T is 5-methyluracil — while uracil (U) itself has no substituent at position 5; this is one chemical root of the T-vs-U difference between DNA and RNA.

quiz.q_zh: 核酸链方向命名「从5'端到3'端」中，5'和3'具体指的是?
quiz.q_en: In the naming convention '5' end to 3' end', what do the 5' and 3' actually refer to?

options.zh: 碱基环本身各个原子的编号方式
options.en: The numbering scheme of atoms within the base ring

options.zh: 磷酸连接在核糖上的碳原子编号
options.en: The ribose carbon position carrying the phosphate

options.zh: 碱基与糖之间糖苷键的键长数值
options.en: The numerical bond length of the glycosidic bond

options.zh: 双螺旋在三维空间中的旋转方向
options.en: The direction of twist of the double helix in space

quiz.explain_zh: 5'和3'指核糖上连接磷酸的碳原子编号：5'端带着磷酸基团，3'端是链末端的羟基位置，撇号正是为了与碱基编号区分。碱基环上的原子用不带撇号的另一套编号方式；糖苷键的键长只是一个键参数，双螺旋的旋转方向是构象性质，都不用来命名链的方向。
quiz.explain_en: The 5' and 3' labels are ribose carbon positions: the 5' end carries a phosphate group and the 3' end is the terminal hydroxyl, and the prime marks exist precisely to separate them from base numbering. Atoms in the base ring use their own unprimed scheme, while glycosidic bond length is only a bond parameter and helical twist a conformational property — neither names strand direction.

quiz.q_zh: DNA(脱氧核糖)与RNA(核糖)在化学结构上的关键区别是?
quiz.q_en: What is the key chemical structural difference between DNA (deoxyribose) and RNA (ribose)?

options.zh: RNA在2'位有羟基，DNA只有氢
options.en: RNA has a hydroxyl at 2'; DNA has only hydrogen

options.zh: DNA在4'位多一个磷酸而RNA没有
options.en: DNA has an extra phosphate at 4' where RNA has none

options.zh: RNA在5'位缺羟基，DNA有羟基
options.en: RNA lacks the hydroxyl at 5' that DNA carries

options.zh: DNA在1'位多一个羟基而RNA没有
options.en: DNA has an extra hydroxyl at 1' where RNA has none

quiz.explain_zh: RNA的核糖在2'位带羟基，DNA的脱氧核糖在2'位只有氢，这正是「脱氧」二字的来源。1'位连碱基、4'位在糖环骨架上、5'位连磷酸，这三处两种糖完全相同，也不存在4'位额外的磷酸。
quiz.explain_en: RNA's ribose carries a hydroxyl at 2' while DNA's deoxyribose has only hydrogen there — exactly what 'deoxy' names. The 1' carbon bonds the base, 4' lies in the sugar ring and 5' carries the phosphate; at all three the two sugars are identical, and no extra phosphate sits at 4'.

quiz.q_zh: 胸腺嘧啶(T)相比尿嘧啶(U)在结构上的差异是?
quiz.q_en: How does thymine (T) differ structurally from uracil (U)?

options.zh: T在3位多一个羰基
options.en: T has an extra carbonyl at position 3

options.zh: T在6位多一个羟基
options.en: T has an extra hydroxyl at position 6

options.zh: T在1位多一个甲基
options.en: T has an extra methyl at position 1

options.zh: T在5位多一个甲基基团
options.en: T has an extra methyl group at position 5

quiz.explain_zh: 胸腺嘧啶是5位带甲基取代的尿嘧啶，即5-甲基尿嘧啶。1位是连糖的氮原子，3位的氮和2、4位的羰基两者都有，6位在两者中都是未取代的碳。
quiz.explain_en: Thymine is uracil with a methyl substituent at position 5 — i.e. 5-methyluracil. Position 1 is the nitrogen bonded to the sugar, the ring nitrogen at 3 and the carbonyls at 2 and 4 are shared by both bases, and position 6 is an unsubstituted carbon in each.

title_zh: 嘌呤编号与m7G、甲基化位置规律、假尿嘧啶(含自我纠正)、常见核苷酸形式与cAMP
title_en: Purine numbering and m7G, methylation-site patterns, pseudouridine (with a self-correction), common nucleotide forms, and cAMP

points.zh: 嘌呤(purine)碳原子编号规则较复杂：虽然与核糖相连的位置在环上某处，但编号习惯从左上角的碳开始(遵循有机化学让两个环上碳原子序号都最小的惯例)，先转一圈编号1-6，再从上方碳开始反方向编号7-9。
points.en: Purine ring numbering is more complex: although the ribose attaches at a fixed ring position, numbering by convention starts at the upper-left carbon (organic chemistry convention of keeping both rings' carbon numbers lowest), circling 1-6 first, then numbering 7-9 in the reverse direction starting from the top carbon.

points.zh: 腺嘌呤(A)与鸟嘌呤(G)化学结构有细微差异。
points.en: Adenine (A) and guanine (G) differ slightly in chemical structure.

points.zh: m7G(7位甲基化的鸟嘌呤)就是mRNA 5' cap结构中的「帽子」分子。
points.en: m7G (guanine methylated at position 7) is the 'cap' molecule of the mRNA 5' cap structure.

points.zh: 甲基化修饰的常见位置有规律：嘌呤(A、G)容易在7位发生甲基化，嘧啶容易在5位发生甲基化；DNA和RNA都存在甲基化修饰。
points.en: Methylation sites follow a pattern: purines (A, G) are commonly methylated at position 7, pyrimidines at position 5; both DNA and RNA carry methylation modifications.

points.zh: 常见核苷酸的两种主要形式：一种是ATP/ADP型，即核苷酸左侧带有磷酸基团(单磷酸/二磷酸/三磷酸链)，这是生物体内最常见形式。
points.en: Two main forms of common nucleotides: one is the ATP/ADP type, with a chain of phosphate groups (mono-/di-/triphosphate) attached, the most common form in the body.

points.zh: ATP中β位和γ位的磷酸键都是高能磷酸键(high-energy phosphate bond)，但生物体内实际最常利用的是γ位高能磷酸键，β位高能磷酸键很少被直接利用。
points.en: In ATP, both the β and γ phosphate bonds are high-energy bonds, but the body actually mostly uses the γ-position bond; the β-position bond is rarely used directly.

points.zh: 另一种常见核苷酸形式是环核苷酸(cyclic nucleotide)，如cAMP：磷酸基团除了在5'位正常连接外，还与3'位的氧形成额外的共价键，形成环状结构，常作为第二信使(second messenger)参与细胞内信号级联传递。
points.en: The other common nucleotide form is the cyclic nucleotide, such as cAMP: besides the normal 5' phosphate link, an extra covalent bond forms to the 3' oxygen, creating a ring; it commonly acts as a second messenger in intracellular signalling cascades.

points.zh: 老师中途自我纠正(约00:40:17)：此前的说法把「糖苷键连接位置」与「甲基化」搞混了——他澄清假尿嘧啶(pseudouridine, Ψ)是由糖苷键连接位置改变造成的，与甲基化无关，是一种独立的修饰类型。
points.en: The lecturer self-corrected mid-lecture (around 00:40:17): an earlier statement had confused 'where the glycosidic bond forms' with 'methylation' — he clarified that pseudouridine (Ψ) results from a change in glycosidic-bond position, unrelated to methylation, and is a separate class of modification.

extra.zh: 老师在00:40:17左右自己发现并纠正了此前的混淆——之前的说法暗示某个符号代表「甲基化的甲」，但正确概念是：假尿嘧啶(Ψ)的定义是糖苷键从正常的N1-C1'(嘧啶氮-糖碳)异构为C5-C1'(碳-碳键)，与是否甲基化无关。请以老师纠正后的说法为准。
extra.en: Around 00:40:17 the lecturer caught and corrected his own earlier confusion — an earlier statement implied a symbol stood for 'the methyl of methylation', but the correct concept is: pseudouridine (Ψ) is defined by the glycosidic bond isomerising from the normal N1-C1' (pyrimidine N to sugar C) linkage to a C5-C1' (carbon-carbon) linkage, unrelated to methylation. Take the corrected version as authoritative.

extra.zh: m7G(7-甲基鸟苷，cap结构核心)与假尿嘧啶(Ψ，糖苷键异构)是两类不同的RNA修饰机制——前者是甲基化(methylation)，后者是异构化(isomerization)，不要混为一谈，但两者都属于表观转录组学(epitranscriptomics)研究范畴。
extra.en: m7G (7-methylguanosine, the core of the cap structure) and pseudouridine (Ψ, a glycosidic-bond isomerisation) are two distinct RNA modification mechanisms — the former is methylation, the latter isomerisation. Don't conflate them, though both fall under epitranscriptomics.

extra.zh: ATP水解γ磷酸产生的自由能(ΔG°′)约为-30.5 kJ/mol(约-7.3 kcal/mol)，这是「高能磷酸键」这一概念的定量基础，课上未给出具体数值。
extra.en: The free energy (ΔG°′) of ATP hydrolysis at the γ-phosphate is about -30.5 kJ/mol (about -7.3 kcal/mol) — the quantitative basis of the 'high-energy phosphate bond' concept, a number the lecture did not give.

extra.zh: cAMP作为第二信使的经典通路是G蛋白偶联受体(GPCR)→腺苷酸环化酶(adenylate cyclase)激活→ATP转化为cAMP→激活蛋白激酶A(PKA)，这条通路在讲座后段的GPCR题外话中也会被提及。
extra.en: The classic cAMP second-messenger pathway is GPCR → adenylate cyclase activation → ATP converted to cAMP → protein kinase A (PKA) activation — this pathway also surfaces later in the lecture's GPCR digression.

quiz.q_zh: mRNA 5' cap结构中的「帽子」分子m7G，是在鸟嘌呤的哪个位置发生甲基化?
quiz.q_en: In the mRNA 5' cap's 'cap' molecule m7G, at which position is guanine methylated?

options.zh: 1位
options.en: position 1

options.zh: 3位
options.en: position 3

options.zh: 5位
options.en: position 5

options.zh: 7位
options.en: position 7

quiz.explain_zh: m7G即7-甲基鸟嘌呤，甲基化发生在嘌呤咪唑环的7位氮上，这也是嘌呤类碱基常见的甲基化位置。5位在嘌呤中是稠合的碳、1位氮和3位氮都参与碱基配对与环骨架，不是加帽的甲基化位点。
quiz.explain_en: m7G is 7-methylguanine, methylated at the nitrogen at position 7 of the purine imidazole ring — the common methylation site for purine bases. In a purine, position 5 is a fused carbon and the nitrogens at 1 and 3 take part in base pairing and the ring framework, so none of them is the capping methylation site.

quiz.q_zh: ATP分子中，生物体内实际最常被利用的高能磷酸键是?
quiz.q_en: Which high-energy phosphate bond in ATP is actually most commonly used by the body?

options.zh: β位上的磷酸键
options.en: the phosphate bond at the β position

options.zh: γ位上的磷酸键
options.en: the phosphate bond at the γ position

options.zh: α位与β位的磷酸键
options.en: the phosphate bonds at α and β

options.zh: α位上的磷酸键
options.en: the phosphate bond at the α position

quiz.explain_zh: β位和γ位的磷酸键都是高能磷酸酐键，但体内实际最常被利用的是γ位磷酸键的水解，把末端磷酸基团转给底物。α位磷酸直接连在核糖上，属于普通的磷酸酯键；把α与β两处合起来当作主要供能键也不符合常规的能量传递方式。
quiz.explain_en: The β and γ phosphate bonds are both high-energy anhydride bonds, but the one the body actually uses most is hydrolysis of the γ bond, handing the terminal phosphate to a substrate. The α phosphate is attached straight to the ribose through an ordinary phosphoester bond, and treating the α and β linkages together as the main energy-yielding bond does not match how ATP normally delivers energy.

quiz.q_zh: 假尿嘧啶(pseudouridine, Ψ)与正常尿嘧啶相比，结构上真正改变的是?
quiz.q_en: Compared to normal uracil, what actually changes structurally in pseudouridine (Ψ)?

options.zh: 尿嘧啶环的N3位上多接了一个甲基
options.en: An extra methyl group is added onto ring position N3

options.zh: 糖苷键由N1-C1'改变为C5-C1'
options.en: The glycosidic bond shifts from N1-C1' to a C5-C1' link

options.zh: 核糖上连接的磷酸基团由一个变成了三个
options.en: The attached phosphate groups go from one up to three

options.zh: 所连的戊糖由核糖整个换成了脱氧核糖
options.en: The attached ribose is swapped out for deoxyribose

quiz.explain_zh: 老师纠正后明确：假尿嘧啶是糖苷键的连接位置由N1-C1'变成C5-C1'的碳-碳键，相当于把碱基翻转过来，原子组成并没有增减。它与N3位加甲基那类修饰无关，磷酸数目不变，所连的戊糖仍然是核糖。
quiz.explain_en: As the lecturer corrected: pseudouridine arises when the glycosidic bond moves from N1-C1' to a C5-C1' carbon-carbon linkage — the base is effectively flipped, with no atoms gained or lost. It is unrelated to adding a methyl at N3, the phosphate count is unchanged, and the attached pentose is still ribose.

title_zh: 核苷酸序列命名法、甲基化频率、沃森克里克DNA双螺旋模型与α-helix比较(含口误纠正)
title_en: Nucleotide sequence nomenclature, methylation frequency, the Watson-Crick DNA double helix, and its comparison with the α-helix (with a correction)

points.zh: 核酸序列的标准书写方法：从5'端开始写到3'端；正常磷酸二酯键连接的磷酸在书写时通常省略，因此序列直接写成大写字母如ATCG(RNA中T换成U)。
points.en: Standard nucleic-acid sequence notation: written from the 5' end to the 3' end; phosphates joined by ordinary phosphodiester bonds are usually omitted in writing, so sequences are just written as capital letters like ATCG (T becomes U in RNA).

points.zh: 若某位置存在甲基化修饰，则在对应碱基字母右上角标注甲基化位置编号，如某序列中U在5位甲基化，标注为m5U形式。
points.en: If a position carries a methylation, the methylated-position number is noted as a superscript on that base letter — e.g. uracil methylated at position 5 is written m5U.

points.zh: mRNA cap结构(m7GpppN...)之所以要把磷酸完整写出来(三个p)，是因为cap处的磷酸连接方式(5'-5'三磷酸桥)不是常规的磷酸二酯键，属于特殊连接，不能像正常序列那样省略磷酸符号。
points.en: The reason the mRNA cap structure (m7GpppN...) writes out all three phosphates is that the cap's phosphate linkage (a 5'-5' triphosphate bridge) is not an ordinary phosphodiester bond — a special linkage that cannot be abbreviated like a normal sequence.

points.zh: 修饰频率的经验描述：U的甲基化相对较少见，C(胞嘧啶)的甲基化较常见，A(腺嘌呤)的甲基化也比较常见。
points.en: Empirical note on modification frequency: methylation of U is relatively rare, methylation of C (cytosine) is fairly common, and methylation of A (adenine) is also fairly common.

points.zh: 沃森克里克(Watson-Crick)提出的DNA双螺旋模型：两条反平行(antiparallel)的核酸链沿中心轴相互缠绕。
points.en: The Watson-Crick DNA double helix model: two antiparallel nucleic acid strands wind around a central axis.

points.zh: DNA双螺旋每上升一个碱基对(base pair)，螺旋上升约0.34纳米(3.4埃)；螺旋每转一圈需要约10个碱基对(10 bp/turn)。
points.en: For every base pair the DNA double helix rises about 0.34 nm (3.4 Å); the helix completes one turn about every 10 base pairs (10 bp/turn).

points.zh: 老师将DNA螺旋参数与蛋白质α-螺旋(α-helix)类比：α-helix大约每4个氨基酸重复一次螺旋周期。
points.en: The lecturer drew an analogy between DNA helix parameters and the protein α-helix: the α-helix repeats its turn roughly every 4 amino acids.

points.zh: 双螺旋的维持力包括氢键，最初沃森克里克提出的经典配对是A-T、C-G(「经典沃森克里克氢键配对」)；课上提到实际上还存在非经典的沃森克里克配对，被同事的消息打断未展开。
points.en: Forces maintaining the double helix include hydrogen bonds; the original Watson-Crick pairing is A-T, C-G ('classic Watson-Crick pairing'). Non-classic Watson-Crick pairing was mentioned but the lecture was interrupted by a colleague's message and did not elaborate.

extra.zh: 00:44:49-00:45:51，老师把α-helix每个氨基酸上升的距离说成「大概3.4纳米，是DNA的10倍」。正确数值方向完全相反：α-helix每个氨基酸残基上升约0.15 nm(1.5 Å)(每3.6个残基一圈，螺距0.54 nm)，大约只是DNA双螺旋每碱基对上升0.34 nm的一半，而不是10倍。听到「3.4纳米/10倍」时应替换为「0.15 nm、约为DNA上升幅度的一半」。
extra.en: At 00:44:49-00:45:51 the lecturer described the α-helix's rise per residue as 'about 3.4 nm, 10 times DNA's'. The correct figure runs the opposite direction: the α-helix rises about 0.15 nm (1.5 Å) per residue (one turn every 3.6 residues, pitch 0.54 nm), roughly half of DNA's 0.34 nm rise per base pair — not ten times more. Wherever '3.4 nm / 10x' was heard, substitute '0.15 nm, about half of DNA's rise'.

extra.zh: α-helix严谨地说是每3.6个氨基酸残基一圈(不是课上说的「每4个」的整数近似)，螺距(pitch)为0.54 nm；这一数值常与DNA双螺旋10 bp/turn、3.4 nm/turn放在一起做对比记忆。
extra.en: Precisely, the α-helix completes one turn every 3.6 amino acid residues (not the rounded 'every 4' stated in the lecture), with a pitch of 0.54 nm — a number worth memorising alongside DNA's 10 bp/turn, 3.4 nm/turn for comparison.

extra.zh: cap结构保留三个磷酸(ppp)并非因为「磷酸多」，而是因为连接方式特殊——cap是m7G通过三磷酸桥反向连接到mRNA第一个核苷酸的5'端(5'-5'三磷酸桥)，与常规链内5'-3'磷酸二酯键完全不同的连接拓扑，这才是需要特殊标注的原因。
extra.en: The cap keeps all three phosphates (ppp) written out not because there are 'more phosphates', but because of the special linkage: m7G is joined to the first nucleotide's 5' end through a reversed 5'-5' triphosphate bridge, a completely different connection topology from the ordinary 5'-3' phosphodiester bond within a strand — this is why it needs special notation.

extra.zh: 非经典沃森克里克配对(non-Watson-Crick base pairing，如Hoogsteen配对、wobble配对)在此处被同事的消息打断，课上没有继续展开，是一个值得课后补充的考点。
extra.en: Non-classic Watson-Crick base pairing (e.g. Hoogsteen pairing, wobble pairing) was raised but the lecture was interrupted by a colleague's message and never elaborated — worth supplementing after class.

quiz.q_zh: DNA双螺旋每上升一个碱基对，螺旋轴方向上升约多少?
quiz.q_en: For each base pair, roughly how far does the DNA double helix rise along its axis?

options.zh: 3.4纳米
options.en: 3.4 nm

quiz.explain_zh: DNA双螺旋每碱基对沿轴上升约0.34纳米，每转一圈约10个碱基对。0.15纳米是α-helix每残基的上升幅度，3.4纳米是整整一圈的螺距而不是单个碱基对。
quiz.explain_en: The DNA double helix rises about 0.34 nm per base pair along its axis, with about 10 base pairs per turn. The 0.15 nm figure is the α-helix rise per residue, and 3.4 nm is the pitch of a full turn rather than a single base pair.

quiz.q_zh: α-螺旋(α-helix)每个氨基酸残基沿螺旋轴上升的距离，与DNA双螺旋每碱基对上升的距离相比，正确的关系是?
quiz.q_en: How does the α-helix's rise per residue actually compare to DNA's rise per base pair?

options.zh: α-helix每残基上升约是DNA每碱基对的20倍
options.en: The α-helix rise per residue is about 20 times DNA's per base pair

options.zh: α-helix每残基上升约是DNA每碱基对的10倍
options.en: The α-helix rise per residue is about 10 times DNA's per base pair

options.zh: α-helix每残基上升约是DNA每碱基对的一半
options.en: The α-helix rise per residue is about half of DNA's per base pair

options.zh: α-helix每残基上升与DNA每碱基对基本相等
options.en: The α-helix rise per residue about equals DNA's per base pair

quiz.explain_zh: α-helix每残基上升约0.15 nm，DNA双螺旋每碱基对上升约0.34 nm，α-helix的上升幅度大约是DNA的一半，而不是课上口误所说的10倍，更不是20倍，两者也并不相等。
quiz.explain_en: The α-helix rises about 0.15 nm per residue and the DNA double helix about 0.34 nm per base pair, so the α-helix value is roughly half of DNA's — not the 10-fold figure misstated in the lecture, not 20-fold, and not equal.

quiz.q_zh: mRNA cap结构中m7G与mRNA起始核苷酸之间，为什么书写命名时要把三个磷酸完整标出而不能省略?
quiz.q_en: Why must all three phosphates between m7G and the mRNA's starting nucleotide be written out in the cap structure's notation?

options.zh: 因为它是特殊的5'-5'三磷酸桥而非二酯键
options.en: Because it is a special 5'-5' triphosphate bridge instead

options.zh: 因为这里磷酸的数目会直接影响碱基配对的方式
options.en: Because the phosphate number here directly alters base pairing

options.zh: 因为这里是核糖2'位上额外加的磷酸化修饰
options.en: Because this is an extra phosphorylation at the ribose 2'

options.zh: 因为它只是链内常规的5'-3'磷酸二酯键
options.en: Because it is just an ordinary in-strand phosphodiester bond

quiz.explain_zh: cap是m7G通过反向的5'-5'三磷酸桥连到mRNA起始核苷酸的5'端，连接拓扑与链内常规的5'-3'磷酸二酯键完全不同，所以三个磷酸必须写全。磷酸的数目并不参与碱基配对，核糖2'位上的甲基化修饰(cap1)则是另一回事。
quiz.explain_en: The cap links m7G to the 5' end of the mRNA's starting nucleotide through a reversed 5'-5' triphosphate bridge, a topology quite unlike the ordinary in-strand 5'-3' phosphodiester bond, so all three phosphates are spelled out. Phosphate number plays no part in base pairing, and modification at the ribose 2' position (cap1) is a separate matter.

title_zh: DNA双螺旋的稳定作用力、A/B/Z三种构象与超螺旋
title_en: Forces Stabilizing DNA's Double Helix, the A/B/Z Forms, and Supercoiling

points.zh: 除了经典的Watson-Crick配对(A-T、G-C)外,还存在非经典/非Watson-Crick配对,例如A偶尔也能与G或C配对,但这种情况非常稀有。
points.en: Besides classic Watson-Crick pairing (A-T, G-C), non-Watson-Crick pairing also occurs — e.g. A can occasionally pair with G or C — but such pairing is very rare.

points.zh: 维持双螺旋的第二种作用力是碱基堆积力(base stacking),本质上是一种π-π stacking相互作用。
points.en: The second force holding the double helix together is the base-stacking force, essentially a π-π stacking interaction.

points.zh: 人体内最常见的双螺旋是B型DNA(B-DNA);还有一种构象相近、同为右手螺旋的A型DNA(A-DNA)。
points.en: The most common double helix in the body is B-form DNA (B-DNA); a structurally similar, also right-handed form is A-DNA.

points.zh: Z型DNA(Z-DNA)比较细长,主要出现在三股螺旋或四股螺旋等比较特殊的结构中。
points.en: Z-form DNA (Z-DNA) is more slender/elongated and mainly appears in special structures such as triple helices or quadruplexes.

points.zh: DNA的超螺旋(supercoiling)不是固定的,会因复制等过程随时打开、随时改变。
points.en: DNA supercoiling is not fixed — it can open up and change at any time, e.g. during replication.

points.zh: 形成超螺旋的意义:第一是压缩DNA占据的空间;第二,超螺旋带有张力,是拓扑异构酶(topoisomerase)消耗ATP将环状DNA扭成'8字形'而形成的。
points.en: The point of supercoiling: first, it compresses the space DNA occupies; second, it stores tension — topoisomerase spends ATP to twist circular DNA into a figure-eight shape.

points.zh: 形成负超螺旋后,DNA只需消耗较少能量就能把环状结构打开、变成线状,而线状更有利于局部发生复制。
