points.en: Once negative supercoils form, only a small amount of energy is then needed to relax the loop into a linear form, and the linear form favors local initiation of replication.

points.zh: 经典DNA双螺旋稳定性主要来自两方面:大量氢键(碱基配对氢键)和碱基堆积力;GC之间是3对氢键,AT之间是2对氢键。
points.en: Classic DNA double-helix stability mainly comes from two sources: extensive hydrogen bonding (base-pairing H-bonds) and base stacking; G-C pairs form 3 hydrogen bonds, A-T pairs form 2.

points.zh: 碱基堆积力(π-π stacking)大体上可算作疏水作用力(环与环的面对面比较疏水),但碱基边缘因含有能与水形成氢键的N、O原子,相对亲水,所以整体来说核酸是比较亲水的分子。
points.en: Base stacking can broadly be considered a hydrophobic interaction (the face-to-face stacking between rings is fairly hydrophobic), but the edges of the bases are relatively hydrophilic because they carry N and O atoms that can hydrogen-bond with water — so overall, nucleic acids are quite hydrophilic molecules.

extra.zh: B-DNA为右手螺旋、每圈约10个碱基对、上升约0.34 nm/bp(螺距约3.4 nm);A-DNA同为右手但更短粗、每圈约11 bp;Z-DNA是左手螺旋、每圈约12 bp——这些具体圈数/方向课上未展开,是常见考点。
extra.en: B-DNA is right-handed, ~10 bp/turn, rise ~0.34 nm/bp (pitch ~3.4 nm); A-DNA is also right-handed but shorter and wider, ~11 bp/turn; Z-DNA is LEFT-handed, ~12 bp/turn — these specific turn counts/handedness weren't detailed in lecture but are common exam points.

extra.zh: 课上笼统说'靠拓扑异构酶消耗大量ATP'引入超螺旋,但严格说只有II型拓扑异构酶(如细菌的DNA gyrase)水解ATP来引入负超螺旋;I型拓扑异构酶通过切开单链、旋转后再连接,大多不需要消耗ATP。
extra.en: The lecture generalizes 'topoisomerase consumes a lot of ATP,' but strictly only type II topoisomerases (e.g. bacterial DNA gyrase) hydrolyze ATP to introduce negative supercoils; type I topoisomerases nick one strand, allow rotation, then reseal, mostly without consuming ATP.

extra.zh: 碱基堆积力对双螺旋稳定性的贡献通常被认为大于氢键——氢键更多决定配对的'特异性'(哪个碱基配哪个),而堆积力对螺旋整体的热力学稳定性贡献更大,这一点课上没有强调。
extra.en: Base stacking is generally considered to contribute more to overall helix thermodynamic stability than hydrogen bonds do; H-bonds mainly confer pairing specificity (which base pairs with which). This wasn't emphasized in lecture.

extra.zh: 负超螺旋除了利于复制起始外,也是转录起始、解旋酶结合等过程共同需要的构象基础,课上只提到复制。
extra.en: Beyond favoring replication initiation, negative supercoiling is also a structural prerequisite shared by transcription initiation and helicase loading — the lecture only mentioned replication.

quiz.q_zh: 双螺旋中G-C碱基对与A-T碱基对之间氢键数目的差异是?
quiz.q_en: What is the difference in hydrogen-bond number between G-C and A-T base pairs in the double helix?

options.zh: G-C为两对氢键，而A-T有三对氢键
options.en: G-C has two H-bonds while A-T has three

options.zh: G-C为三对氢键，A-T也是三对氢键
options.en: G-C has three H-bonds and A-T three as well

options.zh: G-C为两对氢键，A-T也是两对氢键
options.en: G-C has two H-bonds and A-T two as well

options.zh: G-C为三对氢键，而A-T只有两对氢键
options.en: G-C has three H-bonds while A-T has only two

quiz.explain_zh: 课上明确讲到G-C之间是三对氢键、A-T之间是两对氢键，所以GC含量高的片段更难解链、Tm更高。把两者的数目对调，或者让两种碱基对氢键数相同，都与实际结构不符。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture states plainly that G-C pairs form three hydrogen bonds and A-T pairs two, which is why GC-rich stretches melt less easily and have a higher Tm. Swapping the two counts, or giving both kinds of pair the same number, contradicts the actual structures.

quiz.q_zh: 课上提到,人体内最常见的双螺旋构象是?
quiz.q_en: According to lecture, which double-helix conformation is most common in the body?

options.zh: 三股螺旋DNA
options.en: Triplex DNA

options.zh: B型DNA
options.en: B-DNA

options.zh: A型DNA
options.en: A-DNA

options.zh: Z型DNA
options.en: Z-DNA

quiz.explain_zh: 课上说人体内最常见的双螺旋是B型DNA。A型DNA构象相近但在脱水条件下才多见，Z型DNA是左手螺旋、只在特殊序列和结构中出现，三股螺旋更不是常态。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture states B-DNA is the most common double helix in the body. A-DNA is structurally similar but appears mainly under dehydrating conditions, Z-DNA is a left-handed helix confined to special sequences and structures, and a triple helix is rarer still.

quiz.q_zh: 形成DNA负超螺旋所消耗的能量来自哪种酶的作用?
quiz.q_en: The energy used to introduce negative supercoiling into DNA comes from the action of which enzyme?

options.zh: 核酸酶
options.en: Nuclease

options.zh: 拓扑异构酶
options.en: Topoisomerase

options.zh: 解旋酶
options.en: Helicase

options.zh: 聚合酶
options.en: Polymerase

quiz.explain_zh: 课上讲超螺旋是靠拓扑异构酶消耗ATP把环状DNA扭成'8字形'而形成的。解旋酶只在复制叉处把双链拆开，聚合酶负责按模板合成新链，核酸酶则水解核酸的磷酸二酯键，三者都不向DNA中引入超螺旋。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture explains that supercoiling forms via topoisomerase consuming ATP to twist circular DNA into a figure-eight shape. Helicase only separates the two strands at the replication fork, polymerase synthesises a new strand on a template, and nuclease hydrolyses the phosphodiester backbone; none of them introduces supercoils into DNA.

title_zh: RNA分子结构:tRNA的三叶草二级结构与修饰碱基
title_en: RNA Molecular Structure: tRNA's Cloverleaf Secondary Structure and Modified Bases

points.zh: 核酸的分子结构也分一级、二级、三级,但核酸很少提到二级、三级结构,主要在RNA(尤其tRNA)中才有意义。
points.en: Nucleic acid structure is also described in primary/secondary/tertiary levels, but these levels are rarely emphasized for nucleic acids in general — they mainly matter for RNA, especially tRNA.

points.zh: RNA一级结构就是它的核苷酸序列;二级结构指局部像小环一样折叠形成的结构;三级结构是整条RNA链的整体折叠方式。
points.en: RNA primary structure is its nucleotide sequence; secondary structure refers to small loop-like structures formed locally; tertiary structure is how the whole RNA chain folds overall.

points.zh: 几乎所有(约99%以上已知)tRNA的3'末端都是CCA(两个C一个A),这个CCA末端不发生任何碱基配对,是游离的;5'起始端一般是C或G。
points.en: Essentially all (>99% of known) tRNAs have a 3' CCA end (two C's and one A); this CCA end is unpaired/free, and the 5' start is generally C or G.

points.zh: 末端腺苷酸(A)的羟基上会连接氨基酸,这是tRNA携带氨基酸的位置。
points.en: An amino acid attaches to the hydroxyl of that terminal adenosine — this is where tRNA carries its amino acid.

points.zh: tRNA的整体二级结构是典型的'三叶草'形状(cloverleaf),三级结构上进一步折叠(例如4号环与1号环贴合扭转)形成一个三角形、整体呈倒L型的立体结构。
points.en: tRNA's overall secondary structure is the classic cloverleaf shape; in the tertiary structure it folds further (e.g. loop 4 folding against loop 1) into a triangular, overall inverted-L-shaped 3D structure.

points.zh: tRNA最大的特点是高度的碱基修饰,存在很多稀有/修饰碱基,不同的环因其特征修饰碱基而各有专属名称。
points.en: tRNA's biggest feature is heavy base modification — many rare/modified bases — and each loop is named after its characteristic modified base.

points.zh: 二氢尿嘧啶环(DHU环,D-loop)因含有多了两个氢原子的尿嘧啶(二氢尿嘧啶)而得名。
points.en: The dihydrouridine loop (DHU/D-loop) is named for containing dihydrouridine — a uracil with two extra hydrogen atoms.

points.zh: TΨC环含有固定序列T(胸腺嘧啶)-Ψ(假尿嘧啶)-C;DHU环与TΨC环在空间上靠得很近,共同形成一个'T'字形结构。
points.en: The TΨC loop has a fixed T (thymine)-Ψ (pseudouridine)-C sequence; the DHU loop and TΨC loop sit close together in space, together forming a T-shaped substructure.

points.zh: 底部的反密码子环(anticodon loop)上的3个关键碱基决定该tRNA携带哪种氨基酸,因为它们要与mRNA上的密码子配对。
points.en: The three key bases in the anticodon loop at the bottom determine which amino acid that tRNA carries, because they pair with the codon on the mRNA.

extra.zh: 课上说tRNA有'三个圈',但随后又提到'4号环'与'1号环'折叠——标准教材里经典三叶草结构通常描述为氨基酸接受臂(acceptor stem,无环,只是CCA末端)加三个环状臂(D臂、反密码子臂、TψC臂),部分tRNA还有一个可变臂(variable arm),编号和数目容易混淆,考试时按'三个环+可变臂'理解更稳妥。
extra.en: The lecture says tRNA has 'three loops' but then refers to 'loop 4' folding against 'loop 1' — standard textbooks describe the classic cloverleaf as an acceptor stem (no loop, just the CCA end) plus three loop-bearing arms (D-arm, anticodon arm, TψC arm), with some tRNAs also having a variable arm. The loop numbering is easy to confuse; for exams it's safer to think 'three main loops plus an optional variable arm.'

extra.zh: 假尿嘧啶(pseudouridine, Ψ)是尿嘧啶的C-糖苷异构体(碳-碳键连接核糖,而非常见的氮-碳键),是tRNA中最常见的修饰碱基之一,课上提到了TΨC环但没解释Ψ的化学本质。
extra.en: Pseudouridine (Ψ) is a C-glycoside isomer of uridine (ribose attached via a carbon-carbon bond instead of the usual nitrogen-carbon bond) and is one of the most common modified bases in tRNA; the lecture named the TΨC loop but didn't explain Ψ's chemistry.

extra.zh: tRNA的修饰碱基不仅关系结构稳定,也影响翻译的准确性和效率(例如反密码子第34位的摆动修饰会影响密码子识别范围),课上只提到修饰多、没展开功能意义。
extra.en: tRNA's modified bases affect not only structural stability but also translational accuracy and efficiency (e.g. wobble-position modifications at anticodon position 34 affect which codons can be read); the lecture mentioned heavy modification but didn't cover this functional significance.

quiz.q_zh: 几乎所有已知tRNA的3'末端序列是?
quiz.q_en: The 3' end sequence found in nearly all known tRNAs is?

options.zh: CCA
options.en: CCA

options.zh: CAC
options.en: CAC

options.zh: ACC
options.en: ACC

options.zh: CCU
options.en: CCU

quiz.explain_zh: 课上说几乎所有已知tRNA的3'末端都是CCA(两个C再接一个A)，末端腺苷的羟基就是氨基酸挂载的位置。把碱基顺序打乱或把末位换成U，都不是这个保守末端。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture states that almost all known tRNAs end in CCA at the 3' side (two C's followed by an A), and the hydroxyl of that terminal adenosine is where the amino acid is loaded. Reordering the bases or ending in U does not give this conserved terminus.

quiz.q_zh: tRNA上决定其携带哪种氨基酸的关键碱基位于哪个环?
quiz.q_en: Which loop's bases determine which amino acid a tRNA carries?

options.zh: 反密码子环
options.en: The anticodon loop

options.zh: 二氢尿嘧啶环
options.en: The dihydrouridine loop

options.zh: TΨC茎环
options.en: The TΨC stem loop

options.zh: 长度可变环
options.en: The variable loop

quiz.explain_zh: 课上讲反密码子环上的3个关键碱基要与mRNA密码子配对，从而决定该tRNA携带哪种氨基酸。二氢尿嘧啶环、TΨC茎环和长度可变环主要参与tRNA的折叠以及被酶和核糖体识别，并不读取密码子。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture explains that the three key bases in the anticodon loop pair with the mRNA codon, thereby determining which amino acid that tRNA carries. The dihydrouridine loop, the TΨC stem loop and the variable loop mainly serve tRNA folding and recognition by enzymes and the ribosome; they do not read codons.

quiz.q_zh: 二氢尿嘧啶环得名的原因是?
quiz.q_en: Why is the dihydrouridine loop named as such?

options.zh: 环上有一个尿嘧啶多出了两个氢原子
options.en: It contains a uracil bearing two extra hydrogen atoms

options.zh: 环上有两个尿嘧啶彼此相邻排列
options.en: It contains two uracils sitting next to each other

options.zh: 环上的尿嘧啶被连续磷酸化了两次
options.en: Its uracil has been phosphorylated twice in a row

options.zh: 环上的尿嘧啶丢失了两个氢原子
options.en: Its uracil is missing two of its hydrogen atoms

quiz.explain_zh: 课上说这个环上的尿嘧啶在5、6位被还原，多加了两个氢原子，所以叫二氢尿嘧啶环。名字里的「二氢」指多出来的两个氢，既不是指有两个尿嘧啶相邻排列，也与磷酸化或脱氢无关。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture states the uracil in this loop is reduced at positions 5 and 6, picking up two extra hydrogen atoms, which is what 'dihydro' names. The prefix refers to those added hydrogens, not to two uracils sitting side by side, and it has nothing to do with phosphorylation or with losing hydrogen.

title_zh: rRNA与mRNA:单/多顺反子、5'帽子与poly-A尾
title_en: rRNA and mRNA: Mono-/Polycistronic mRNA, the 5' Cap, and the Poly-A Tail

points.zh: rRNA主要与核糖体里的蛋白质结合,单独不发挥作用,要结合到核糖体蛋白质上才整体发挥功能。
points.en: rRNA mainly binds proteins within the ribosome and doesn't function alone — it only works as part of the assembled ribosome.

points.zh: 真核生物的mRNA主要是单顺反子(monocistronic):一条mRNA对应一条蛋白质。
points.en: Eukaryotic mRNA is mainly monocistronic — one mRNA corresponds to one protein.

points.zh: 原核生物的mRNA是多顺反子(polycistronic):一条mRNA可以对应好几个蛋白质,不同蛋白质的编码区之间可能有重叠。
points.en: Prokaryotic mRNA is polycistronic — one mRNA can encode several proteins, with the coding regions for different proteins sometimes overlapping.

points.zh: 真核生物mRNA有5'端的帽子结构(m7G加三个磷酸,即m7GpppN),以及3'端的poly-A尾巴。
points.en: Eukaryotic mRNA has a 5' cap (m7G plus three phosphates, i.e. m7GpppN) and a 3' poly-A tail.

points.zh: 课上给出的poly-A尾巴长度是'大概8到20个A'。
points.en: The lecture gives the poly-A tail length as 'roughly 8 to 20 A residues.'

points.zh: 帽子和poly-A尾巴能帮助真核核糖体识别mRNA,极大提高mRNA的翻译效率。
points.en: The cap and poly-A tail help the eukaryotic ribosome recognize the mRNA and greatly increase translation efficiency.

points.zh: 原核生物的mRNA不含帽子结构和poly-A尾巴,核糖体的组装方式也不一样。
points.en: Prokaryotic mRNA lacks a cap structure and poly-A tail, and ribosome assembly onto it also differs.

points.zh: 课上的结论是:原核生物mRNA的翻译效率'要低于'真核生物,原因归结于RNA形态和核糖体组成形式的不同。
points.en: The lecture concludes that prokaryotic mRNA translation efficiency is 'lower than' eukaryotic, attributing this to differences in RNA form and ribosome composition.

extra.zh: (约00:58:39)课上说原核生物mRNA翻译效率'低于'真核生物,标准说法正相反:原核生物转录和翻译是偶联的(没有细胞核分隔,翻译在转录未结束时就能开始),不需要加帽和剪接,又常常多核糖体同时结合一条多顺反子mRNA,这些都使原核翻译总体上更快、效率更高,而不是更低。
extra.en: (around 00:58:39) The lecture states prokaryotic mRNA translates 'less efficiently' than eukaryotic; the standard view is the opposite — prokaryotic transcription and translation are coupled (no nucleus separating them, so translation can start before transcription finishes), no capping or splicing is needed, and multiple ribosomes often load onto one polycistronic mRNA simultaneously — all of which make prokaryotic translation faster/more efficient overall, not slower.

extra.zh: 课上给出poly-A尾巴长度约8-20个A,实际上真核生物新合成mRNA的poly-A尾巴通常约有200-250个A(哺乳动物),之后会随时间被逐渐剪短(deadenylation),8-20个A明显偏短。
extra.en: The lecture gives the poly-A tail length as ~8-20 A residues; in reality, newly made eukaryotic mRNA (mammalian) typically carries ~200-250 A residues, which is progressively shortened over time by deadenylation — 8-20 is well below the real number.

extra.zh: 5'帽子的正式结构是m7GpppN——7-甲基鸟苷通过不寻常的5'-5'三磷酸桥连接到mRNA第一个核苷酸上,翻译起始时由帽结合蛋白eIF4E识别,poly-A尾则被PABP结合,两者协同促进小亚基募集,这一机制课上没有展开。
extra.en: The formal cap structure is m7GpppN — 7-methylguanosine linked to the mRNA's first nucleotide via an unusual 5'-5' triphosphate bridge, recognized at translation initiation by the cap-binding protein eIF4E, while PABP binds the poly-A tail; together they help recruit the small ribosomal subunit — this mechanism wasn't covered in lecture.

quiz.q_zh: 原核生物的mRNA最常见的顺反子类型是?
quiz.q_en: What is the most common cistron type of prokaryotic mRNA?

options.zh: 单顺反子
options.en: Monocistronic

options.zh: 仅双顺反子
options.en: Bicistronic only

options.zh: 无顺反子
options.en: Acistronic

options.zh: 多顺反子
options.en: Polycistronic

quiz.explain_zh: 课上说原核生物mRNA一般是多顺反子，一条mRNA可对应好几个蛋白质，这与操纵子的组织方式一致；单顺反子是真核生物的常态。并不存在只能带两个顺反子的限制，而任何编码mRNA都至少含一个顺反子。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture states prokaryotic mRNA is generally polycistronic, one mRNA encoding several proteins, in keeping with operon organisation; monocistronic messages are the eukaryotic norm. No rule restricts a message to exactly two cistrons, and any coding mRNA contains at least one.

quiz.q_zh: 真核生物mRNA的5'帽子结构主要成分是?
quiz.q_en: What is the main component of the eukaryotic mRNA 5' cap structure?

options.zh: tRNA中的二氢尿嘧啶核苷
options.en: Dihydrouridine found in tRNA

options.zh: m7G加上三个磷酸基团
options.en: m7G plus three phosphate groups

options.zh: 3'端加上的多聚腺苷酸尾
options.en: A poly-A tail added at the 3' end

options.zh: tRNA中的假尿嘧啶核苷
options.en: Pseudouridine found in tRNA

quiz.explain_zh: 课上说真核mRNA的5'端帽子是m7G(7-甲基鸟苷)加三个磷酸;多聚腺苷酸尾加在3'端而不是5'端,假尿嘧啶核苷和二氢尿嘧啶核苷则是tRNA上的修饰碱基,与帽子无关。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture states the eukaryotic mRNA 5' cap is m7G (7-methylguanosine) plus three phosphates; the poly-A tail is added at the 3' end rather than the 5' end, while pseudouridine and dihydrouridine are modified bases of tRNA and have nothing to do with the cap.

quiz.q_zh: 关于原核和真核翻译效率的比较,标准生物学的观点是?
quiz.q_en: What is the standard biological view comparing prokaryotic vs eukaryotic translation efficiency?

options.zh: 二者翻译效率完全相同,加帽与剪接并不影响速度
options.en: The two have identical translation efficiency, as capping and splicing cost no time

options.zh: 原核是多顺反子,一次只能翻译一个基因,效率最低
options.en: Being polycistronic limits prokaryotes to one gene at a time, so efficiency is lowest

options.zh: 原核转录翻译偶联、无需加帽剪接,故整体更快更高效
options.en: Coupled transcription-translation and no capping or splicing make prokaryotes faster

options.zh: 真核有帽子和poly-A,故整体翻译总是快于原核
options.en: Having a 5' cap and a poly-A tail makes eukaryotes always faster than prokaryotes

quiz.explain_zh: 课上说原核翻译效率低于真核,但标准生物学观点相反:原核转录翻译偶联、无需加帽剪接、常多核糖体同时翻译,整体更快更高效,这是本讲义中标注的一处口误。真核的帽子和poly-A提高的是稳定性与起始效率,并不能让真核总体超过原核;加帽和剪接确实要额外耗时,所以两者效率并不相同;多顺反子恰恰允许一条mRNA同时翻译多个基因,而不是一次只能翻译一个。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture states prokaryotic translation is less efficient than eukaryotic, but standard biology holds the opposite: coupled transcription-translation, no capping/splicing needed, and frequent multi-ribosome loading make prokaryotic translation faster overall — this is flagged as a lecture misstatement. The eukaryotic cap and poly-A tail improve stability and initiation rather than making eukaryotes faster overall; capping and splicing do cost time, so the two are not equal; and being polycistronic lets one mRNA be translated into several proteins rather than restricting it to one gene.

title_zh: 核酸的化学水解:酸碱敏感性与磷酸二酯酶
title_en: Chemical Hydrolysis of Nucleic Acids: Acid/Base Sensitivity and Phosphodiesterases

points.zh: 核酸容易被水解,其中碱基(糖苷键)比磷酸二酯键更容易水解——核苷酸链可以先丢掉碱基,但磷酸和核糖仍连在一起,链仍保持线状。
points.en: Nucleic acids are prone to hydrolysis; the base (glycosidic bond) hydrolyzes more easily than the phosphodiester bond — a nucleotide chain can lose its bases first while the phosphate-sugar backbone stays intact, so the chain remains linear.

points.zh: 核酸在酸性条件下相对稳定,在碱性条件下则比较敏感、容易被水解。
points.en: Nucleic acids are relatively stable under acidic conditions, but sensitive and prone to hydrolysis under alkaline conditions.

points.zh: RNA在碱性条件下会被完全水解;DNA对碱性条件有较强的抗水解能力,但并非完全不水解。
points.en: RNA is completely hydrolyzed under alkaline conditions; DNA has stronger resistance to alkaline hydrolysis, but is not entirely immune.

points.zh: 实验提示:做polymerase相关实验时要注意体系的pH,例如pH 8.5下即使聚合酶成功转录出RNA,RNA也可能直接水解;温度升高会加速水解,跑胶时可能什么都看不到。
points.en: Practical note: when doing polymerase-related experiments, watch the system's pH — e.g. at pH 8.5, even if the polymerase successfully transcribes RNA, that RNA may hydrolyze away; higher temperature speeds this up, and the gel may show nothing at all.

points.zh: 酶促水解方面,课本提到两种代表性磷酸二酯酶:蛇毒磷酸二酯酶,切割3'-羟基形成的磷酸二酯键;牛脾磷酸二酯酶,则在磷酸二酯键的另一侧切割。
points.en: For enzymatic hydrolysis, the textbook names two representative phosphodiesterases: snake-venom phosphodiesterase, which cuts the phosphodiester bond at the 3'-hydroxyl side; and bovine-spleen phosphodiesterase, which cuts on the other side of the bond.

points.zh: 这两种具体的酶不需要死记,重点是:核酸水解酶普遍是切割磷酸二酯键(磷酸上侧或下侧都有可能),很少有酶去切碱基本身,因为碱基被切掉后片段就失去生物学功能了。
points.en: These two specific enzymes don't need to be memorized; the key point is that nucleic-acid hydrolases generally cut the phosphodiester bond (on either side of the phosphate), and rarely cut the base itself, because once the base is removed the fragment loses biological function.

extra.zh: 蛇毒磷酸二酯酶是从3'端开始逐个切割的外切酶(3'-exonuclease),释放5'-单核苷酸;牛脾磷酸二酯酶则是从5'端开始的外切酶(5'-exonuclease),释放3'-单核苷酸——两者方向正好相反,课上只说'切两侧',没点出这是外切酶且方向不同。
extra.en: Snake-venom phosphodiesterase is a 3'-exonuclease that works inward from the 3' end, releasing 5'-mononucleotides; bovine-spleen phosphodiesterase is a 5'-exonuclease working from the 5' end, releasing 3'-mononucleotides — opposite directions. The lecture only said 'cuts on either side' without naming these as exonucleases or noting the opposite directionality.

extra.zh: RNA对碱水解敏感的化学机制是2'-OH对相邻磷酸的分子内亲核进攻(转酯反应),形成2',3'-环磷酸中间体后断链;DNA因为2'位没有羟基,缺乏这个反应途径,这是DNA远比RNA耐碱水解的根本原因,课上没有讲这个机制。
extra.en: The chemical reason RNA is alkali-sensitive is that its 2'-OH performs an intramolecular nucleophilic attack on the adjacent phosphate (a transesterification), forming a 2',3'-cyclic phosphate intermediate that breaks the chain; DNA lacks a 2'-OH and so lacks this pathway — this is the root reason DNA is far more alkali-resistant than RNA, though the lecture didn't cover the mechanism.

extra.zh: 强酸加高温条件下DNA的脱嘌呤(depurination)是经典的酸催化反应,曾被用于Maxam-Gilbert化学法测序(甲酸处理);脱嘌呤后留下的无碱基位点(AP site)要在后续的碱处理下才会真正断链——这与课上'碱基先丢、骨架仍连着'的说法是吻合的。
extra.en: Under strong acid plus heat, DNA depurination is a classic acid-catalyzed reaction, historically exploited in Maxam-Gilbert chemical sequencing (formic-acid treatment); the resulting abasic (AP) site only breaks the backbone upon subsequent alkaline treatment — consistent with the lecture's point that 'the base can be lost first while the backbone stays connected.'

quiz.q_zh: RNA在碱性条件下容易被完全水解,而DNA相对耐受,根本原因是?
quiz.q_en: RNA is readily fully hydrolyzed under alkaline conditions while DNA resists — what is the underlying reason?

options.zh: RNA通常是双链而DNA是单链,双链在碱中更不稳定
options.en: RNA is usually double-stranded and DNA single-stranded, and duplexes melt in alkali

options.zh: RNA的2'-OH能发起分子内转酯反应,使链断裂
options.en: RNA's 2'-OH launches an intramolecular transesterification that cuts the chain

options.zh: RNA的磷酸二酯键比DNA的键能更低,更易断裂
options.en: RNA's phosphodiester bonds have a lower bond energy than DNA's and break first

options.zh: RNA的嘧啶碱基在碱性条件下更容易被氧化脱落
options.en: RNA's pyrimidine bases are far more readily oxidized off under alkaline conditions

quiz.explain_zh: RNA的2'-OH能对相邻磷酸发起分子内转酯反应而断链,DNA因没有2'-OH缺乏此途径,这是DNA对碱性更耐受的化学基础。两者的磷酸二酯键键能本质相同,不存在RNA的键更弱的问题;碱性水解切的是骨架而不是氧化碱基;而且RNA多为单链、DNA多为双链,链型的说法本身就反了。
quiz.explain_en: RNA's 2'-OH can trigger an intramolecular transesterification against the adjacent phosphate that breaks the chain; DNA lacks a 2'-OH and this pathway, which is the chemical basis for DNA's greater alkaline resistance. The phosphodiester bonds themselves are chemically the same in both, so bond energy is not the difference; alkaline hydrolysis cleaves the backbone rather than oxidizing bases; and RNA is usually single-stranded while DNA is usually double-stranded, so the strandedness claim is backwards.

quiz.q_zh: 核酸链中,哪种化学键相对最容易先发生水解?
quiz.q_en: In a nucleic acid strand, which bond tends to hydrolyze first?

options.zh: 核糖环内部的C-C碳碳键
options.en: The carbon-carbon bond in the ribose ring

options.zh: 碱基环上的芳香C=C双键
options.en: The aromatic C=C double bond in the base ring

options.zh: 连接碱基与戊糖的N-糖苷键
options.en: The N-glycosidic bond joining base and sugar

options.zh: 连接糖与磷酸的磷酸二酯键
options.en: The phosphodiester bond linking the sugars

quiz.explain_zh: 课上说碱基与糖之间的糖苷键比磷酸二酯键更容易水解,核苷酸链可以先丢碱基而骨架仍连着;磷酸二酯键要更强的酸碱或酶才断,而核糖环上的C-C键和碱基环上的芳香C=C双键在水解条件下基本不动。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture states the base-to-sugar glycosidic bond hydrolyzes more easily than the phosphodiester bond — a strand can lose its bases first while the backbone stays connected. The phosphodiester bond needs stronger acid/base or an enzyme, and the ribose C-C bonds and the aromatic C=C bonds of the base are essentially untouched by hydrolysis.

quiz.q_zh: 课上提到用于研究的两种磷酸二酯酶分别来自?
quiz.q_en: The two research-use phosphodiesterases mentioned in lecture come from which sources respectively?

options.zh: 蛇毒和猪肝
options.en: Snake venom and porcine liver

options.zh: 蝎毒和牛脾
options.en: Scorpion venom and bovine spleen

options.zh: 蛇毒和牛肝
options.en: Snake venom and bovine liver

options.zh: 蛇毒和牛脾
options.en: Snake venom and bovine spleen

quiz.explain_zh: 课上提到的两种代表性磷酸二酯酶分别来自蛇毒和牛脾:蛇毒的那种从3'端切、牛脾的那种从5'端切;蝎毒、猪肝和牛肝都不是这两种酶的经典来源。
quiz.explain_en: The two representative phosphodiesterases named in lecture come from snake venom and bovine spleen — the venom enzyme digests from the 3' end and the spleen enzyme from the 5' end; scorpion venom, porcine liver and bovine liver are not the classic sources of this pair.

title_zh: 实验室闲聊:核酸酶的实际应用与RNase H的功能
title_en: Lab Chat: Practical Uses of Nucleases and the Role of RNase H

points.zh: 学生提问这些切磷酸二酯键的酶有什么实际应用价值,老师回答:蛇毒/牛脾磷酸二酯酶这类酶目前用得不多,主要是早期研究阶段的研究手段,没有太多实用价值。
points.en: A student asks what practical value these phosphodiester-cutting enzymes have; the teacher answers that enzymes like snake-venom/bovine-spleen phosphodiesterase are not much used now — they were mainly research tools from early-stage research, without much practical application today.

points.zh: 讨论如何把DNA/RNA均匀打断成小片段的问题,例如构建基因文库(gene library)做shuffle实验时需要把DNA全部打碎。
points.en: They discuss how to break DNA/RNA evenly into fragments — e.g. when building a gene library for a shuffle experiment, the DNA needs to be fragmented entirely.

points.zh: 学生提到有些公司提供专门定制的酶,比如识别特定位点(如'AA到C'这类位置)进行切割,或是比较随机地切割,这类定制酶一般要向公司咨询。
points.en: The student mentions that some companies offer custom enzymes — e.g. ones recognizing a specific site (like 'AA to C') to cut there, or ones that cut more randomly — and such custom enzymes generally need to be arranged through the company.

points.zh: 话题转回RNase,课本提到RNase H:转录结束后,新合成的RNA还粘在DNA模板上,形成DNA-RNA杂交链(hybrid),RNase H(或其他DNase)负责切割这条杂交链帮助RNA离开模板。
points.en: The topic returns to RNase — the textbook mentions RNase H: after transcription finishes, the newly made RNA is still stuck to the DNA template, forming a DNA-RNA hybrid strand; RNase H (or other DNases) cuts this hybrid strand to help the RNA leave the template.

points.zh: RNase H1等具体亚型现在不太常用,课上没有深入讲。
points.en: Specific subtypes like RNase H1 aren't much used now and weren't covered in depth.

points.zh: 总体而言,实际操作中DNase用得比RNase多。
points.en: Overall, DNase is used more often than RNase in practice.

extra.zh: RNase H在生物学上更经典的角色其实是清除DNA复制中冈崎片段(Okazaki fragment)上的RNA引物,以及在逆转录(reverse transcription)中降解RNA:DNA杂交体里的RNA模板链,逆转录酶本身常带有RNase H结构域——这两点课上都没提到。
extra.en: RNase H's more classic biological roles are removing the RNA primers on Okazaki fragments during DNA replication, and degrading the RNA strand of an RNA:DNA hybrid during reverse transcription — reverse transcriptase itself often carries an RNase H domain — neither of which was mentioned in lecture.

extra.zh: RNase H在分子生物学实验中的常见用途是:合成cDNA后,用RNase H降解模板RNA,只留下DNA第一链,便于后续第二链合成或PCR。
extra.en: A common lab use of RNase H is: after cDNA synthesis, RNase H degrades the template RNA, leaving only the first-strand DNA, to facilitate subsequent second-strand synthesis or PCR.

quiz.q_zh: RNase H特异性降解的是什么?
quiz.q_en: What does RNase H specifically degrade?

options.zh: 单链RNA中的嘌呤碱基所在位点
options.en: The purine base sites in single-stranded RNA

options.zh: 双链RNA分子中互补配对的两条链
options.en: Both paired strands of a double-stranded RNA

options.zh: RNA:DNA杂交体中的RNA链
options.en: The RNA strand within an RNA:DNA hybrid duplex

options.zh: 双链DNA中被甲基化的那一条链
options.en: The methylated strand within double-stranded DNA

quiz.explain_zh: 课上讲RNase H负责切割转录后残留的DNA-RNA杂交链中的RNA部分,底物必须是RNA与DNA配对形成的杂交体。它不认甲基化状态,也不切双链DNA;它切的是磷酸二酯骨架而不是嘌呤位点;双链RNA是Dicer一类酶的底物,不是RNase H的。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture explains RNase H cuts the RNA portion of the DNA-RNA hybrid left over after transcription, so its substrate must be RNA paired with DNA. It does not read methylation and does not cut double-stranded DNA; it cleaves the phosphodiester backbone rather than purine sites; and double-stranded RNA is the substrate of Dicer-type enzymes, not of RNase H.

quiz.q_zh: 课上提到,转录刚结束时,新生RNA为何会暂时与DNA模板结合在一起?
quiz.q_en: According to lecture, why does the newly made RNA remain briefly bound to the DNA template right after transcription?

options.zh: 新生RNA尚未加上5'帽子,因而离不开模板
options.en: The nascent RNA lacks its 5' cap and cannot leave the template

options.zh: DNA模板链上还残留着起始用的一段RNA引物
options.en: An RNA primer used for initiation still sits on the template

options.zh: 它们仍以DNA-RNA杂交链形式存在,未分开
options.en: They still exist as a DNA-RNA hybrid that has not yet separated

options.zh: RNA聚合酶用共价键把新生RNA接在模板上
options.en: RNA polymerase covalently attached the new RNA to the template

quiz.explain_zh: 课上说转录刚结束时新生RNA还'粘'在DNA模板上,即靠碱基配对以DNA-RNA杂交链的形式暂时存在。RNA与模板之间只有氢键而没有共价连接;加帽发生在细胞核内、与RNA是否脱离模板无关;RNA引物是DNA复制的产物,转录不需要引物。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture states that right after transcription the nascent RNA is still 'stuck' to the DNA template — held by base pairing as a temporary DNA-RNA hybrid. Only hydrogen bonds, never a covalent link, join RNA to the template; capping happens in the nucleus and is unrelated to release from the template; and RNA primers belong to DNA replication, since transcription needs no primer.

title_zh: 限制性内切酶:EcoRI与酶的命名规则
title_en: Restriction Endonucleases: EcoRI and Enzyme Naming Conventions

points.zh: 实际操作中DNase使用远比RNase多,其中最主要的一类是限制性内切酶(restriction endonuclease)。
points.en: In practice DNase is used far more than RNase, and the main class of DNase used is restriction endonucleases.

points.zh: 限制性内切酶最初来源于细菌,细菌会分泌这类酶。
points.en: Restriction endonucleases were originally derived from bacteria — bacteria secrete this class of enzyme.

points.zh: 经典例子是EcoRI:'Eco'代表大肠杆菌(E. coli),这个酶是在大肠杆菌中发现的一类核酸酶。
points.en: The classic example is EcoRI: 'Eco' stands for Escherichia coli — this enzyme was discovered in and derived from E. coli.

points.zh: 限制性内切酶能专门降解/识别特定的片段位点,不同的核酸内切酶识别不同的序列位点。
points.en: Restriction endonucleases specifically recognize and cut particular sequence sites — different enzymes recognize different sites.

points.zh: 这类酶在PCR相关实验中用得非常多。
points.en: This class of enzyme is used a great deal in PCR-related work.

points.zh: 酶命名规则:例如EcoRI中'R'代表发现该酶的菌株(strain),罗马数字表示在该菌株中被发现的顺序(第一个发现的酶)。
points.en: Naming convention: e.g. in EcoRI the 'R' denotes the bacterial strain it was found in, and the Roman numeral indicates the order of discovery in that strain (the first one found).

extra.zh: (约01:05:36-01:06:08)课上先把EcoRI这类酶称为'核酸外切酶',紧接着又改口说是'限制性内切酶',两者矛盾。限制性酶是内切酶(endonuclease):在DNA内部特定位点切磷酸二酯键;外切酶(exonuclease)则是从链的末端逐个切除核苷酸,机制完全不同。EcoRI本身是内切酶,且只切DNA。
extra.en: (around 01:05:36-01:06:08) The lecture first calls enzymes like EcoRI an 'exonuclease,' then immediately corrects itself to 'restriction endonuclease' — contradictory. Restriction enzymes are endonucleases: they cut internal phosphodiester bonds at a specific site within the DNA; exonucleases instead remove nucleotides one at a time from a strand end — a completely different mechanism. EcoRI itself is an endonuclease, and it is DNA-specific.

extra.zh: EcoRI识别的具体序列是GAATTC(回文序列),切割后在两条链上各留下4个碱基的5'突出末端('黏性末端'),这是分子克隆里最常用的知识点之一,课上没有给出具体序列。
extra.en: EcoRI's recognition sequence is GAATTC (a palindrome); cutting leaves a 4-base 5' overhang ('sticky end') on each strand — one of the most commonly tested facts in molecular cloning, though the lecture didn't give the specific sequence.

extra.zh: 限制性内切酶更核心的用途是分子克隆中切割载体和插入片段、以及限制性片段长度多态性(RFLP)分析,而不只是'用在PCR里';PCR本身通常不需要限制性酶,只有在PCR产物后续要克隆、酶切鉴定时才会用到。
extra.en: Restriction endonucleases' more central use is cutting vectors and insert fragments in molecular cloning, and restriction fragment length polymorphism (RFLP) analysis — not simply being 'used in PCR' itself; PCR per se usually doesn't require restriction enzymes, they come in afterward when the PCR product needs cloning or enzyme-digestion verification.

quiz.q_zh: 限制性内切酶属于哪一类酶?
quiz.q_en: What enzyme class do restriction enzymes belong to?

options.zh: 内切酶,在链内部的特定位点切割
options.en: Endonuclease, cutting at a specific site inside the strand

options.zh: 外切酶,从链末端逐个切除核苷酸
options.en: Exonuclease, removing nucleotides one by one from the end

options.zh: 连接酶,把两段核酸的末端连起来
options.en: Ligase, joining up the ends of two nucleic acid segments

options.zh: 解旋酶,把双螺旋解开成两条单链
options.en: Helicase, unwinding a duplex into two separate strands

quiz.explain_zh: 课上一开始把EcoRI这类酶说成'核酸外切酶',随即改口为正确的'限制性内切酶':限制性酶识别回文序列并在链内部特定位点切割,而不是从末端逐个啃;连接酶做的是相反的封口反应,解旋酶只解氢键、根本不切磷酸二酯键。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture initially calls enzymes like EcoRI an 'exonuclease' and immediately self-corrects to the accurate term 'restriction endonuclease': restriction enzymes recognize a palindrome and cut at a specific internal site rather than nibbling from an end; a ligase performs the opposite, sealing reaction, and a helicase only breaks hydrogen bonds without cutting any phosphodiester bond.

quiz.q_zh: EcoRI名称中的'Eco'来源于?
quiz.q_en: What does the 'Eco' in EcoRI's name refer to?

options.zh: 幽门螺杆菌(Helicobacter pylori)
options.en: Helicobacter pylori

options.zh: 大肠杆菌(Escherichia coli)
options.en: Escherichia coli

options.zh: 枯草芽孢杆菌(Bacillus subtilis)
options.en: Bacillus subtilis

options.zh: 沙门氏菌(Salmonella enterica)
options.en: Salmonella enterica

quiz.explain_zh: 限制性内切酶按属名的首字母加种名开头两个字母命名,'Eco'即Escherichia coli(大肠杆菌),这个酶正是在大肠杆菌中发现的;Bacillus subtilis对应Bsu,Salmonella enterica对应Sen,Helicobacter pylori对应Hpy。
quiz.explain_en: Restriction enzymes are named from the genus initial plus two letters taken from the species name, so 'Eco' is Escherichia coli, where the enzyme was discovered; Bacillus subtilis would give Bsu, Salmonella enterica gives Sen, and Helicobacter pylori gives Hpy.

quiz.q_zh: 限制性内切酶最初是从什么生物中分离得到的?其生理作用是什么?
quiz.q_en: Restriction endonucleases were originally isolated from which organisms, and what is their role there?

options.zh: 病毒,用于整合到宿主
options.en: Viruses, for integrating into the host

options.zh: 植物,用于抵御食草动物
options.en: Plants, for defense against herbivores

options.zh: 细菌,用于抵御噬菌体
options.en: Bacteria, for defense against phage

options.zh: 真菌,用于分解细胞壁
options.en: Fungi, for breaking down cell walls

quiz.explain_zh: 课上说限制性内切酶最初来源于细菌:它与甲基化酶配套构成限制-修饰系统,切碎入侵噬菌体的DNA而放过自身被甲基化的基因组。真菌降解细胞壁靠的是几丁质酶一类的水解酶,病毒整合靠整合酶,植物防御食草动物靠次生代谢物,都与限制性内切酶无关。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture states restriction endonucleases were originally derived from bacteria: paired with a methylase they form the restriction-modification system, shredding invading phage DNA while sparing the cell's own methylated genome. Fungal cell-wall breakdown uses chitinase-type hydrolases, viral integration uses an integrase, and plant defense against herbivores relies on secondary metabolites — none of these involve restriction enzymes.

title_zh: 核酸与蛋白质的紫外吸收及纯度判断(260/280)
title_en: UV Absorption and Purity Assessment for Nucleic Acids and Protein (260/280 Ratio)

points.zh: 核酸的最大吸收波长在260 nm左右,蛋白质的最大吸收波长在280 nm左右。
points.en: Nucleic acids have a UV absorption maximum around 260 nm, while proteins peak around 280 nm.

points.zh: 蛋白质280 nm的吸收主要由带苯环的芳香族氨基酸提供,这几种氨基酸在足够大的蛋白质中大致均匀分布,综合起来表现为280 nm的吸收峰。
points.en: Protein absorption at 280 nm mainly comes from aromatic amino acids bearing benzene rings, which are roughly uniformly distributed in a large enough protein, and together give the 280 nm peak.

points.zh: 核酸的吸收主要来自碱基上的环结构。
points.en: Nucleic acid absorption mainly comes from the ring structures on the bases.

points.zh: 定量核酸浓度常用OD(光密度),例如用nanodrop仪器测量,仪器内置公式将吸光度换算成'每毫升多少纳克'的浓度。
points.en: Nucleic acid concentration is commonly quantified by OD (optical density), e.g. measured with a nanodrop instrument, which uses a built-in formula to convert absorbance into a ng/mL concentration.

points.zh: 判断核酸样品纯度最重要的指标是260/280比值:DNA要大于1.8,RNA要大于2.0。
points.en: The most decisive indicator of nucleic-acid sample purity is the 260/280 ratio: it should be above 1.8 for DNA and above 2.0 for RNA.

points.zh: 如果RNA的260/280比值落在1.8到2.0之间,很可能说明这份RNA已经降解,或者被DNA污染,纯度不够高。
points.en: If an RNA sample's 260/280 ratio falls between 1.8 and 2.0, it likely means the RNA has degraded or is contaminated with DNA — the purity isn't high enough.

points.zh: 现在用nanodrop测浓度时,仪器会同时自动给出260/280比值。
points.en: When measuring concentration with a nanodrop nowadays, the instrument automatically reports the 260/280 ratio at the same time.

points.zh: 蛋白质纯度看的是相反的比值——280/260,方向和核酸正好相反;比值大约在0.6到0.7之间就是比较纯的蛋白质,质量非常高的蛋白质该比值大约在0.67左右。
points.en: Protein purity is assessed with the inverse ratio, 280/260 — the opposite direction from nucleic acids; a ratio of roughly 0.6 to 0.7 indicates a fairly pure protein, and very high-quality protein has a ratio around 0.67.

extra.zh: 严格来说,280 nm吸收主要来自色氨酸(Trp)和酪氨酸(Tyr),苯丙氨酸(Phe)虽然也有苯环,但其摩尔消光系数很小,对280 nm吸收的实际贡献常被忽略不计——课上笼统说'三个带苯环的氨基酸'贡献相当,更准确的说法是Trp和Tyr是主要贡献者。
extra.en: Strictly, 280 nm absorption comes mainly from tryptophan (Trp) and tyrosine (Tyr); phenylalanine (Phe), despite also having a benzene ring, has a very small molar extinction coefficient there and its practical contribution is usually considered negligible. The lecture broadly credits 'three aromatic-ring amino acids' equally; more precisely Trp and Tyr are the main contributors.

extra.zh: nanodrop等仪器常用的经验换算关系是:1 OD260大约相当于双链DNA 50 ng/μL、RNA 40 ng/μL、单链DNA/寡核苷酸约33 ng/μL,课上提到'仪器有自己的公式'但没给出具体数值。
extra.en: A common rule of thumb used by instruments like nanodrop: 1 OD260 unit corresponds to roughly 50 ng/μL of double-stranded DNA, 40 ng/μL of RNA, or 33 ng/μL of single-stranded DNA/oligo; the lecture mentioned 'the instrument has its own formula' but didn't give the actual numbers.

extra.zh: 260/280只能反映蛋白质污染或部分降解,检测不出苯酚、盐或其他化学残留;判断是否有酚类残留通常还要看260/230比值(理想应大于约2.0-2.2),课上没有提到这个补充指标。
extra.en: The 260/280 ratio only flags protein contamination or partial degradation — it can't detect phenol, salt, or other chemical carryover; checking for phenol residue typically also requires the 260/230 ratio (ideally above roughly 2.0-2.2), a supplementary metric the lecture didn't mention.

quiz.q_zh: 判断DNA样品纯度时,260/280比值至少要达到多少才算合格?
quiz.q_en: When judging DNA sample purity, what is the minimum 260/280 ratio for the sample to count as acceptable?
quiz.explain_zh: 课上明确说DNA的260/280比值要大于1.8才算纯度合格;约2.0是纯RNA的典型值,1.5说明蛋白质污染严重,2.5则高得不合常理,通常提示读数或空白有问题。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture explicitly states the DNA 260/280 ratio must be above 1.8 to count as acceptable purity; about 2.0 is the typical value for pure RNA, 1.5 indicates heavy protein contamination, and 2.5 is implausibly high and usually signals a bad reading or blank.

quiz.q_zh: 蛋白质在280 nm处的吸收主要由哪些氨基酸的苯环提供?
quiz.q_en: Absorption at 280 nm in proteins mainly comes from the aromatic ring(s) of which amino acid(s)?

options.zh: 色氨酸和酪氨酸
options.en: Tryptophan and tyrosine

options.zh: 甲硫氨酸和脯氨酸
options.en: Methionine and proline

options.zh: 组氨酸和精氨酸
options.en: Histidine and arginine

options.zh: 半胱氨酸和天冬酰胺
options.en: Cysteine and asparagine

quiz.explain_zh: 严格来说280nm吸收主要由色氨酸和酪氨酸提供(苯丙氨酸虽带苯环但贡献很小,课上笼统归为'三个带苯环的氨基酸');甲硫氨酸、脯氨酸、组氨酸、精氨酸、半胱氨酸和天冬酰胺的侧链都不含苯环,在280nm几乎不吸收。
quiz.explain_en: Strictly, 280 nm absorption mainly comes from tryptophan and tyrosine (phenylalanine has a ring but contributes little; the lecture broadly grouped these as 'three aromatic-ring amino acids'); methionine, proline, histidine, arginine, cysteine and asparagine all lack a benzene ring and absorb essentially nothing at 280 nm.

quiz.q_zh: 评估蛋白质纯度时使用的比值方向是?
quiz.q_en: When assessing protein purity, which ratio direction is used?

options.zh: 260/280,与核酸方向相同
options.en: A260/A280, the same direction as for nucleic acids

options.zh: 260/230,与核酸方向相同
options.en: A260/A230, the same direction as for nucleic acids

options.zh: 230/280,与核酸方向相反
options.en: A230/A280, the opposite direction from nucleic acids

options.zh: 280/260,与核酸的方向相反
options.en: A280/A260, the opposite direction from nucleic acids

quiz.explain_zh: 课上说蛋白质纯度看的是280/260,把被测物自己的特征吸收放在分子上,方向与核酸的260/280正好相反;沿用核酸的260/280会让蛋白质越纯比值越低,而260/230是核酸样品中查有机溶剂残留用的,230/280则不是任何一方的常规判据。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture states protein purity is assessed via A280/A260, putting the analyte's own characteristic absorbance on top — the opposite direction from the nucleic acid A260/A280 ratio; keeping A260/A280 would make purer protein score lower, A260/A230 is used on nucleic acid samples to check for organic-solvent carryover, and A230/A280 is not a routine criterion for either.

title_zh: 核酸的变性:氢键断裂与粘度下降
title_en: Nucleic Acid Denaturation: Hydrogen-Bond Breaking and Viscosity Drop

points.zh: 生化中定义的"变性"(denaturation):DNA碱基对之间的氢键(hydrogen bond)断裂,但共价的磷酸二酯键(phosphodiester bond)不断裂,一级结构(primary structure)不发生改变。
points.en: Biochemical "denaturation" means the hydrogen bonds between DNA base pairs break, while the covalent phosphodiester backbone stays intact and the primary structure is unchanged.

points.zh: 双链解开(strand separation)后,核酸溶液的粘度(viscosity)会下降——这是判断变性发生的一个宏观、可观察的指标。
points.en: When the two strands separate, the viscosity of the nucleic acid solution drops — a macroscopic, observable sign that denaturation has occurred.

points.zh: 举例:大肠杆菌加RIPA裂解液(RIPA lysis buffer)溶解细胞膜和蛋白质,其效果与超声(sonication)类似;超声会把核酸打得碎碎的(shear/fragment DNA)。
points.en: Example: adding RIPA lysis buffer to E. coli dissolves the membrane and proteins, similar in effect to sonication; sonication shears nucleic acids into small fragments.

points.zh: 超声处理后,菌液虽然还有一点粘度,但粘度会明显比较低。
points.en: After sonication the bacterial lysate still has a little viscosity, but it is noticeably lower.

points.zh: 若用比较温和的裂解方式(不超声),完整、未被打碎的DNA会让溶液变得非常粘稠,给制样、上样和跑胶(gel electrophoresis)带来很大困难。
points.en: With a gentler lysis method (no sonication), the intact, unfragmented DNA makes the solution very viscous, which makes sample prep and gel loading much harder.

points.zh: 核酸(尤其DNA)本身很难自发变性,除非发生降解(degradation);所以平时基本不需要专门判断核酸是否变性,这一点与蛋白质变性的判断不同。
points.en: Nucleic acids (especially DNA) rarely denature spontaneously unless they are degrading, so in practice one almost never needs to check whether a nucleic acid sample has denatured — unlike protein denaturation, which is routinely checked.

extra.zh: 蛋白质纯度看A280/A260(纯品约0.6–0.7,主吸收峰280 nm来自色氨酸/酪氨酸等芳香族氨基酸);核酸纯度反过来看A260/A280(纯DNA约1.8,纯RNA约2.0)——两者的比值方向正好相反,分子分母不要记反。
extra.en: Protein purity uses A280/A260 (pure protein ≈0.6–0.7; the 280 nm peak comes from aromatic residues like Trp/Tyr), while nucleic acid purity uses the inverse ratio A260/A280 (pure DNA ≈1.8, pure RNA ≈2.0) — the two ratios point opposite directions, so don't swap numerator and denominator.

extra.zh: 双链DNA解链时,碱基堆积(base stacking)被破坏,除了粘度下降,还会出现增色效应(hyperchromic effect),即A260读数升高——这正是后面Tm曲线测定的原理基础,本段只提了粘度,没有点出这个术语。
extra.en: As dsDNA melts, disrupted base stacking also produces a hyperchromic effect — a rise in A260 — which is the physical basis for the Tm curve discussed next; this segment mentioned only viscosity, not that term.

extra.zh: 涡旋(vortex)之所以损伤核酸,是因为产生的高剪切力(shear force)会打断很长的DNA分子(尤其是基因组DNA/gDNA);质粒因为是环状(circular)且分子较小,相对更耐受机械剪切,这也是老师说"质粒稳定性最高"的部分原因。
extra.en: Vortexing damages nucleic acids because the high shear force it generates breaks long DNA molecules (especially genomic DNA); plasmids, being circular and smaller, tolerate mechanical shear better — part of why plasmids are described as the most stable form of DNA.

quiz.q_zh: 核酸变性(denaturation)时断裂的化学键是?
quiz.q_en: Which bond breaks during nucleic acid denaturation?

options.zh: 碱基与核糖之间的糖苷键
options.en: N-glycosidic bonds linking each base to its ribose

options.zh: 相邻碱基之间的堆积作用
options.en: base-stacking interactions between adjacent bases

options.zh: 互补碱基对之间的氢键
options.en: hydrogen bonds between complementary base pairs

options.zh: 糖-磷酸骨架的磷酸二酯键
options.en: phosphodiester bonds of the sugar-phosphate backbone

quiz.explain_zh: 变性断裂的是互补碱基对之间的氢键,一级结构完好所以可以复性;磷酸二酯键和糖苷键都是共价键,变性条件下不会断裂,断了就是水解而不是变性;碱基堆积作用在变性时确实被削弱,但它是范德华力驱动的疏水堆积,不是被'断裂'的化学键。
quiz.explain_en: Denaturation breaks the hydrogen bonds between complementary base pairs, leaving the primary structure intact so the strands can renature; the phosphodiester and glycosidic bonds are covalent and survive denaturing conditions — breaking them would be hydrolysis, not denaturation; base stacking is indeed weakened, but it is a van der Waals-driven hydrophobic interaction rather than a chemical bond that is broken.

quiz.q_zh: 大肠杆菌用超声处理后菌液粘度会怎样,为什么?
quiz.q_en: What happens to the viscosity of an E. coli lysate after sonication, and why?

options.zh: 粘度不变,因为超声只作用于细胞膜不影响核酸
options.en: viscosity is unchanged, because sonication only acts on the membrane, not on DNA

options.zh: 粘度降低,因为超声把染色体DNA打断成小片段
options.en: viscosity drops, because sonication shears chromosomal DNA into small fragments

options.zh: 粘度降低,因为超声使核酸完全水解为游离核苷酸
options.en: viscosity drops, because sonication hydrolyzes nucleic acid into free nucleotides

options.zh: 粘度升高,因为超声促进核酸复性形成更多双链
options.en: viscosity rises, because sonication promotes renaturation into longer duplex DNA

quiz.explain_zh: 超声通过剪切力把长链染色体DNA打碎成小片段,片段变短使溶液粘度明显下降;它并不能把磷酸二酯键彻底水解成单个核苷酸,局部升温反而不利于复性,而且细胞裂开后释放的正是让菌液发粘的染色体DNA,所以粘度不可能不变。
quiz.explain_en: Sonication shears long chromosomal DNA into short fragments by mechanical shear, and shorter fragments noticeably lower the solution's viscosity; it cannot hydrolyze every phosphodiester bond down to free nucleotides, the local heating works against renaturation, and it is precisely the chromosomal DNA released on lysis that makes the lysate viscous, so the viscosity cannot stay unchanged.

quiz.q_zh: 关于DNA和蛋白质纯度判断的说法,哪个正确?
quiz.q_en: Which statement about judging DNA versus protein purity by UV ratio is correct?

options.zh: DNA纯度看A260/A280,纯品约0.6–0.7;蛋白质纯度看A280/A260,纯品约1.8
options.en: DNA purity uses A260/A280 (pure ≈0.6–0.7); protein purity uses A280/A260 (pure ≈1.8)

options.zh: DNA纯度看A260/A280,纯品约1.8;蛋白质纯度看A280/A260,纯品约0.6–0.7
options.en: DNA purity uses A260/A280 (pure ≈1.8); protein purity uses A280/A260 (pure ≈0.6–0.7)

options.zh: DNA纯度看A280/A260,纯品约1.8;蛋白质纯度看A260/A280,纯品约0.6–0.7
options.en: DNA purity uses A280/A260 (pure ≈1.8); protein purity uses A260/A280 (pure ≈0.6–0.7)

options.zh: DNA与蛋白质的纯度都用A260/A280判断,只是纯品比值分别约为1.8和0.6–0.7
options.en: Both DNA and protein purity use A260/A280, only the pure value differing: ≈1.8 vs ≈0.6–0.7

quiz.explain_zh: DNA用A260/A280(纯品约1.8),蛋白质用A280/A260(纯品约0.6–0.7):每一方都把自己的特征吸收放在分子上,所以比值方向相反、数值也不同。把方向对调、把两者都写成A260/A280、或者把1.8和0.6–0.7两个数值互换,都会得到相反的纯度结论。
quiz.explain_en: DNA purity is read from A260/A280 (pure ≈1.8) and protein purity from A280/A260 (pure ≈0.6–0.7): each analyte's own characteristic absorbance goes on top, so the directions are reversed and the target values differ. Swapping the two directions, forcing both onto A260/A280, or exchanging the 1.8 and 0.6–0.7 values each invert the purity verdict.

title_zh: 解链温度Tm与复性
title_en: Melting Temperature (Tm) and Renaturation

points.zh: Tm(解链温度/melting temperature)定义:以A260(260 nm处吸光度)对温度作图,吸光度变化达到最大变化一半时所对应的温度。
points.en: Tm (melting temperature) is defined by plotting A260 against temperature; Tm is the temperature at which the absorbance change reaches half of its total change.

points.zh: 可以理解为核酸"变性一半"时的温度。
points.en: It can be understood as the temperature at which the nucleic acid is "half denatured".

points.zh: DNA的Tm曲线变化陡峭(sharp transition),Tm落在很窄的温度范围内,因为DNA分子结构相对均质,没有复杂的二级结构。
points.en: DNA's melting curve rises sharply, so its Tm falls in a narrow temperature range, because DNA is a relatively homogeneous double helix without complex secondary structure.

points.zh: RNA由于存在局部的二级结构(分子内碱基配对,如发夹等),分子群体整体上更不均一(heterogeneous),解链曲线更平缓,Tm对应的温度范围较宽。
points.en: RNA has local secondary structure (intramolecular base pairing, e.g. hairpins), making the RNA population more heterogeneous; its melting curve rises more gradually and its Tm spans a wider temperature range.

points.zh: 复性(renaturation/annealing):在合适条件下,解开的两条单链会重新配对形成双链——PCR中反复经历这一过程,课上不再展开细讲。
points.en: Renaturation (annealing): under the right conditions the separated single strands re-pair into a duplex — this happens repeatedly during PCR, and was not elaborated further in lecture.

extra.zh: Tm值与GC含量(GC content)正相关:G-C碱基对由三个氢键连接,比A-T的两个氢键更稳定,所以GC比例越高、Tm越高——这是解释"DNA解链曲线陡峭、范围窄"的常见机制补充。
extra.en: Tm correlates positively with GC content: a G-C pair has three hydrogen bonds versus two for A-T, so it is more stable, and higher GC content raises Tm — a common mechanistic addition to why DNA's melting transition is sharp and narrow.

extra.zh: A260升高的现象称为增色效应(hyperchromic effect);复性/退火时A260下降则称为减色效应(hypochromic effect)——这组术语常配对考,课上只描述了曲线形状,没有点名。
extra.en: A rise in A260 is called the hyperchromic effect; the drop in A260 during renaturation/annealing is the hypochromic effect — this pair of terms is a common exam pairing that the lecture described by shape but did not name.

extra.zh: "变性一半"是一个基于A260变化的操作性定义(operational definition),不是说恰好一半数量的氢键断裂——不要把吸光度百分比和氢键断裂比例直接划等号。
extra.en: "Half denatured" is an operational definition based on the A260 change, not a claim that exactly half the hydrogen bonds have broken — don't equate the absorbance percentage directly with the fraction of bonds broken.

quiz.q_zh: DNA的Tm曲线与RNA相比有什么特点,原因是什么?
quiz.q_en: How does DNA's Tm curve differ from RNA's, and why?

options.zh: DNA的Tm曲线更平缓、范围更宽,因为DNA有二级结构
options.en: DNA's curve is flatter and wider, because DNA carries secondary structure

options.zh: RNA的Tm曲线更陡峭、范围更窄,因为RNA结构均一
options.en: RNA's curve is sharper and narrower, because RNA is structurally uniform

options.zh: DNA和RNA的Tm曲线形状几乎相同,解链行为一致
options.en: DNA's and RNA's curves are nearly identical, both melting uniformly

options.zh: DNA的Tm曲线更陡峭、范围更窄,因为DNA结构均一
options.en: DNA's curve is sharper and narrower, because DNA is structurally uniform

quiz.explain_zh: DNA是通体互补配对的均质双螺旋,解链行为一致,Tm曲线陡峭、范围窄;RNA因发夹等局部二级结构而不均质,曲线更平缓、范围更宽。把'均一'安给RNA、把'有二级结构'安给DNA,或者说两者曲线形状相同,都与这一对比矛盾。
quiz.explain_en: DNA is a homogeneous, fully complementary duplex that melts uniformly, giving a sharp, narrow Tm curve; RNA's hairpins and other local secondary structure make the population heterogeneous, giving a more gradual, wider curve. Assigning uniformity to RNA, assigning secondary structure to DNA, or calling the two curves identical each contradict that contrast.

quiz.q_zh: Tm值的定义是?
quiz.q_en: What is the definition of Tm?

options.zh: A280吸光度变化达到最大变化一半时的温度
options.en: the temperature where the A280 change is half of its total change

options.zh: A260吸光度的变化达到最大变化一半时的温度
options.en: the temperature where the A260 change is half of its total change

options.zh: 核酸双链完全解开、A260不再上升时的温度
options.en: the temperature where the duplex is fully open and A260 stops rising

options.zh: 核酸开始出现降解、A260明显下降时的温度
options.en: the temperature where degradation starts and A260 clearly falls

quiz.explain_zh: Tm是用A260(核酸的特征吸收波长)对温度作图后,吸光度变化恰好达到一半时对应的温度。完全解开对应的是曲线的平台终点而不是中点;降解与解链是两回事,Tm与降解无关;A280是蛋白质的特征波长,核酸的增色效应看不出来。
quiz.explain_en: Tm is read from an A260-versus-temperature plot at the point where the absorbance change is exactly half complete. Complete melting corresponds to the end of the plateau rather than the midpoint; degradation is a different process and does not define Tm; and A280 is the protein wavelength, where the nucleic acid hyperchromic shift is not visible.

quiz.q_zh: RNA的Tm曲线范围比DNA宽,最主要的原因是?
quiz.q_en: What is the main reason RNA's Tm range is wider than DNA's?

options.zh: RNA分子内的局部二级结构使分子群体更加不均质
options.en: RNA's local secondary structure makes the molecular population heterogeneous

options.zh: RNA的分子量远大于DNA,解链需要更多能量
options.en: RNA has a far higher molecular weight than DNA and needs more melting energy

options.zh: RNA用尿嘧啶代替胸腺嘧啶,配对稳定性更参差
options.en: RNA uses uracil in place of thymine, making pairing stability more uneven

options.zh: RNA是单链分子,完全不存在稳定的碱基配对
options.en: RNA molecules are single-stranded and form no stable base pairing at all

quiz.explain_zh: RNA的局部二级结构(如发夹配对)使不同区段的稳定性不一致,解链发生在更宽的温度范围。细胞内RNA的分子量通常远小于染色体DNA,能量的说法也站不住;U与A同样形成两个氢键,替换T并不会让配对稳定性变得参差;而'完全不存在稳定的碱基配对'与RNA确实折叠出发夹的事实直接矛盾,若真如此就根本不会有解链曲线。
quiz.explain_en: RNA's local secondary structure (e.g. hairpin pairing) makes different regions differ in stability, spreading the transition over a wider temperature range. Cellular RNA is typically far smaller than chromosomal DNA, so the molecular-weight argument fails; U pairs with A through the same two hydrogen bonds as T, so the substitution does not make pairing uneven; and claiming no stable base pairing at all contradicts the hairpins RNA demonstrably forms — with no pairing there would be no melting curve to measure.

title_zh: 核酸提取方法:质粒miniprep、酚氯仿法与RNA提取
title_en: Nucleic Acid Extraction: Plasmid Miniprep, Phenol-Chloroform, and RNA Extraction

points.zh: 提取核酸的总原则是防止降解和变性:避免过酸、过碱、剧烈搅拌;提取DNA时不要涡旋(vortex),涡旋产生的剪切力(shear force)会把核酸剪得碎碎的。
points.en: The general principle of nucleic acid extraction is to prevent degradation and denaturation: avoid strong acid/base and vigorous mixing; never vortex when extracting DNA, since the shear force it generates fragments the nucleic acid.

points.zh: 质粒(plasmid)是环状DNA(circular DNA),稳定性相对最高,是目前最常规提取的DNA形式。
points.en: A plasmid is circular DNA, which is relatively the most stable form, and is the DNA type extracted most routinely today.

points.zh: 传统miniprep用SDS(十二烷基硫酸钠)加高浓度NaCl(如300–500 mM甚至更高)裂解:SDS直接与蛋白质结合使其变性沉淀,形成肉眼可见的白色沉淀;离心后蛋白质留在沉淀里,上清含高盐和核酸。
points.en: Classic miniprep lysis uses SDS plus high-concentration NaCl (e.g. 300–500 mM or higher): SDS binds proteins directly and denatures/precipitates them into a visible white pellet; after centrifugation the protein stays in the pellet while the supernatant holds the high salt and the nucleic acid.

points.zh: 现在通常不再用稀释法,而是把上清直接过亲和柱(affinity column):过柱时高浓度NaCl随水相穿透柱子而不被保留,最后用ddH2O或TE缓冲液(Tris-EDTA,提供缓冲环境并螯合金属离子)把DNA洗脱下来。
points.en: The dilution step is now usually skipped; the supernatant is loaded directly onto an affinity column. The high-salt fraction flows through without being retained, and the DNA is finally eluted with ddH2O or TE buffer (Tris-EDTA, which buffers the solution and chelates metal ions).

points.zh: 更古老的方法是酚氯仿抽提法(phenol-chloroform extraction),常用比例苯酚:氯仿约25:24,对核酸溶解性好而对蛋白质溶解性差;但氯仿剧毒、苯酚对人体毒性也大,现在已很少使用。
points.en: An older method is phenol-chloroform extraction, typically phenol:chloroform ≈ 25:24, which dissolves nucleic acids well but proteins poorly; chloroform is highly toxic and phenol is also toxic to humans, so this method is now rarely used.

points.zh: RNA提取常用TRIzol试剂,其中也含有酚氯仿类似成分,同样毒性较大。
points.en: RNA extraction commonly uses TRIzol reagent, which also contains a phenol-chloroform-like component and is likewise fairly toxic.

points.zh: 所有做RNA相关实验的玻璃/塑料器皿要高压灭菌或用DEPC水处理,以灭活环境中的RNase;DNA可直接用ddH2O溶解,RNA必须用DEPC水(DEPC-treated water)溶解,否则残留的RNase会很快把RNA降解掉;也可另外加入商品化的RNase抑制剂来抑制残留酶活性。
points.en: All glass/plastic used for RNA work should be autoclaved or DEPC-treated to inactivate ambient RNase; DNA can be dissolved directly in ddH2O, but RNA must be dissolved in DEPC-treated water, or residual RNase will quickly degrade it. A commercial RNase inhibitor can also be added to suppress residual enzyme activity.

extra.zh: DEPC(diethyl pyrocarbonate,焦碳酸二乙酯)通过共价修饰RNase上的组氨酸(histidine)残基使其失活;DEPC本身有毒且不稳定,处理过的水必须再高压灭菌分解掉残留DEPC(生成CO2和乙醇),否则DEPC也会修饰RNA本身、影响后续实验。
extra.en: DEPC (diethyl pyrocarbonate) inactivates RNase by covalently modifying its histidine residues; DEPC itself is toxic and unstable, so DEPC-treated water must be autoclaved to break down residual DEPC (into CO2 and ethanol), otherwise DEPC can also modify the RNA itself and interfere with downstream work.

extra.zh: 酚氯仿抽提常用的三组分比例是苯酚:氯仿:异戊醇(isoamyl alcohol)= 25:24:1,异戊醇的作用是减少抽提时产生的泡沫、帮助水相/有机相分离;课上提到"25比24比1"但没有点名第三种成分是异戊醇。
extra.en: The classic three-component ratio is phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol = 25:24:1; isoamyl alcohol reduces foaming during extraction and helps the aqueous/organic phases separate cleanly. The lecture gave the "25:24:1" ratio without naming the third component.

extra.zh: SDS在这里的作用是让蛋白质变性沉淀以便去除,而不是像在SDS-PAGE中那样均匀包被蛋白质使其带负电荷、用于按分子量分离——同一试剂在裂解和电泳这两种语境下的作用侧重完全不同,容易混淆。
extra.en: Here SDS denatures and precipitates protein so it can be removed — a different role from SDS-PAGE, where SDS uniformly coats proteins to give them a negative charge for size-based separation. The same reagent plays quite different roles in lysis versus electrophoresis, and the two are easy to conflate.

extra.zh: 硅胶膜亲和柱(silica membrane column)结合DNA依赖高盐(高浓度离液盐类,本例中的高浓度NaCl)屏蔽DNA磷酸骨架的负电荷,使其能与带负电的硅胶表面结合;这也是为什么洗脱要用低盐的水或TE缓冲液——盐浓度降低后DNA重新带负电、与硅胶相互排斥而被释放下来。
extra.en: Silica-membrane affinity columns bind DNA because high salt (a chaotropic-type high-concentration NaCl in this case) shields the negative charge on DNA's phosphate backbone, letting it bind the negatively charged silica surface; this is why elution uses low-salt water or TE buffer — lowering the salt restores DNA's negative charge, which is then repelled from the silica and released.

quiz.q_zh: 传统质粒miniprep中,加入SDS和高浓度NaCl后离心得到的白色沉淀主要是什么?
quiz.q_en: In classic plasmid miniprep, after adding SDS and high-concentration NaCl and centrifuging, what does the white pellet mainly consist of?

options.zh: 被高盐沉淀下来的染色体DNA片段
options.en: chromosomal DNA fragments salted out of solution

options.zh: 在高盐条件下结晶析出的NaCl
options.en: NaCl crystallizing out at high salt concentration

options.zh: 未被裂解的完整细胞与细胞壁碎片
options.en: intact unlysed cells together with cell-wall debris

options.zh: SDS与变性蛋白结合成的复合物
options.en: a complex of SDS bound to the denatured protein

quiz.explain_zh: SDS直接与细胞内蛋白质结合使其变性,加高盐后形成不溶的白色SDS-蛋白复合物沉淀,离心后与留在上清中的质粒DNA分开。染色体DNA虽然会被一起裹下去,但它不是沉淀的主体;NaCl在这个浓度下完全溶解,不会结晶;而SDS的作用恰恰是把细胞裂解开,沉淀里不是完整细胞。
quiz.explain_en: SDS binds cellular protein directly and denatures it; on adding high salt this forms an insoluble white SDS-protein complex that pellets, separating it from the plasmid DNA left in the supernatant. Chromosomal DNA is dragged down with it but is not the bulk of the pellet; NaCl is fully dissolved at this concentration and does not crystallize; and SDS is precisely what lyses the cells, so the pellet is not made of intact cells.

quiz.q_zh: 现在酚氯仿抽提法很少被使用,主要原因是?
quiz.q_en: Why is the phenol-chloroform extraction method rarely used today?

options.zh: 该方法对核酸的得率明显偏低
options.en: the method's nucleic acid yield is clearly too low

options.zh: 该方法完全无法去除样品中的蛋白
options.en: the method cannot remove any protein from the sample

options.zh: 该方法只能提RNA不能处理DNA
options.en: the method extracts only RNA and cannot handle DNA

options.zh: 氯仿与苯酚对人体的毒性都很大
options.en: both chloroform and phenol are quite toxic to humans

quiz.explain_zh: 酚氯仿法本身核酸得率高、去蛋白效果好(核酸留在水相,变性的蛋白进入酚相和界面),DNA和RNA都能提,只是改变pH偏好不同;它被淘汰的主要原因是氯仿剧毒、苯酚腐蚀且有较大毒性,操作必须在通风橱里进行。
quiz.explain_en: Phenol-chloroform extraction actually gives a high nucleic acid yield and removes protein well (nucleic acid stays in the aqueous phase while denatured protein goes to the phenol phase and interface), and it handles both DNA and RNA, only with a different pH preference; the real reason it fell out of use is that chloroform is highly toxic and phenol is corrosive and toxic, so the work must be done in a fume hood.

quiz.q_zh: 处理RNA相关实验用的玻璃器皿和水,为什么要用DEPC处理或高压灭菌?
quiz.q_en: Why must glassware and water used for RNA work be DEPC-treated or autoclaved?

options.zh: 灭活环境中残留的RNase,防止RNA降解
options.en: to inactivate the residual RNase and prevent RNA from degrading

options.zh: 灭活环境中残留的DNase,防止DNA污染
options.en: to inactivate the residual DNase and prevent DNA carryover

options.zh: 去除水中残留的重金属离子,避免核酸发生变性
options.en: to remove residual heavy-metal ions that would denature RNA

options.zh: 降低水的电导率,从而提高核酸在水中的溶解度
options.en: to lower conductivity and so improve nucleic acid solubility

quiz.explain_zh: DEPC处理和高压灭菌的目的都是灭活环境中无处不在、极其耐热的RNase,防止RNA样品被迅速降解。DNase污染是用DNase酶消化或柱上处理解决的,不靠DEPC;重金属离子不是核酸变性的常见原因;水的电导率也不影响核酸溶解。
quiz.explain_en: Both DEPC treatment and autoclaving are meant to inactivate the ubiquitous, remarkably heat-stable RNase in the environment so it cannot rapidly degrade the RNA sample. DNase carryover is handled by enzymatic or on-column DNase digestion rather than DEPC; heavy-metal ions are not a common cause of nucleic acid denaturation; and the water's conductivity does not affect how well nucleic acid dissolves.

title_zh: 核酸定量与氯化铯密度梯度离心(含一段连线中断与闲聊)
title_en: Nucleic Acid Quantification and CsCl Density Gradient Centrifugation (includes a call-reconnection interruption and casual chat)

points.zh: 早期定量核酸浓度用"定磷法"(phosphate determination),测核酸中的磷含量来推算核酸量,这是上世纪的方法,现在完全不用了。
points.en: An early quantification method, phosphate determination, measured the phosphate content of a nucleic acid sample to infer its concentration; this was a 20th-century method and is completely obsolete now.

points.zh: 要分离一个物种的全部核酸(如大肠杆菌的总蛋白+DNA+RNA)可用氯化铯(CsCl)密度梯度离心(density gradient / isopycnic centrifugation),利用蛋白质、DNA、RNA各自密度不同而分层。
points.en: To separate all of a species' nucleic acids (e.g. total protein + DNA + RNA from E. coli), one can use CsCl density gradient (isopycnic) centrifugation, which exploits the different densities of protein, DNA and RNA to layer them apart.

points.zh: 离心后从上到下依次是:密度最低的蛋白质在最上层,DNA居中,密度最高的RNA沉到最下层。
points.en: After centrifugation, from top to bottom: the lowest-density protein sits at the top, DNA is in the middle, and the highest-density RNA sinks to the bottom.

points.zh: 现在很少提取"总核酸",因为常规实验(如大肠杆菌质粒)用miniprep就够了——高拷贝质粒(如pUC系衍生载体)在细菌内拷贝数可达几万到几十万份,占比很高,没必要再做这种精细的总核酸分层。
points.en: Total nucleic acid extraction is rarely done now, because routine work (e.g. bacterial plasmids) only needs miniprep — high-copy plasmids (e.g. pUC-derived vectors) can reach tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of copies per cell, making fine-grained total-nucleic-acid separation unnecessary.

points.zh: 凝胶电泳后切胶回收(gel extraction)的回收效率和分辨率都远高于CsCl密度梯度离心,这也是CsCl梯度离心逐渐被淘汰的原因之一。
points.en: Gel extraction after electrophoresis has both much higher recovery efficiency and much higher resolution than CsCl gradient centrifugation, which is one more reason the latter has fallen out of use.

points.zh: 这段中间发生了一次真实的会议连线中断(约01:22–01:24),随后是关于生物化学这门课有多难、老师本科时"四大必挂"课程的闲聊——这部分不是讲课内容,可以跳过。
points.en: In the middle of this stretch there was a real video-call disconnection (roughly the 01:22–01:24 mark), followed by casual chat about how hard biochemistry is and the teacher's undergraduate "four hardest-to-pass courses" — this part is not lecture content and can be skipped.

extra.zh: CsCl密度梯度离心属于等密度离心(isopycnic/equilibrium centrifugation),需要超速离心机(ultracentrifuge)长时间运转(常需十几到几十小时)才能达到平衡,这也是它效率远低于凝胶电泳/柱纯化的原因之一,课上只强调了效率和分辨率的差距,没有展开离心时长的问题。
extra.en: CsCl gradient centrifugation is isopycnic (equilibrium) centrifugation and requires an ultracentrifuge running for a long time (often tens of hours) to reach equilibrium, which is part of why it is so much slower than gel electrophoresis or column purification; the lecture emphasized the efficiency/resolution gap but not the run-time issue.

extra.zh: 定磷法测的是核酸骨架中磷酸基团的总含量,通过显色反应间接推算核酸浓度,精度和特异性远不如现在的紫外分光光度法(UV/A260)或荧光染料法(如PicoGreen)。
extra.en: Phosphate determination measures the total phosphate content of the nucleic acid backbone via a colorimetric reaction to infer concentration indirectly; it is far less precise and specific than modern UV spectrophotometry (A260) or fluorescent-dye methods (e.g. PicoGreen).

extra.zh: 不要把"总核酸提取(CsCl梯度分离蛋白/DNA/RNA)"和"质粒miniprep(只针对细菌内高拷贝质粒DNA)"混为一谈——前者是分离一个细胞/组织中所有核酸种类,后者是富集提取某一种特定的核酸分子。
extra.en: Don't conflate "total nucleic acid extraction (CsCl gradient separating protein/DNA/RNA)" with "plasmid miniprep (targeting only high-copy plasmid DNA in bacteria)" — the former separates every nucleic acid species in a cell/tissue, the latter enriches one specific molecule.

quiz.q_zh: 氯化铯(CsCl)密度梯度离心分离大肠杆菌裂解物后,从离心管上层到下层的排列顺序是?
quiz.q_en: After CsCl density gradient centrifugation of an E. coli lysate, what is the top-to-bottom order of layers in the tube?

options.zh: 蛋白质、RNA、DNA
options.en: protein, RNA, DNA

options.zh: DNA、蛋白质、RNA
options.en: DNA, protein, RNA

options.zh: RNA、DNA、蛋白质
options.en: RNA, DNA, protein

options.zh: 蛋白质、DNA、RNA
options.en: protein, DNA, RNA

quiz.explain_zh: 等密度离心中各组分停在与自身浮力密度相等的位置:蛋白质约1.3 g/cm³最轻浮在上层,DNA约1.7 g/cm³居中,RNA约1.9 g/cm³最重沉在下层,所以顺序是蛋白质在上、DNA居中、RNA在底。
quiz.explain_en: In isopycnic centrifugation each component stops where its own buoyant density matches the gradient: protein at about 1.3 g/cm³ is lightest and floats on top, DNA at about 1.7 g/cm³ bands in the middle, and RNA at about 1.9 g/cm³ is densest and sinks to the bottom.

quiz.q_zh: 现在大肠杆菌实验中很少再用CsCl密度梯度离心提取总核酸,最主要的原因是?
quiz.q_en: Why is CsCl density gradient centrifugation now rarely used to extract total nucleic acid from E. coli?

options.zh: 常规实验只需miniprep取质粒,凝胶回收更精细
options.en: routine work needs only a miniprep, and gel extraction is much finer

options.zh: CsCl密度梯度离心已被证明无法分离DNA与RNA
options.en: CsCl gradient centrifugation cannot separate DNA from RNA at all

options.zh: CsCl会在长时间离心中降解核酸而导致实验失败
options.en: CsCl degrades the nucleic acid during the long spin and ruins it

options.zh: 大肠杆菌不含可被CsCl梯度分开的高密度RNA
options.en: E. coli has no high-density RNA a CsCl gradient could separate

quiz.explain_zh: CsCl梯度离心技术上依然有效,只是常规实验通常只要高拷贝质粒,miniprep加凝胶回收既快又能按大小精确取带,超速离心几十小时的代价不值得。说它分不开DNA和RNA与密度差事实相反;CsCl是惰性盐,不会降解核酸;大肠杆菌的rRNA和tRNA含量很高,密度也足以成带。
quiz.explain_en: CsCl gradient centrifugation still works technically; it fell out of favour because routine work usually needs only high-copy plasmid, and a miniprep plus gel extraction is faster and lets you pick a band by size, which is not worth tens of hours of ultracentrifugation. Saying it cannot separate DNA from RNA contradicts their density difference; CsCl is an inert salt that does not degrade nucleic acid; and E. coli is rich in rRNA and tRNA, dense enough to band.

quiz.q_zh: 定磷法(phosphate determination)用于核酸定量的原理是?
quiz.q_en: What is the principle behind phosphate determination as a nucleic acid quantification method?

options.zh: 用显色反应测定核酸骨架上全部磷酸基团的总量
options.en: measuring total phosphate on the nucleic acid backbone by colour reaction

options.zh: 用紫外激发测定核酸中嘌呤碱基的自身荧光强度
options.en: measuring the native fluorescence of purine bases under UV excitation

options.zh: 用分光光度计测定样品 260nm 处的吸光度
options.en: measuring the ultraviolet absorbance of the sample at 260 nm wavelength

options.zh: 用溴化乙啶嵌入核酸后测定其荧光的强度大小
options.en: measuring fluorescence of ethidium bromide intercalated into nucleic acid

quiz.explain_zh: 定磷法靠显色反应测出核酸骨架上磷酸基团的总量,再按每个核苷酸含一个磷酸换算成核酸浓度;260nm 吸光度法和溴化乙啶嵌入荧光法都是后来取代它的现代方法,而嘌呤碱基自身的荧光极弱,从来不用于定量。
quiz.explain_en: Phosphate determination uses a colour reaction to measure the total phosphate on the backbone, then converts it to concentration via one phosphate per nucleotide; absorbance at 260 nm and ethidium-bromide intercalation fluorescence are the modern methods that later replaced it, while the native fluorescence of purine bases is far too weak to be used for quantification.

title_zh: 溴化乙啶(EB):嵌入DNA的机制、染色体变异与致癌性
title_en: Ethidium Bromide (EB): DNA Intercalation, Chromosomal Aberration, and Carcinogenicity

points.zh: 溴化乙啶(ethidium bromide, EB)是强致癌剂,绝对不能徒手直接接触。
points.en: Ethidium bromide (EB) is a potent carcinogen and must never be handled with bare hands.

points.zh: EB的作用机制是嵌入(intercalate)到DNA双链碱基对之间,插入后会干扰正常的碱基对(base pair)配对关系,导致碱基错配(mismatch)。
points.en: EB works by intercalating between DNA base pairs; once inserted it disrupts normal base pairing and causes mismatches.

points.zh: 若细胞正处于DNA复制(replication)阶段,被EB干扰产生的错误信息有可能被直接复制并保留下来,使该细胞发生突变(mutation)。
points.en: If a cell is undergoing DNA replication at the time, the erroneous information caused by EB can be copied and fixed into the genome, producing a mutation in that cell.

points.zh: 人体基因组有几十亿个碱基对(base pairs),错配一个碱基对极难被机体自身的DNA修复(repair)机制排查出来,这是EB毒性比普通遗传突变更高、能诱导癌症(carcinogenesis)的原因。
points.en: The human genome has billions of base pairs, and a single mismatched pair is extremely hard for the body's own DNA repair machinery to detect — this is why EB's mutagenic potency, and its ability to induce cancer, exceeds that of an ordinary inherited mutation.

points.zh: 染色体变异(chromosomal aberration)有多种类型:比如染色体断裂(丢失一段)——细胞通常能耐受,顶多丢失一段信息或细胞直接死亡;更危险的是像EB这类插入(insertion)导致的碱基错配,它不破坏整条染色体的配对结构,却会系统性地改写遗传信息。
points.en: Chromosomal aberrations come in several types: e.g. breakage/deletion of a segment, which a cell can usually tolerate — it loses that stretch of information, or the cell simply dies. More dangerous is an EB-type insertion that mismatches bases: it doesn't break the chromosome's overall pairing structure, but it systematically corrupts the genetic information.

points.zh: 实验操作上更推荐用"预染"(pre-stained)上样染料(loading dye):EB只被提前加在样品/loading buffer的小体积里,而不加入制胶(gel casting)和电泳缓冲液(running buffer)中,这样接触到的EB总量大幅减少,相对更安全。
points.en: In practice, a "pre-stained" loading dye is recommended: EB is added only to the small volume of sample/loading buffer beforehand, rather than into the gel-casting mix or the running buffer, greatly reducing total EB exposure and making the process comparatively safer.

points.zh: 对比:传统做法是把EB直接加到胶(gel)里、加到电泳缓冲液里,或者跑完胶后把胶泡在EB溶液中染色,这些做法接触到的EB总量都比预染法大得多。
points.en: By contrast, older practice adds EB directly into the gel, into the running buffer, or post-stains the gel by soaking it in EB solution after the run — all of these involve much more total EB exposure than the pre-stained approach.

extra.zh: 老师说"假如拿手指头摸了EB,变异的也只是手指头"这种想法本身不准确:单个体细胞(somatic cell)的突变确实通常只影响该细胞及其克隆后代,不会像生殖系突变(germline mutation)那样遗传给下一代,但这不代表接触是安全的——体细胞突变仍可能是癌变的起点,这正是老师随后强调"很难排查、诱癌性更高"的原因。
extra.en: The offhand idea "if I touched it with a finger, only the finger's cells would mutate" is itself imprecise: a somatic-cell mutation usually does stay confined to that cell and its clonal descendants rather than being inherited like a germline mutation, but that does not make contact safe — a somatic mutation can still be the starting point of cancer, which is exactly why the lecture goes on to stress how hard such errors are to catch and how strongly carcinogenic they are.

extra.zh: EB嵌入DNA双螺旋后会使相邻碱基对之间的间距明显增大,是它在琼脂糖凝胶电泳(agarose gel electrophoresis)中用作核酸荧光染料的物理基础——嵌入后其荧光量子产率大幅提高,在紫外光(UV)激发下发出橙红色荧光,从而使核酸条带可视化。
extra.en: EB intercalation between base pairs noticeably widens the spacing of the double helix, which is the physical basis for its use as a nucleic acid fluorescent stain in agarose gel electrophoresis — intercalation greatly increases its fluorescence quantum yield, so under UV excitation it emits orange-red fluorescence that visualizes the nucleic acid bands.

extra.zh: 严格来说,像EB这类嵌入剂(intercalating agent)引起的经典突变类型主要是移码突变(frameshift mutation)——嵌入使双螺旋局部解旋、拉长,复制时DNA聚合酶容易在该处多插入或漏掉一个核苷酸,而不是直接让某个碱基去配对"错误的"碱基;课上"碱基错配"的说法是一种简化描述,区分插入/缺失型移码突变和碱基替换型点突变(point mutation)是常见考点。
extra.en: Strictly speaking, the classic mutation type caused by intercalating agents like EB is frameshift mutation — intercalation locally unwinds and lengthens the helix, making DNA polymerase prone to inserting or skipping a nucleotide there during replication, rather than directly pairing one base with a "wrong" one. The lecture's phrase "base mismatch" is a simplification; distinguishing insertion/deletion-driven frameshift mutations from substitution-driven point mutations is a common exam point.

extra.zh: 现在不少实验室已改用毒性更低的替代染料,如SYBR Safe、GelRed等,它们同样通过嵌入或沟槽结合(groove binding)方式与DNA相互作用而发出荧光,但致突变性显著低于EB——这是课上没有提到的现代替代方案。
extra.en: Many labs now switch to lower-toxicity alternative dyes such as SYBR Safe or GelRed, which likewise fluoresce by intercalating or groove-binding to DNA but are markedly less mutagenic than EB — a modern alternative the lecture did not mention.

quiz.q_zh: 溴化乙啶(EB)使DNA发生突变的分子机制是?
quiz.q_en: What is the molecular mechanism by which ethidium bromide (EB) causes DNA mutation?

options.zh: EB 直接氧化 DNA 碱基,原位生成 8-氧鸟嘌呤
options.en: EB directly oxidises DNA bases in situ, generating 8-oxoguanine lesions

options.zh: EB 竞争性占据 DNA 聚合酶活性位点,阻断复制
options.en: EB competitively occupies the polymerase active site, halting replication

options.zh: EB 嵌入相邻 DNA 碱基对之间,干扰正常碱基配对
options.en: EB intercalates between adjacent DNA base pairs, disturbing base pairing

options.zh: EB 与 DNA 磷酸骨架共价结合,切断磷酸二酯键
options.en: EB covalently binds the phosphate backbone, cutting phosphodiester bonds

quiz.explain_zh: EB 的核心机制是非共价地嵌入相邻碱基对之间、把双螺旋撑开,复制时因此造成插入或缺失。它不与磷酸骨架形成共价键,也不切断磷酸二酯键;把碱基氧化成 8-氧鸟嘌呤的是活性氧而不是 EB;它更不是结合在聚合酶活性位点上的竞争性抑制剂。
quiz.explain_en: EB's core mechanism is non-covalent intercalation between adjacent base pairs, which unwinds the helix and produces insertions or deletions during replication. It forms no covalent bond with the phosphate backbone and cuts no phosphodiester bond; oxidation of bases to 8-oxoguanine is the work of reactive oxygen species, not EB; and it is not a competitive inhibitor sitting in the polymerase active site.

quiz.q_zh: "预染"(pre-stained)loading dye相对传统EB染色方法更安全,原因是?
quiz.q_en: Why is a "pre-stained" loading dye considered safer than the traditional EB-staining approach?

options.zh: EB 在预染染料中已失去嵌入 DNA 双链的能力
options.en: the EB in the pre-stained dye has already lost the power to intercalate

options.zh: 预染染料中完全不含 EB,改用无毒荧光染料替代
options.en: the pre-stained dye contains no EB at all, using a non-toxic dye instead

options.zh: 预染方法要等跑完胶之后才把 EB 加进染色液中
options.en: the pre-stained method adds EB to the staining bath only after the run

options.zh: EB 只进入小体积上样缓冲液,不进入胶和电泳液
options.en: EB goes only into the small loading buffer, never the gel or run buffer

quiz.explain_zh: 预染法用的仍然是 EB,只是把它限制在体积极小的上样缓冲液里,不再倒进制胶液和电泳缓冲液这类大体积液体,总接触量因此大幅下降。预染染料里的 EB 照样能正常嵌入 DNA,它确实含 EB 而不是无毒替代染料,而跑完胶之后再泡染色液恰恰是它要取代的传统做法。
quiz.explain_en: The pre-stained method still uses EB; it merely confines it to a very small volume of loading buffer instead of the large volumes of gel-casting mix and running buffer, so total exposure drops sharply. The EB in the dye intercalates perfectly well, the dye really does contain EB rather than a non-toxic substitute, and soaking the finished gel in a staining bath is precisely the traditional practice it replaces.

quiz.q_zh: 相比染色体断裂(缺失一段),课上认为像EB插入导致的碱基错配更危险,主要理由是?
quiz.q_en: Compared with chromosome breakage (losing a segment), why does the lecture consider EB-type insertion/mismatch more dangerous?

options.zh: 它只改变生殖细胞而不影响体细胞,后果更隐蔽
options.en: it alters only germ cells and spares somatic cells, hiding the harm

options.zh: 它使 DNA 完全无法复制,受累细胞立即停止分裂
options.en: it makes DNA wholly unable to replicate, so the cell stops dividing

options.zh: 它保持染色体结构完整,却难被修复系统识别纠正
options.en: it leaves chromosome structure intact yet evades repair machinery

options.zh: 它使染色体断裂处无法愈合,受损细胞必然死亡
options.en: it keeps a chromosome break from healing, so the damaged cell dies

quiz.explain_zh: 染色体断裂丢掉一整段信息,细胞要么带着缺口存活要么死亡,损伤本身很显眼;嵌入造成的错配却保持染色体整体结构完整、难被修复系统查出,于是更容易被复制并固定下来,系统性地改写遗传信息。断裂并非无法愈合(同源重组和末端连接都能接回),EB 对体细胞和生殖细胞一样起作用,DNA 也不会因此彻底停止复制。
quiz.explain_en: A break loses a whole stretch of information: the cell either survives with a gap or dies, and the damage is conspicuous. An insertion-type mismatch leaves the overall chromosome structure intact, escapes the repair system, and is therefore more likely to be copied and fixed into the genome, systematically rewriting genetic information. Breaks are not unhealable (homologous recombination and end joining rejoin them), EB acts on somatic cells just as much as germ cells, and DNA replication does not stop outright.

title_zh: [实验室闲聊] 转化vs转染、抗生素筛选压力,及学生自述的RBD重组分析
title_en: [Lab Chat] Transformation vs. Transfection, Antibiotic Selection Pressure, and the Student's Own RBD Recombination Analysis

points.zh: 明确区分实验室常用术语:大肠杆菌等原核生物导入质粒DNA称为转化(transformation);哺乳动物细胞(mammalian cells)导入外源核酸称为转染(transfection)——两者不能混用,原核生物没有"瞬时转染/永久转染"这种说法。
points.en: A clear terminology distinction: introducing plasmid DNA into a prokaryote like E. coli is called transformation; introducing exogenous nucleic acid into mammalian cells is called transfection — the two terms are not interchangeable, and prokaryotes don't have "transient/permanent transfection" at all.

points.zh: 严格来说,大肠杆菌一旦转化成功获得质粒,是"永久的"——只是在细胞分裂复制过程中,质粒有可能被丢失(plasmid loss),因为质粒对细胞而言是一种代谢负担(metabolic burden)。
points.en: Strictly speaking, once an E. coli cell is successfully transformed with a plasmid, that state is "permanent" — except that during cell division the plasmid can still be lost, because carrying a plasmid is a metabolic burden on the cell.

points.zh: 这正是培养带质粒的大肠杆菌时必须加抗生素(antibiotics)的原因:抗生素提供选择压力(selective pressure),使得只有保留质粒(携带抗性基因)的细胞才能存活,从而迫使质粒在群体中被长期保留下来。
points.en: This is exactly why antibiotics must be added when culturing plasmid-bearing E. coli: the antibiotic imposes selective pressure so that only cells retaining the plasmid (which carries the resistance gene) survive, forcing the population to keep the plasmid over time.

points.zh: (题外话,与本重组项目相关)学生描述自己在分析RBD(receptor-binding domain)序列重组时,传统BLAST/比对(alignment)工具会"强行比对"相似序列,即使两条序列实际差异很大也可能被错误比对上,这在RBD这类彼此保守性(conservation)很高的同源序列间尤其明显。
points.en: (An aside, relevant to this recombination project) The student describes that when analyzing RBD (receptor-binding domain) sequence recombination, conventional BLAST/alignment tools will force an alignment between similar-looking sequences even when they are actually quite different, a problem that is especially pronounced among highly conserved homologous sequences like RBDs.

points.zh: 学生自己想出的替代思路是按读码框(reading frame)每3个碱基一移动、逐段核对是否与其他位置完全匹配;后来发现已有工具SimPlot就是专门用于检测病毒重组(viral recombination)的生信工具,与她自己的想法思路一致。
points.en: The student's own alternative idea was to shift by 3 bases at a time along the reading frame and check each segment for an exact match elsewhere; she later found that an existing tool, SimPlot, is specifically built to detect viral recombination and follows the same logic she had worked out herself.

points.zh: 这一整段(从01:28起)是实验室内的闲聊/答疑,不是这次课的正式讲课内容,讨论了生信分析工具的局限性以及学生自己项目的进展和明天要当面演示的压力,可整体跳过,只有转化/转染和抗生素筛选部分是可迁移的规范知识点。
points.en: This whole stretch (from roughly 01:28 on) is lab chat/informal Q&A, not formal lecture content — it covers the limits of bioinformatics tools and the student's own project progress and the pressure of a live demo the next day. It can be skipped entirely; only the transformation/transfection and antibiotic-selection portion is transferable, standard knowledge.

extra.zh: "transformation"和"transfection"的界限并不严格等同于"原核vs真核"——transfection一词也可用于把DNA导入原核细胞以外的多种真核细胞(不仅哺乳动物细胞),但"细菌用transformation、真核细胞用transfection"是绝大多数场景下适用、也是课上给出的最实用的记忆方法。
extra.en: The transformation/transfection boundary isn't strictly "prokaryote vs. eukaryote" — transfection can technically apply to various eukaryotic cells beyond mammalian ones, but "bacteria = transformation, eukaryotic cells = transfection" is the practical rule of thumb the lecture gives, and it holds for the vast majority of real situations.

extra.zh: 抗生素抗性基因(如AmpR氨苄青霉素抗性、KanR卡那霉素抗性)通常位于质粒骨架(vector backbone)上,与目的基因(insert)一起被克隆,是"筛选标记"(selection marker)的标准设计——这是抗生素选择压力起作用的分子基础,课上未展开这层机制细节。
extra.en: Antibiotic-resistance genes (e.g. AmpR for ampicillin, KanR for kanamycin) typically sit on the plasmid's vector backbone alongside the cloned insert, functioning as a standard selection marker — this is the molecular basis of why antibiotic selective pressure works, a mechanistic layer the lecture didn't spell out.

extra.zh: 学生提到的SimPlot是一款专门检测病毒基因组重组断点(recombination breakpoint)的相似性作图工具,通过滑动窗口(sliding window)比较查询序列与多个参考序列的相似度并作图,原理与她自己"逐段核对匹配"的思路一致,也是本重组项目分析流程实际会用到的工具(参见本项目pipeline的step5)。
extra.en: The SimPlot the student mentions is a similarity-plotting tool built specifically to detect viral genome recombination breakpoints: it compares a query sequence against multiple references over a sliding window and plots the similarity, matching the logic of her own "check each segment for an exact match" approach — and it is in fact the tool used in this project's own analysis pipeline (see step5).

quiz.q_zh: 在大肠杆菌中导入质粒DNA和在哺乳动物细胞中导入外源核酸,分别应该称为什么?
quiz.q_en: What are the correct terms for introducing plasmid DNA into E. coli versus introducing exogenous nucleic acid into mammalian cells?

options.zh: 大肠杆菌称为transfection(转染),哺乳动物细胞也称transfection(转染)
options.en: E. coli: transfection; mammalian cells: transfection

options.zh: 大肠杆菌称为transformation(转化),哺乳动物细胞称为transfection(转染)
options.en: E. coli: transformation; mammalian cells: transfection

options.zh: 大肠杆菌称为transfection(转染),哺乳动物细胞称为transformation(转化)
options.en: E. coli: transfection; mammalian cells: transformation

options.zh: 大肠杆菌称为transformation(转化),哺乳动物细胞也称transformation(转化)
options.en: E. coli: transformation; mammalian cells: transformation

quiz.explain_zh: 原核生物(如大肠杆菌)导入 DNA 叫 transformation,真核的哺乳动物细胞导入核酸叫 transfection,两个术语专用于不同的细胞类型,不能互换,也不能拿其中一个同时套用到两类细胞上——transformation 用在哺乳动物细胞上时,指的是细胞发生癌变转化,含义完全不同。
quiz.explain_en: Introducing DNA into a prokaryote such as E. coli is transformation; introducing nucleic acid into a eukaryotic mammalian cell is transfection. The two terms belong to different cell types, are not interchangeable, and neither one can be stretched to cover the other case — applied to mammalian cells, transformation instead means malignant conversion, an entirely different meaning.

quiz.q_zh: 培养携带质粒的大肠杆菌时必须加抗生素,最主要的原因是?
quiz.q_en: Why must antibiotics be added when culturing plasmid-bearing E. coli?

options.zh: 抗生素能够显著加快质粒在细菌体内的复制速度
options.en: the antibiotic markedly speeds plasmid replication inside the cell

options.zh: 抗生素能够与质粒结合,防止质粒序列发生突变
options.en: the antibiotic binds the plasmid and shields its sequence from mutation

options.zh: 抗生素能够提高感受态细胞摄取质粒的转化效率
options.en: the antibiotic raises the efficiency of plasmid uptake by the cells

options.zh: 抗生素施加选择压力,只有保住质粒的细胞能存活
