quiz.explain_en: The lecture emphasizes that this methyl-sulfur bond is high-energy only in the specific structure of SAM: once adenosine is attached, the sulfur becomes a positively charged sulfonium, strongly activating the methyl group. Free methionine has the same methyl-sulfur connectivity but that bond is not high-energy; the bond contains no phosphorus and so is unrelated to phosphoanhydride bonds; and the linkage plainly exists within SAM, since it is what donates the methyl group.

quiz.q_zh: 高能化合物在讲课中的定义标准是什么？
quiz.q_en: What defining criterion does the lecture give for a high-energy compound?

options.zh: 分子中必须含有至少一个磷酸基团，与释放多少自由能无关
options.en: The molecule must contain at least one phosphate group, whatever energy it releases

options.zh: 只要能参与ATP合成的化合物都算高能化合物，与键的类型无关
options.en: Any compound taking part in ATP synthesis counts, whatever type of bond it carries

options.zh: 水解时释放出的能量必须能全部直接转化为热能而不用于做功
options.en: The energy released on hydrolysis must be fully convertible into heat, not work

options.zh: 水解或基团转移反应释放出大于约21 kJ/mol的自由能
options.en: Its hydrolysis or group transfer releases more than about 21 kJ/mol of free energy

quiz.explain_zh: 讲课给出的高能化合物定义是：水解反应或某基团转移中能释放出大于约21 kJ/mol自由能的化合物，这是一个数量级门槛，不是精确切点。判据是能量而不是组成：乙酰CoA和SAM都不含磷酸基团却是高能化合物；葡萄糖-6-磷酸参与糖代谢却只释放约13 kJ/mol，不算高能；能量是否变成热也与该定义无关。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture's definition is a compound whose hydrolysis or group-transfer reaction releases more than roughly 21 kJ/mol of free energy — an order-of-magnitude threshold, not a precise cutoff. The criterion is energy, not composition: acetyl-CoA and SAM contain no phosphate yet are high-energy, while glucose-6-phosphate takes part in sugar metabolism but releases only about 13 kJ/mol and does not qualify; and whether the energy ends up as heat is irrelevant to the definition.

title_zh: ATP的α/β/γ磷酸键能级与镁离子的结合作用
title_en: ATP's α/β/γ-Phosphate Energy Level and the Role of Mg2+

points.zh: 讨论ATP时，重点不在腺嘌呤碱基(base)或核糖(ribose)，而在α、β、γ三个磷酸基团。
points.en: When discussing ATP, the focus is not on the adenine base or the ribose, but on the three phosphate groups: α, β, γ.

points.zh: 三个磷酸基团中，只有γ磷酸(γ-phosphate)对应的键是（能量适中的）高能磷酸键。
points.en: Of the three phosphate groups, only the γ-phosphate bond is the (moderate-energy) high-energy phosphate bond.

points.zh: γ磷酸的标准生化自由能变处于一个"中间"水平：它既可以从更高能的化合物接收能量（被磷酸化），也可以把能量传给更低能的化合物，讲课把这形容为生物体"折中"的策略。
points.en: The γ-phosphate's standard free energy sits at an intermediate level: it can accept energy from higher-energy compounds (being phosphorylated) and can also donate energy to lower-energy ones — described in lecture as the body's "compromise" strategy.

points.zh: 讲课先说镁离子(Mg2+)是人体内含量较多的离子之一，随即当场纠正：人体内含量最多的离子其实是钾离子(K+)，其次才是镁离子、锌离子等。
points.en: The lecture first says Mg2+ is one of the body's abundant ions, then immediately self-corrects: the most abundant ion in the body is actually potassium (K+), with magnesium and zinc coming after.

points.zh: Mg2+主要结合在ATP两个磷酸基团之间的羟基(hydroxyl)位置，发挥的作用是屏蔽ATP上的负电荷。
points.en: Mg2+ mainly binds at the hydroxyl position between two of ATP's phosphate groups, and its role is to shield the negative charges on ATP.

points.zh: 除了Mg2+，锰离子(Mn2+)、锌离子(Zn2+)等在很多酶中也能起到类似中和ATP磷酸基团负电荷的作用。
points.en: Besides Mg2+, ions like Mn2+ and Zn2+ can play a similar role in many enzymes, neutralizing the strong negative charge on ATP's phosphate groups.

extra.zh: 讲课先说"镁离子是人体内含量最多的离子之一"，随即自己纠正为"人体内最多的离子其实应该是钾离子，然后剩下的才是镁离子、锌离子"，属于当场自我更正（约02:14:21）。
extra.en: The lecture first says "Mg2+ is one of the most abundant ions in the body," then immediately self-corrects to "the most abundant ion is actually K+, followed by Mg2+, Zn2+, etc." — a same-breath self-correction (around 02:14:21).

extra.zh: 细胞内主要阳离子的相对丰度顺序通常是K+ > Mg2+ > Na+（细胞内Na+浓度远低于细胞外），Ca2+、Zn2+、Mn2+等属于微量/信号性离子，浓度远低于K+和Mg2+；这与讲课当场纠正后给出的顺序方向一致。
extra.en: The typical relative abundance order of intracellular cations is K+ > Mg2+ > Na+ (intracellular Na+ is much lower than extracellular), while Ca2+, Zn2+, Mn2+ are trace/signaling ions present at much lower concentrations than K+ and Mg2+; this matches the direction of the order lecture gives after self-correcting.

extra.zh: Mg2+-ATP复合物(Mg-ATP)是几乎所有ATP依赖性酶（如激酶kinase）真正识别和使用的底物形式，而不是"裸"ATP4-；这是酶学实验设计中常被要求注意的细节。
extra.en: The Mg2+-ATP complex (Mg-ATP), not "bare" ATP4-, is the substrate form actually recognized and used by nearly all ATP-dependent enzymes such as kinases — a detail often required in enzymology experimental design.

extra.zh: "γ磷酸自由能处于中间水平，可接收也可给出能量"容易被误解为该键不稳定/低能；实际上ATP的γ磷酸键水解自由能在生物体常见高能化合物中属于中等偏高水平——比葡萄糖-6-磷酸等低能磷酸化合物高，但比磷酸肌酸等更高能化合物低，这个相对位置正是磷酸基团转移反应能够单向进行的化学基础。
extra.en: "The γ-phosphate's free energy sits at an intermediate level, able to accept and donate energy" can be misread as meaning the bond is unstable/low-energy; in fact ATP's γ-phosphate hydrolysis free energy is on the moderately-high end among common biological high-energy compounds — higher than low-energy phosphates like glucose-6-phosphate but lower than higher-energy ones like creatine phosphate, and this relative position is exactly what makes directional phosphate group-transfer reactions possible.

quiz.q_zh: 讲课中关于ATP三个磷酸基团（α、β、γ），下列说法正确的是？
quiz.q_en: Regarding ATP's three phosphate groups (α, β, γ) as described in lecture, which statement is correct?

options.zh: 只有γ磷酸的键是高能键，其自由能处于可收可放的中间水平
options.en: Only the γ-phosphate bond is high-energy, at a middle level able to take and give energy

options.zh: α、β、γ三个磷酸键的自由能完全等价，都属于同级的高能键
options.en: The α, β and γ phosphate bonds are exactly equal in free energy and all rank as high-energy

options.zh: 只有α磷酸的键是高能键，β和γ磷酸键的自由能都非常低
options.en: Only the α-phosphate bond is high-energy, and the β and γ phosphate bonds are both very low

options.zh: 三个磷酸键中自由能最高的是β磷酸对应的键，γ磷酸键次之
options.en: The β-phosphate bond has the highest free energy of the three, with the γ-phosphate next

quiz.explain_zh: 讲课强调关注α、β、γ三个磷酸时，只有γ磷酸对应的是高能磷酸键，其自由能处于中间水平，既可从磷酸肌酸等更高能化合物接收能量，也能把能量传给更低能的化合物。α磷酸与核糖之间是普通磷酸酯键，能量远低于末端的磷酸酐键，所以三个键既不等价，最高的也不是β磷酸对应的键。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture emphasizes that among ATP's α, β, γ phosphates, only the γ-phosphate bond is the high-energy one, sitting at an intermediate free-energy level that can accept energy from higher-energy compounds such as creatine phosphate and donate it to lower-energy ones. The α-phosphate is joined to ribose by an ordinary phosphoester bond, far weaker in energy than the terminal anhydride, so the three bonds are neither equal nor headed by the β-phosphate.

quiz.q_zh: 关于人体内阳离子丰度，讲课当场做了怎样的自我纠正？
quiz.q_en: Regarding cation abundance in the body, what self-correction did the lecture make on the spot?

options.zh: 先说镁离子含量最多，随即纠正为钾离子才是含量最多的离子
options.en: First said Mg2+ was the most abundant, then corrected that K+ is actually the most abundant

options.zh: 先说钾离子含量最多，随即纠正为镁离子才是含量最多的离子
options.en: First said K+ was the most abundant, then corrected that Mg2+ is actually the most abundant

options.zh: 先说锌离子含量最多，随即纠正为镁离子才是含量最多的离子
options.en: First said Zn2+ was the most abundant, then corrected that Mg2+ is actually most abundant

options.zh: 讲课全程没有出现任何自我纠正，直接给出钾离子最多的结论
options.en: No self-correction was made at all; the lecture stated K+ was most abundant from the start

quiz.explain_zh: 讲课先说镁离子是人体内含量最多的离子之一，随即自己纠正说人体内最多的离子其实应该是钾离子，然后才是镁离子、锌离子等（约02:14:21）。纠正的方向是从镁改口到钾，而不是反过来；讲课从未先提到锌离子最多；纠正本身确实发生过，并非一开始就给出钾离子的结论。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture first said Mg2+ was one of the body's most abundant ions, then self-corrected that the most abundant ion is actually K+, followed by Mg2+, Zn2+, etc. (around 02:14:21). The correction ran from Mg2+ to K+, not the reverse; Zn2+ was never claimed to be the most abundant; and the correction did happen rather than K+ being stated from the outset.

quiz.q_zh: Mg2+结合在ATP分子上的位置和作用是什么？
quiz.q_en: Where does Mg2+ bind on the ATP molecule, and what is its role?

options.zh: 直接取代γ磷酸基团的位置，并与ADP形成新的化学键
options.en: It replaces the γ-phosphate group outright, forming a new chemical bond with the ADP

options.zh: 结合在β和γ磷酸基团的氧原子上，屏蔽ATP上的负电荷
options.en: It binds to oxygens of the β- and γ-phosphate groups, shielding ATP's negative charge

options.zh: 结合在腺嘌呤碱基的两个氮原子上，稳定碱基堆积结构
options.en: It binds to two nitrogens of the adenine base, stabilizing the base-stacking structure

options.zh: 结合在核糖的2'-羟基上，防止ATP的磷酸酐键被水解
options.en: It binds the ribose 2'-hydroxyl, shielding ATP's phosphoanhydride bond from hydrolysis

quiz.explain_zh: 讲课说明Mg2+结合在ATP两个磷酸基团之间（标准描述是β与γ磷酸的氧原子上），作用是屏蔽掉磷酸基团带的密集负电荷，细胞内真正的底物是Mg-ATP复合物。Mg2+并不结合腺嘌呤碱基去稳定堆积，也不结合核糖羟基去防止水解，更不会取代γ磷酸与ADP成键——那样ATP就不再是ATP了。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture explains that Mg2+ binds between two of ATP's phosphate groups — in the standard description, to oxygens of the β- and γ-phosphates — shielding the dense negative charge they carry, so the real substrate in cells is the Mg-ATP complex. Mg2+ does not bind the adenine base to stabilize stacking, nor the ribose hydroxyl to block hydrolysis, and it certainly does not replace the γ-phosphate and bond to ADP, which would no longer be ATP.

title_zh: ATP的电荷、跨膜机制（讲课说法有误）与本节收尾
title_en: ATP's Charge, Its Membrane-Crossing Mechanism (Lecture Misstatement), and Wrap-Up

points.zh: ATP带有三个磷酸基团，带较多负电荷：好处是水溶性好（可与溶液中的离子如Na+、Cl-形成离子相互作用），坏处是极性太强，与细胞膜的非极性脂质环境兼容性差。
points.en: ATP's three phosphate groups carry substantial negative charge: this gives good water solubility (ionic interactions with solution ions like Na+, Cl-) but also makes ATP too polar to be compatible with the nonpolar lipid environment of membranes.

points.zh: 讲课的结论是：这种强极性导致ATP不容易穿过细胞膜（包括线粒体的双层膜结构），这被形容为ATP的一个"痛点"。
points.en: The lecture's conclusion: this strong polarity makes it hard for ATP to cross cell membranes (including the mitochondrion's double-membrane structure) — described as a real "pain point" for ATP.

points.zh: 讲课给出的解决方案是：Mg2+的2个正电荷屏蔽掉ATP上的2个负电荷，使ATP净负电荷减少，再加上细胞膜磷脂头部带一点正电荷，两者互相吸引，讲课认为这样ATP就能"比较顺利地透过细胞膜"。
points.en: The lecture's proposed mechanism: Mg2+'s two positive charges shield two of ATP's negative charges, reducing its net negative charge; combined with the slightly positive charge of membrane phospholipid heads, the lecture states this lets ATP "cross the membrane fairly smoothly".

points.zh: ATP的这些特点（电荷、极性、镁离子中和作用）也适用于很多以ATP为底物的酶：Mg2+、Mn2+、Zn2+等离子普遍能中和ATP磷酸基团的强负电荷。
points.en: These ATP properties (charge, polarity, Mg2+ neutralization) also apply to many ATP-utilizing enzymes: ions like Mg2+, Mn2+, Zn2+ generally help neutralize the strong negative charge on ATP's phosphate groups.

points.zh: 讲课以此结束生物能学(bioenergetics)这一节，预告下节课开始讲糖酵解(glycolysis)。
points.en: The lecture wraps up the bioenergetics section here, previewing that the next class will begin covering glycolysis.

extra.zh: ATP并不会在Mg2+屏蔽电荷后直接扩散穿过脂双层膜。穿越线粒体内膜依靠的是腺苷酸转位酶(adenine nucleotide translocase, ANT/ANT1)，它以1:1反向交换的方式，用基质中的ATP换取胞质中的ADP。这一交换由膜电位驱动，正是细胞能把胞质和线粒体基质的ATP/ADP比值分开独立调控的机制——如果ATP能自由扩散穿膜，氧化磷酸化下游依赖的这种区隔就会被破坏（约02:15:25）。
extra.en: ATP does not diffuse directly across the lipid bilayer once Mg2+ shields its charge. Crossing the inner mitochondrial membrane is done by the adenine nucleotide translocase (ANT/ANT1), which exchanges matrix ATP for cytosolic ADP one-for-one, driven by the membrane potential — exactly how the cell keeps cytosolic and matrix ATP/ADP ratios under separate control. Free diffusion would erase the distinction the rest of oxidative phosphorylation depends on (around 02:15:25).

extra.zh: ANT是线粒体内膜上含量最丰富的转运蛋白之一，也是凋亡(apoptosis)相关研究和线粒体通透性转换孔(mitochondrial permeability transition pore, mPTP)讨论中的关键组分，是生化/细胞生物学考试中常和ATP合酶一起考的膜蛋白。
extra.en: ANT is one of the most abundant transport proteins in the inner mitochondrial membrane, and a key component in apoptosis research and discussions of the mitochondrial permeability transition pore (mPTP) — a membrane protein commonly tested alongside ATP synthase in biochemistry/cell biology exams.

extra.zh: 不要把"ATP不能自由跨膜扩散"和"ATP不能被细胞利用"混为一谈——ATP在细胞质中是可以自由扩散的（这也是前面ATP合酶定位讨论中"通用能量货币"说法的基础），受限的只是跨越脂双层膜这一步，膜内外/细胞器内外的ATP转运都需要专门的转运蛋白（如ANT）。
extra.en: Do not conflate "ATP cannot freely diffuse across membranes" with "ATP cannot be used by the cell" — ATP diffuses freely within the cytosol (the basis for the earlier "universal energy currency" point about ATP synthase localization); what's restricted is only the step of crossing a lipid bilayer, for which dedicated transport proteins like ANT are required.

extra.zh: ANT介导的ADP/ATP交换是驱动氧化磷酸化持续运转的限速环节之一，这套反向交换机制使线粒体基质内新合成的ATP不断被"换出"到胞质供全身使用，同时把胞质中消耗产生的ADP"换入"基质补充原料。
extra.en: ANT-mediated ADP/ATP exchange is one of the rate-limiting steps that keeps oxidative phosphorylation running continuously; this antiport mechanism constantly exports newly made ATP from the matrix to the cytosol for use throughout the body, while importing cytosolic ADP back into the matrix as raw material.

quiz.q_zh: 讲课认为Mg2+屏蔽ATP的负电荷之后，ATP就能"比较顺利地透过细胞膜"。标准生物化学的说法是？
quiz.q_en: The lecture claims that once Mg2+ shields ATP's negative charge, ATP can "cross the cell membrane fairly smoothly." What does standard biochemistry say instead?

options.zh: ATP不自由扩散穿膜，跨线粒体内膜靠腺苷酸转位酶反向交换
options.en: ATP does not diffuse across; it crosses the inner mitochondrial membrane by antiport

options.zh: ATP在Mg2+屏蔽电荷后就能自由扩散穿过任何一层生物膜
options.en: Once Mg2+ shields its charge, ATP can freely diffuse across any biological membrane

options.zh: ATP只能借助线粒体膜上的核孔复合体被动穿过线粒体内膜
options.en: ATP can only cross the inner mitochondrial membrane passively via nuclear pore complexes

options.zh: ATP跨线粒体内膜由ATP合酶兼职完成，不需要专门的转运蛋白
options.en: ATP synthase itself moonlights to carry ATP across, needing no dedicated transporter

quiz.explain_zh: ATP穿越线粒体内膜依靠专门的转运蛋白腺苷酸转位酶(ANT)，以基质ATP换胞质ADP的方式1:1反向交换，而不是靠Mg2+中和电荷后自由扩散穿膜。核孔复合体只存在于核膜，与线粒体内膜无关；ATP合酶的职能是利用质子梯度合成ATP，并不承担把ATP运出基质的工作，那是ANT的专职。
quiz.explain_en: ATP crosses the inner mitochondrial membrane via the dedicated transporter ANT, exchanging matrix ATP for cytosolic ADP in a 1:1 antiport, not by freely diffusing once Mg2+ neutralizes its charge. Nuclear pore complexes exist only in the nuclear envelope and have nothing to do with the inner mitochondrial membrane; and ATP synthase's job is making ATP from the proton gradient, not exporting it from the matrix, which is ANT's dedicated task.

quiz.q_zh: ATP带有三个磷酸基团带来的电荷特性，下列描述正确的是？
quiz.q_en: Regarding the charge properties resulting from ATP's three phosphate groups, which description is correct?

options.zh: 电荷使ATP水溶性好，但极性过强难以直接穿过脂质细胞膜
options.en: The charge gives ATP good water solubility but makes it too polar to cross a lipid membrane

options.zh: 电荷使ATP水溶性很差，但极性弱因而容易穿过脂质细胞膜
options.en: The charge makes ATP poorly water-soluble but weakly polar and easy to cross that membrane

options.zh: 电荷对ATP的水溶性和跨脂质膜的穿透性都完全没有影响
options.en: The charge affects neither ATP's water solubility nor its passage across the lipid membrane

options.zh: 电荷只影响ATP与酶的结合，对溶解性和膜穿透性没有影响
options.en: The charge only affects ATP's binding to enzymes, not its solubility or membrane crossing

quiz.explain_zh: 讲课指出ATP的多个磷酸基团带来大量负电荷，好处是水溶性好，坏处是极性太强导致难以直接穿过细胞膜的脂质环境。带电只会提高而不是降低水溶性，也只会降低而不是提高跨脂双层的能力；说电荷毫无影响、或只影响与酶结合，都与带电分子在疏水膜芯中受阻这一基本事实矛盾。
quiz.explain_en: The lecture points out that ATP's multiple phosphate groups carry substantial negative charge, giving good water solubility but making it too polar to cross the lipid environment of the cell membrane. Charge raises rather than lowers water solubility and lowers rather than raises passage through a bilayer; claiming no effect at all, or an effect confined to enzyme binding, contradicts the basic fact that charged molecules are blocked by the hydrophobic membrane core.

quiz.q_zh: 腺苷酸转位酶(ANT, adenine nucleotide translocase)在线粒体中的功能是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the function of the adenine nucleotide translocase (ANT) in mitochondria?

options.zh: 利用线粒体内膜两侧的质子电化学梯度直接合成出ATP分子
options.en: It uses the proton electrochemical gradient across the inner membrane to synthesize ATP

options.zh: 在基质中催化NADH向FADH2转化的氧化还原反应
options.en: It catalyzes the redox reaction converting NADH into FADH2 in the mitochondrial matrix

options.zh: 在胞质中分解ATP，把磷酸基团转给肌酸生成磷酸肌酸
options.en: It breaks down ATP and transfers the phosphate onto creatine to make creatine phosphate

options.zh: 以1:1反向交换的方式，用基质ATP换取胞质中的ADP
options.en: It exchanges matrix ATP for cytosolic ADP in a 1:1 antiport across the inner membrane

quiz.explain_zh: ANT是线粒体内膜上的转运蛋白，通过1:1反向交换机制，用基质中的ATP交换胞质中的ADP，这是ATP/ADP真正穿越线粒体内膜的机制，而非自由扩散。利用质子梯度合成ATP的是ATP合酶；NADH与FADH2各自由不同脱氢酶生成，彼此之间并无直接互变的反应；把ATP的磷酸转给肌酸的是肌酸激酶(creatine kinase)。
quiz.explain_en: ANT is a transport protein in the inner mitochondrial membrane that exchanges matrix ATP for cytosolic ADP via a 1:1 antiport — the actual way ATP/ADP crosses that membrane, rather than free diffusion. Using the proton gradient to make ATP is the job of ATP synthase; NADH and FADH2 are generated by separate dehydrogenases and there is no direct reaction converting one into the other; and transferring ATP's phosphate onto creatine is done by creatine kinase.
